sun-conjunction-sun: Your solar return, and your real birthday even if the calendar disagrees by a day. A year of your own private calendar closes and another opens. The energy is not dramatic; what you notice instead is a quiet insistence on being seen, on counting for something. Whatever you begin now carries the stamp of your own individuality more than anything else you start all year, so begin something. Let people know you are here, without arrogance and without apology. The tone you set in these few days tends to colour the twelve months that follow.
sun-sextile-sun: Two months out from your birthday, either side of it, the year's cycle offers a checkpoint rather than an event. Your goals and the goals of the people around you sit easily together, so cooperation costs nothing and confirms rather than dilutes who you are. The real use of it is scrutiny. On the pass after your birthday, take an honest measure of how far this year's intentions have actually travelled; adjustments left undone here tend to arrive as inexplicable friction at the square a month later. Ease is the opportunity, not the reward.
sun-square-sun: Three months from your birthday, coming or going, the year's project is put to the test. Very often the challenge arrives as people working at cross-purposes to you, and it is worth remembering that their motives are usually no different from yours, however deliberate the obstruction feels. Something in you is trying to get out into the light, and the world is asking it to prove itself first. The earlier square tests what you are building; the later one tests your willingness to let a finished thing go. Neither is a verdict.
sun-trine-sun: Four months either side of your birthday, the pressure drops and you can simply be yourself with little in the way. Energy runs higher, work and pleasure both go easily, and the temptation is to assume it will always be like this. It will not. Use the low stress to firm up what is working and to be honest about what is not, because doing either later will cost far more effort. If something has already failed, this is the calm in which to admit it and start clearing the ground rather than to talk yourself out of the evidence.
sun-opposition-sun: Half a year from your birthday, the cycle reaches its culmination and whatever you have been doing becomes visible, to you and to everyone else. Expect other people's ambitions to press against yours, and be careful with anyone who holds authority over you. If the work has been sound, this is where you collect. If it has not, the failure often happened months ago and only becomes undeniable now, which is why the low mood arrives with it. Treat that as an experiment concluded rather than a defeat, and note what your own creations are now making of you.
sun-conjunction-moon: A personal new moon: your domestic life, your family, your habits and your moods all come to the front, and the solar energy pours straight into them. Most people find it unexpectedly integrating, a day of feeling like one person rather than several. It only turns uncomfortable if you dislike your own feelings, in which case the discomfort is information about the attitude rather than the feelings. Because the whole inner region is briefly in flux, changes made here are easier than at any other point in the year, from rearranging a room to reopening a conversation you have avoided.
sun-sextile-moon: Conscious intention and instinctive habit are briefly in tune, which shows up as a day where ordinary life stops costing extra. Negotiations, errands, small conversations all move without friction, and people are at ease with you because you are at ease with yourself. Domestic life runs warmer than usual and is worth sharing. The specific use of this: strains in your personal life can be raised now cheaply, while you have the calm to hear an answer. Left alone because nothing is urgent, the same material tends to come back later at a worse moment and a higher price.
sun-square-moon: What you consciously intend and what you habitually do are pulling in different directions, and the friction comes out as irritability, touchiness, or acting before thinking. You can usually describe the first of these selves; the second shows up in compulsions and moods that others see in you long before you do. Neither is the enemy. Pressures you have been sitting on, at home or at work, become hard to hold down, which is uncomfortable and also useful, since it puts them where they can be dealt with. Let the dust settle before you decide what it meant.
sun-trine-moon: A settled interval in which you can look inward without bracing for what you might find. You know what you want, roughly why you want it, and you can say so; because your own moods make sense to you, other people's do too, and you are unusually good company for someone trying to work something out. Use the equilibrium to make the small compromises that clear accumulated static out of your close relationships. Whether the cycle is heading toward a climax or away from one, this is the phase for taking stock rather than for pushing.
sun-opposition-moon: Your private needs and your public obligations are pulling against each other, and the day insists you keep telling the difference: yourself and them, what you feel and what you intend, home and work. If you have been running mainly on rational intent and treating feeling as noise, this is where the neglected half sends the bill, usually through family or a partner. If the two halves have been travelling together, the same tension reads as high energy and things get done. Either way, the polarity is the point; the awareness it forces is what the transit is for.
sun-conjunction-mercury: Your attention turns to talking, writing, and the small machinery of getting things across. Conversations multiply, correspondence catches up, paperwork that has been waiting suddenly seems tractable, and the mind is clear enough to concentrate. Being a conjunction, it makes you the one who initiates: you state your position, announce intentions, open the exchange. That is also the risk. If your head is full only of what you plan to say, you will miss what is being said back to you, including the parts that bear on your own plans. Good day to begin something commercial, or to travel.
sun-sextile-mercury: Communication runs clean. Ordinary exchanges with the people around you get further than usual because you and they actually make contact, which makes this a good interval for saying something that has to be understood precisely, or for putting a group's view rather than only your own. Study goes well; you are alert and receptive rather than merely busy. Opportunities may be handed to you without your asking, but they still have to be recognised and picked up quickly. Buying, selling, negotiating and short journeys with something to learn at the end of them are all favoured.
sun-square-mercury: Ideas and messages come at you faster than you can sort them, and much of what matters is under the surface of what is actually said, so listen for the motive behind the sentence. Expect exchanges that test how clear your thinking really is, often with people who are not opposed to you at all but happen to be standing somewhere incompatible. The useful move is to find the weak points in your own position before somebody else finds them for you. There is plenty of mental force available; the danger is being carried away by the sound of your own reasoning.
sun-trine-mercury: Your mind works easily and, unusually, in both directions: you can make your point and you genuinely want to know what the other person makes of it. That combination is worth spending on anything that has needed saying. Learning goes quickly, curiosity is wide, and the more you understand about a situation the more manageable it turns out to be. The mental quiet also makes this a good time to survey your circumstances as a whole and make the small adjustments that are obvious only when you are not agitated. Travel, particularly with a purpose, tends to go well.
sun-opposition-mercury: You spend the day in dialogue, and the value of it lies entirely in what comes back. Encounters now tell you precisely where you stand with people and how your ideas have actually landed. If you are too full of your own position to hear the reply, this turns into argument for its own sake; if you can be genuinely receptive, you learn a great deal and can still advance your view, provided it is clear you are not threatening theirs. Results are arriving from directions already taken. Note them, plan accordingly, but hold off on launching anything new until they are all in.
sun-conjunction-venus: Affection, pleasure and the wish to be appreciated move to the centre. You are assertive, but only in the service of being noticed by people you care about, and you are willing to give warmth in exchange, which is why others tend to respond. Good conditions for meeting people, for social occasions, and often for money, since the attracting quality of Venus extends to resources as much as to company. The two things to watch are extravagance and self-congratulation. Neither costs much today, but a day spent being fascinating at other people can look different in a month.
sun-sextile-venus: An easy, sociable interval in which you like people and they like you back. Worth spending on friendship specifically: on saying the appreciative thing, on repairing a small tension while it is still small, on letting yourself receive the reinforcement that only a friend can give. You blend readily into a group and are not much interested in standing out, which is precisely why the impression you make holds. It is a poor time to perform a version of yourself for effect, and a good one for improving your actual surroundings, and for settling the financial details of something already under way.
sun-square-venus: An unusually mild square. The dynamic edge goes into seeking out pleasure, beauty and company rather than into conflict, and you will avoid a fight if one is offered. What it exposes, gently, is strain inside your attachments: where indulgence is being taken at somebody else's expense, or where you are waiting passively for something good to arrive rather than going after it. Money spent to gratify a passing whim tends to look foolish later. Little here requires effort, and you are unlikely to feel like making any, so use the ease rather than resenting the drift.
sun-trine-venus: Physically and emotionally this sits well, and it is difficult to take anything grim seriously. Your eye for what is beautiful or well-made is sharper than usual, which makes it a good moment to buy something meant to last rather than something merely wanted. Relationships warm; a difficulty with someone can be smoothed over now because you have no interest in scoring, and they can tell. New attractions are possible, though more often this is simply a good time enjoyed with somebody, without consequence. Spend it in company: alone, the same influence reads as loneliness.
sun-opposition-venus: Relationships come into focus, and you meet yourself through them. What is sound between you and someone stays sound; what has been quietly wrong becomes unstable and shows. That is not a misfortune, it is the awareness the aspect exists to produce. You will notice how much you dislike being alone and how much you rely on someone to think against, and the honest response is to use that rather than deny it: talk to somebody, including about the thing you have been carrying by yourself. Watch your own handling of it more closely than you watch theirs.
sun-conjunction-mars: A strong day for starting something you can carry alone, without waiting on anyone's permission or coordination. Physical energy is high and needs somewhere to go; spent at a desk it turns into itch, then irritability, then a quarrel you did not intend. You want to be recognised as a distinct person, and if that recognition is withheld you will go looking for the argument that provides it. Others may find you disruptive, particularly anyone in charge. The same surplus, unspent, tends to come out as carelessness, so take the machinery and the sharp edges seriously.
sun-sextile-mars: Work goes well and you believe you can do it, which is most of the reason it goes well. Energy and health are usually good, and physical activity is close to a requirement rather than a suggestion; this force has to be used. You can also work with other people without feeling encroached upon, so a shared effort will get further than a solitary one now. You are still assertive, and will hold a position if you have to, but you look for the common ground first. Satisfaction comes from expressing what the group actually wants, not from going off alone.
sun-square-mars: A day for knowing your own motives, because whatever you do not know about them will be acted on anyway. Ego conflicts are likely, often testing a position you took or a claim you made about half a year ago; circumstances go looking for the flaw in your preparation. Energy runs high and impatience with anyone slower is the characteristic failure, especially with people in authority. Find hard physical work for the surplus. If you notice no aggression at all, that is worth more attention, not less: unspent, this force turns inward as accident or illness, or arrives wearing somebody else's face.
sun-trine-mars: Being yourself takes no effort, and the natural mode is to work alone and for your own reasons, not out of hostility but because you would rather not depend on anyone's encouragement. The body wants use; giving it some sharpens the mind rather than tiring it. Since confrontations are coming later in the cycle, spend the calm on knowing what you are actually doing and why — which of your various projects matter, which are drifting, what you are trying to bring to a head. Judge them against your own criteria rather than anyone else's.
sun-opposition-mars: Things come to a head, and it becomes plain whether you have been going about them intelligently. Confrontation is likely; the people opposite may be allies sharpening your position or opponents defending their own, but either way the claim you have staked gets tested, refined, or knocked down. There is a diagnostic in this: whatever makes you angry today is something you have quietly identified with and are defending as if it were your body. Look at what that tells you. Get the hostility genuinely discharged rather than merely swallowed; swallowed, it turns into accident or illness.
sun-conjunction-jupiter: You feel well, and you want more of everything — more experience, more understanding, more room. The appetite is not restlessness; it moves you toward what you want with an unusual confidence of getting it. Good for study, for going somewhere, for anything that widens the frame. The other face of the same energy is arrogance and overreach, and which one you get depends on a fairly simple question: do you believe your growth happens at other people's expense, or through including them? Take on rather more than you would normally, but not very much more, and keep an eye on what you spend.
sun-sextile-jupiter: Traditionally counted as luck, though what it really supplies is the frame of mind that most success comes out of. Things tend to work as planned. You want to belong to something larger than yourself and can work with a group without resenting it, which makes it a good time for meetings, collaborations and anything requiring goodwill to run. Idealism is strong; rather than assuming it will all come right, use the interval to review your actual plans against what you say you are aiming at. Relations with people in authority go well, and you can usually learn something from them.
sun-square-jupiter: A productive square, so long as you keep some discipline in hand. It pushes you to attempt more than your resources strictly cover, which is a fault if you are already exuberant and a gift if you have been playing safe: the same influence produces generosity or extravagance depending on which way you already lean. Friction with other people is likely and mostly winnable, unless you take the high moral ground, which is the characteristic Jupiterian failure. Look properly at the other position and find the ground you share. Compassion is available here too; it is simply harder to reach than certainty.
sun-trine-jupiter: One of the mildest and most agreeable transits, and the risk in it is sleeping through it. Optimism and buoyancy tend to make circumstances fall your way, which looks like luck and is usually the delayed return on something you did earlier. Use the wide view while you have it: this is a rare moment when you can see your life whole and change part of it without the sense of loss that normally makes you cling to things you do not need. Good for travel, for philosophy, for anything that explains how the world hangs together.
sun-opposition-jupiter: Cheerful, expansive, and inclined to think nothing can go wrong, which is pleasant and slightly dangerous. Money goes out easily and confidence runs ahead of the facts, but the same surplus can carry you through something you have never dared before. The characteristic error is instructing people beyond what they asked to hear; even sound advice delivered now tends to arrive as condescension, and anyone above you will notice a manner that outruns your position. Held within bounds, this reads to others as substance rather than swagger, particularly if you are usually the retiring sort. Something is culminating; keep hold of the reins.
sun-conjunction-saturn: Attention swings to duty: the obligations you have taken on, the ones you only think you have taken on, and the ongoing work of telling the two apart. Energy is low but well aimed, and what you finish now tends to outlast what you finish under easier conditions. Old unfinished business resurfaces, and professional matters take precedence. Excellent for organising, planning, imposing order — on your affairs, and if you are not careful on other people too. Loneliness is a common flavour of this and a poor guide. The remedy is work, which is where your weight sits today anyway.
sun-sextile-saturn: An orderly, deliberate frame of mind: you think before you move, you plan at a level that can actually be executed, and abstractions hold no interest. Anything requiring concentration and attention to detail should be done now, and it will be done without loose ends. That seriousness is often noticed by whoever is above you. It is also a good moment to ask advice of someone older, or of anyone whose experience you respect, since you are genuinely willing to hear what the world expects of you. Not a day for pleasure; you are not in the mood and will not miss it.
sun-square-saturn: The question underneath the discomfort is an old one: how much do you owe yourself, and how much do you owe everyone else? The day sets those two against each other. You feel hemmed in, resentful of the routine, aware of a barrier between you and simply being yourself — and other people seem to be standing in the doorway. It is worth asking whether the constraint is real, since assumptions rarely get checked under this influence. Usually the restriction is one you are administering yourself. Discouragement here has a use: it shows exactly where your confidence is thin.
sun-trine-saturn: Discipline without strain. You can point your whole energy at one objective, and there is an unusually close fit between who you are and what you are doing, which makes this a good time to inspect the structures you live inside — your habits, your household, your work — and see how they actually function. Keep it concrete; abstraction is not the strength here. Work done now is thorough and lasts. You are also alert to waste and want to get full use out of what you already have, which makes it a good interval for conserving rather than acquiring.
sun-opposition-saturn: The limits imposed by other people and by circumstance become very visible, and the task is not to be flattened by them. A common form is the sense of a gulf between you and everyone else, and the awkward part is that the gulf is real — there is a point past which people cannot reach each other. That truth is only crushing if you are in the mood to be crushed by it. More practically, your need to express yourself and your need for other people are in open conflict, and neither can be allowed to win outright. Say plainly what you need, and ask the same.
sun-conjunction-uranus: Either you are surprised or you do the surprising, and the second is the healthier version, since the drive underneath is a genuine need to get out from under your own routine. The ordinary shape of your days is not going to satisfy you, and you will act out of character. The function of that is to keep a life from setting; the difficulty is that most of us are married to our routines and experience the interruption as a string of small things going wrong. Plan the departure rather than waiting for it. Unexpressed, this comes out as haste, and haste has consequences.
sun-sextile-uranus: Ordinary life turns interesting without turning alarming. Encounters in the usual round of things carry more insight than usual, and the mind is quick, curious, and impatient to move to the next idea before it has finished admiring the last. Excellent for anything inventive. You are also less tolerant of restriction and less disciplined than usual, which is not much of a loss right now, since what you would do with the freedom matters more than sticking at the grind. You want to be yourself rather than meet expectations, and you let people know it. Use it to change something that has gone static.
sun-square-uranus: Expect the unexpected, and expect some of it to be inconvenient: a plan collapsing, a machine failing, a sudden argument, an abrupt separation. Friction with other people usually runs on restriction, either what they are imposing on you or what you are imposing on them. The impulse underneath is to break up your own routine, and it is far better spent deliberately than left to arrive by accident. Let the restlessness say what it wants; you may find a part of yourself you had been careful not to look at. Unexpressed, this energy turns back on you and makes you careless.
sun-trine-uranus: A good stretch for doing something you have not done and finding out what you make of it. Your perception of your own situation is sharper than usual, and you can see how the pieces connect, which makes any change you make now better aimed. You are frank about who you are, and the liveliness draws people. Favourable for study of the kind that opens something up — science, technique, astrology, anything genuinely new to you — and poor for repetitive drill, which you will not tolerate. Sitting still is not an option; the energy is there to be spent on unfamiliar ground.
sun-opposition-uranus: The surprises arrive through other people. A partner turns restless, or you do, and something in the arrangement that one of you has been quietly enduring stops being endurable; a working relationship may need sudden and awkward revision. Sometimes the disruption comes from a stranger entirely. The function of all of it is to show you that you have been leaving parts of yourself out of your dealings with the world, and that the omission has a cost. Pay attention to what the restlessness is actually asking for. Whether it is practical does not matter yet — first find out what it is.
sun-conjunction-neptune: Two quite different things can happen and it is hard to know in advance which. The first is a marked rise in sensitivity: you read other people accurately, you care more about their situation than your own, and helping someone becomes the natural form of self-expression. Interest in what lies behind ordinary appearances sharpens. The second is the same ego-thinning experienced as fatigue and an inability to face the day, with a strong pull toward somewhere else — daydream at best, evasion at worst. Your body is unusually porous now; treat drink, drugs and even prescriptions with care.
sun-sextile-neptune: The demands of your own ego quieten, which lets more in. You register what people around you need with unusual accuracy and are willing to do something about it, and being asked for help feels like an expression of yourself rather than an imposition. Charitable or unpaid work often attaches itself to this. Meaning matters more than fact today; it is not enough to know what something is. Physical energy is somewhat down, so this is a poor moment to launch anything enormous and a good one to withdraw from the routine and think about what actually matters to you.
sun-square-neptune: Energy is low, perhaps low enough that ordinary demands feel beyond you, and the mood tends toward discouragement. Neither is worth taking seriously as evidence about your life; both are worth taking seriously as instructions to do less. Postpone whatever needs confidence and stamina, because you will not have them, and be sceptical of ambitious plans made under this influence — the goals tend to be unreachable and the disappointment is unnecessary. A sense of futility can also tempt you into indirect tactics, which will not work; you are not clear-headed enough to carry them off, and others may be trying the same on you.
sun-trine-neptune: Idealism surfaces easily and wants somewhere to go. A good interval for solitude, for quiet study of anything metaphysical, and for getting a clearer sense of where you have actually arrived in your life as against where you meant to be. Someone is likely to ask something of you, or you will find yourself working for others with no particular return beyond the satisfaction. A romantic colouring runs through relationships, which is fine as long as it does not persuade you that the people you love are more than human. Sensitivity to the subtler end of things is heightened.
sun-opposition-neptune: Confusion is likely, and so is a genuine enlargement of sympathy; both come from the same lowering of ego pressure. If someone comes at you hard, your instinct will be to slip the confrontation — to withdraw, or to agree without meaning it — because assertion feels pointless. Resist the martyr role and the surrender that follows it, and if you truly cannot stand your ground, postpone the meeting rather than losing it. A poor moment to sign anything or negotiate; you are not clear enough about your own needs. At its best this reads as unusual depth between two people, which will still be there next week.
sun-conjunction-pluto: Nothing stays at the surface. Whatever you touch, you end up genuinely involved in, and the results carry more force than the scale of the day suggests. Practically, it often shows as something broken that has to be repaired, or a situation degraded to the point where it must change radically or end. You may also run into someone attempting to exert unreasonable power over you, quite possibly convinced they are helping. Real Plutonian pressure does not arrive through another person's ego; it is impersonal, and the useful question is what it is dismantling, not who is doing it.
sun-sextile-pluto: You can change things now, including a situation you have put up with for a long time without seeing a way in. Use the leverage for something more than your own convenience — this force works best when it is aimed at improving the whole arrangement, and turns awkward when it is purely self-serving. Excellent for clearing out what has become disordered, literally or otherwise. You will probably have to bring your intentions into line with a group's, which sounds like a concession and usually is not. Depth attracts you: research, psychology, anything that goes to the bottom of a question.
sun-square-pluto: Pressure comes at you from outside and from underneath at the same time, and the way you have been running your life gets tested. The productive response is to let go of the patterns the day's events are showing to be finished; holding them makes everything harder, while releasing them leaves room for something better. Done properly, this feels like a purge. Expect people in authority to demand an accounting, sometimes legitimately and sometimes because power is being enjoyed for its own sake. Machinery and arrangements that were already limping will fail outright. What survives the challenge is what you can build on.
sun-trine-pluto: You want experience with some weight to it, and superficial versions of anything will not hold your attention. Good conditions for investigation of any kind, including of yourself: what actually moves you, what you are looking for, what would have to change for your life to run properly. The transforming energy is unusually available and cooperative, so changes made now are made with less resistance than they would meet at another time. You can also make a considerable impression on someone if you need to — provided the purpose is not ruthless, since force used that way tends to return with interest.
sun-opposition-pluto: Encounters run intense and turn up things about your life you had not understood or had preferred not to. Power struggles are likely, particularly with anyone above you, and you will have to hold your position without becoming domineering, since that starts fights you will lose. Relationships that have been quietly breaking down now have to be brought fully into the open; patching will not do, and only a complete airing makes a new start possible. Objects and arrangements fail and demand real repair. Considerable change is possible now, but not alone — ask for help, and aim it wider than yourself.
sun-conjunction-node: The Sun crosses the axis of your own direction, briefly lighting what you are supposed to be developing and what you have already mastered. Rudhyar read the north node as the point where life is taken in and something new has to be built by effort, and the south as the accomplished, effortless thing you can always fall back on. For a day the difference between the two is unusually easy to see. Notice which one you reached for, and why. Progress along this line is never automatic; it is paid for by exertion, and it repays the exertion generously.
sun-sextile-node: A mild, useful angle on the line of your own development. What you are meant to be growing into is briefly within easy reach — often through ordinary contacts, a conversation, an introduction, a small invitation that fits the direction you have been slow to take. Nothing forces the issue, which is exactly why it is easy to let it pass. The question worth asking is whether today's easy choice belonged to the new faculty you are building or to the old one you already perform well. Both feel fine at the time; only one of them takes you anywhere.
sun-square-node: The two ends of your own axis pull against each other and you cannot satisfy both. On one side the line of least resistance: the thing you do well, have always done well, and can do without thinking. On the other, the work you have not done yet, which is uncomfortable precisely because it is unpractised. Squares of this kind tend to arrive as a situation where the familiar competence is exactly what is not wanted. That is not a punishment. Rudhyar's point about the south node is that we are undone not by our weaknesses but by being ruled by our gifts.
sun-trine-node: An unusually clear view along the line of your own destiny, with none of the pressure that normally comes with seeing it. Effort you have already put into the harder, newer side of yourself shows its return now, and it is worth registering that consciously rather than letting it pass as an ordinary good day. If you have been coasting on old competence instead, the same clarity shows that too, quietly and without much sting. Nothing here compels you. Take stock of which direction the last stretch of your life has actually been facing.
sun-opposition-node: The Sun stands on the far end of your axis, over everything you have already learned to do: inherited talent, practised skill, the performance you can give without preparation. It is a real strength and not the problem. The problem is that ease invites repetition, and repetition is how a gift stops being a resource and starts being a habit that runs you. Watch today for the moment you take the familiar route while telling yourself you had no choice. What you already do well is meant to be the material of the next thing, not a place to live.
sun-conjunction-chiron: The Sun crosses the old injury and lights it, which means you see it plainly for a day rather than through the usual protective haze. Something will press on it — a remark, a situation, an echo — and the first reaction is likely to be sharper than the occasion warrants. That disproportion is the useful signal. Chiron's particular quality is that the wound does not close and yet becomes the source of the help you are qualified to give; you know this territory because you have lived in it. If someone needs exactly that today, you are unusually able to offer it.
sun-sextile-chiron: A gentle contact with the sore place, which usually arrives as an opportunity rather than a jolt: someone asks for the kind of help only experience could have taught you, or offers you the same in a form you can actually accept. Both are the same transit. Taking either is easy now and costs little, which is precisely why it is easy to let the moment pass unremarked. What has hurt you is not only damage; it is also the reason you can recognise it quickly in somebody else. Today that recognition is available without the usual flinch.
sun-square-chiron: Something presses directly on the injury, and the test is what you do with the pain rather than whether you feel it. The two failures are opposite: pretending it does not hurt, and settling into it as an identity, which is more comfortable than it looks and much harder to leave. Chiron is the wound that does not heal, and squares to it insist you decide whether it is going to be a permanent excuse or the material of something useful. Expect the day's events to be smaller than your reaction to them. Take the reaction as data about the wound, not about the day.
sun-trine-chiron: An interval when you can look straight at the old damage without flinching, which does not happen often. Nothing is demanding anything of you, and the wound is simply there, legible, neither denied nor inflamed. That makes it a good time to say something about it out loud, or to do the thing you have long avoided because it touched that place. Your capacity to help someone with the same trouble is at its most available and least effortful now. What is learned here tends to hold, because it was not learned under duress.
sun-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury in somebody else. Someone arrives carrying visibly what you carry quietly, and the encounter can go two ways: you can treat them as the whole problem and stay comfortably out of it, or you can recognise the shape and admit it is familiar. The second is harder and considerably more useful. Oppositions work by putting a thing outside you where it can be seen, and this one puts your particular vulnerability in front of you wearing another face. What you are able to say to them is usually also what you have been unable to say to yourself.
sun-conjunction-mc: The Sun reaches the highest point of your chart and your attention goes with it: ambition, reputation, getting somewhere. Will is the theme, and you have more of it than usual, to the point of refusing compromises that would cost you nothing. Expect dealings with people who hold power, which can go either way — they may back you or they may read your push as a threat. This transit is neither fortunate nor unfortunate in itself; it brings whatever you have been building to the surface, good or bad. Your work will be seen today, so make it worth seeing.
sun-sextile-mc: Quiet confidence rather than display. You are focused on getting somewhere and feel strong enough not to need anyone's endorsement, which means you get on with the work instead of demonstrating that you can do it — and that, ironically, is what tends to attract notice. Any recognition arriving now is deserved, since it can only be based on what you actually did. A good interval for planning your next stretch with a cool head. Home life is not in competition with any of this; you have enough for both, and the sense that nothing must be taken from one to feed the other is part of the ease.
sun-square-mc: A busy, forceful stretch, often with real professional achievement in it, driven entirely by your own objectives. That focus is the strength and the problem: absorbed in your own purposes, you are not especially considerate, and other people notice. Conflict comes either from their reading you as selfish or from goals that genuinely do not fit together. Enlightened self-interest is the right register — pursue what you want, but do not make enemies you did not need to make. If you end up in a dispute, try to see it from outside your own position long enough to find out whether you are right.
sun-trine-mc: You know where you are going and, unusually, you also have the means: the technique, the materials, the patience for detail. Confidence alone achieves nothing and you are aware of it, so the work gets done properly and you take some pride in that. As with the sextile, you feel neither dependent on anyone nor threatened by them, and the resulting steadiness is visible enough that people may look to you to lead. You will accept if you can see how it serves what you are already doing, and decline without rancour if you cannot. Either way the standing you gain is real.
sun-opposition-mc: The Sun sits at the foot of your chart, and attention belongs at home: family, private life, the inner work of finding out what you actually need. This is not the moment to push out into the world, and if you try, the opposition you meet in professional matters can be genuinely demoralising, since you are pushing without your usual weight behind you. Do what must be done and no more. Time spent alone or with the people closest to you is not a retreat; it is where the next move out into the world is prepared and provisioned.
moon-conjunction-sun: Your own new moon, whenever in the calendar month it falls: the point where mind and body are recharged for the cycle ahead. Will, vitality and feeling tend to move together for a few hours, and the usual gap between what you think and what you feel is not much in evidence. That makes it good for anything requiring people to reach a conclusion together, since you can feel the room. If a longer transit has left you depleted, you may find very little here; in that case take the rest, because the whole month tends to be built on this.
moon-sextile-sun: A breathing space. You can take stock of yourself without being swept along by whatever is currently rushing at you, and even if your affairs are not going well, the pressure lets up briefly. Company is good for you now — you can register what other people need without losing sight of your own, which makes you easy to be around whether you are leading or following. Small opportunities tend to arrive from unexpected corners, often through friends. Nothing large is at stake; the value is the pause, and the fact that it is available at all.
moon-square-sun: The ordinary structure of your daily life gets a small shake: home, routine, the people you see without thinking about it. Tensions you carry without examining rise close enough to the surface to be felt as irritability and a lowered tolerance for other people's oddities. Several minor things may reach a small crisis at once, usually in exactly the areas you have been taking for granted. None of it is serious, and all of it is asking for the attention it has not been getting. If your life is genuinely in order, the same energy simply reads as a useful surge.
moon-trine-sun: An easy few hours in which you are in accord with yourself and can do what needs doing without dividing your attention. Energy meets less resistance than usual, and other people pick up on the inward settledness and are drawn to it, which makes this good for anything done in company. You can hold your own interests and a group's at the same time without either being sacrificed. Physically it registers as plain vitality. You may not be driven to produce much — that depends on your temperament rather than the transit — but you will feel well.
moon-opposition-sun: Your personal full moon: energy runs high and wants to be spent, but not smoothly, because different departments of your life are pulling against each other. Home against work, intention against instinct, the part of you that plans against the part that reacts. A good deal can still be done, provided you do not let the internal argument take over the day. Moods are uneven enough to make trouble in close relationships. There is also a characteristic passing attraction to someone quite unlike you, in which the unlikeness is the whole appeal — interesting, and not stable.
moon-conjunction-moon: The start of your emotional month, and whatever you are feeling now tends to set the key for the weeks that follow. Nothing here is inherently good or bad; feeling is simply louder, and objectivity is correspondingly harder to keep in an argument. This is a receptive point in the cycle rather than an assertive one, so things tend to come to you rather than the reverse. Familiar people, places and objects matter more than usual, and the wish to withdraw from anything strange is not avoidance but a genuine need for a few hours of your own ground.
moon-sextile-moon: Feeling runs deep and turns toward what is known: family, old friends, the people and objects that carry your history. Going over old times with someone is exactly the right use of it, and so is doing nothing more strenuous than staying in with something absorbing. What will not satisfy you now is the superficial encounter; you want some actual intimacy in whatever contact you have. If you are in front of a group, the same receptivity works in your favour — you can feel what they need and they can tell, which makes the rapport genuine rather than performed.
moon-square-moon: A brief patch of emotional static, most noticeable at home and with the people closest to you. Real tensions between you and someone will surface, but usually in a form that hides what they are actually about, and this is precisely the wrong moment to go looking, since you are too far inside it to see straight. In a group you will feel your interests and theirs diverging. Poor conditions for anything requiring harmony; usable conditions if your aim is to stir people up about something that has been comfortably ignored.
moon-trine-moon: A settled, restorative interval with a strong sense of being all right. Your inner arrangements are working, and your dealings with other people reflect it without effort. What appeals is the familiar — your own place, your own things, people you have known a long time — and there is no appetite for challenge or novelty, nor any need for one. Comfort matters, though it need not be lavish; what you want is surroundings that feel like they are on your side. With your own needs met, you have plenty left to look after someone else, and doing so steadies you further.
moon-opposition-moon: Moods run deep and strong, and every contact you have shows you something about the effect your emotional state has on other people — which is worth knowing, and not always comfortable. The characteristic difficulty is that no viewpoint but your own is visible right now, so if a relationship snags, the whole fault will appear to lie with the other person. In a group you will feel your interests set against theirs. Try to stand back far enough to watch the feeling rather than only have it; otherwise there will be nothing to learn from afterwards.
moon-conjunction-mercury: For a few hours your reasoning runs coloured by mood, which makes this poor for deciding anything and excellent for finding out how you actually feel about it. Say so while you can — this is one of the easier moments for putting feeling into words, and conversation flows. The characteristic failure is thinking small: trivia acquiring an importance it does not have, chatter absorbing the attention that something real needed. Moods shift quickly and in no predictable direction. Gather information now, including information about yourself, and decide later.
moon-sextile-mercury: The social tempo picks up. You spend the time talking — friends, neighbours, whoever is at hand — about things that concern you all, and it need not be profound to be worth doing; the point is the sense of common ground it leaves behind. Feelings are unusually easy to put into words, so if something is stuck, this is a good moment to take it to a sympathetic ear, and to offer the same. News, letters and calls tend to arrive from every direction. The one risk is passivity: waiting to be contacted rather than making the first move.
moon-square-mercury: Feeling threatens to swamp the reasoning, and what comes out may be so subjective that nobody else can find their way into it. At the same time the need to say something about how you feel is genuine and should not be sat on; a grievance held back now leaks out sideways as small irritating behaviour and makes everything worse. Expect other people to be equally compelled to tell you their side, and expect not to enjoy all of it. Do not resolve disagreement by adopting whichever view is in front of you. Your opinions are in flux; say so instead.
moon-trine-mercury: Feeling and reasoning are in balance, which is rarer than it sounds. You are in touch with your own emotions and can put them into words without the pressure that usually forces the subject, so you can listen to somebody else's trouble properly and be genuinely useful. Sentiment is present without turning maudlin. Family matters or news of your own past may come up and will land well. A good interval for telling people close to you what they actually mean to you, since your words will carry the weight of the feeling behind them rather than obscuring it.
moon-opposition-mercury: Two possibilities, and they look nothing alike. The first is a straight collision between feeling and reason: the fine distinctions you normally make dissolve, people get sorted into categories rather than seen, and old habits of thought — some of them from childhood — quietly take over the controls. Poor conditions for negotiation or for any discussion needing clarity. The second is a genuinely fruitful conversation about your own state, alone or with someone, in which the feelings are unusually legible. The difference lies mostly in whether you can remember that a feeling is a feeling and not a verdict.
moon-conjunction-venus: Warm, sociable and inclined outward. You radiate something people enjoy being near, so this is a good few hours for company, for a gathering, for whatever brings you into pleasant contact with others. Existing affections are strengthened; the transit is too brief to begin anything major on its own, though it may mark the hour when something already indicated begins. Also good for making your surroundings pleasanter, and for having people in. The consistent caution is appetite — for spending, for food, for drink. If you are working to a budget, do the shopping some other day.
moon-sextile-venus: You want to be among the people you are fond of, and the hours generally oblige. Affection accumulates quietly across your various attachments and life feels a little richer for it. If a relationship is under strain from some longer pressure, this offers a breathing space in which the two of you can re-establish contact and perhaps sort something out. Having friends to your own place suits the mood particularly well. The one hazard is the passivity of two receptive planets together: waiting to be brought things, expecting circumstances to look after you, and calling it relaxation.
moon-square-venus: Barely a square at all. The two are sympathetic enough that this mostly registers as an easy, light, sociable stretch in which you find people interesting and are content to be among them. Affection toward those you care about runs strong, along with a wish to look after and protect them — which is the point at which it can go wrong, since protectiveness slides easily into possessiveness and the management of someone else's freedom. Sentiment about the past is heightened and pleasant, but it can crowd out the present. Appetite runs ahead of discipline.
moon-trine-venus: Pleasant feeling flows between you and everyone in range, and there is no particular reason to resist it. Good company, good food, a good time; the qualification is that everything is being taken in rather than put out, so overindulgence is easy and work is unlikely. The exception is any work that makes your surroundings better, which you may genuinely want to do, since you need beauty around you now and will act to get it. In close relationships, feeling moves easily and protectiveness stays the right side of smothering. The maternal end of this pairing is doing the work.
moon-opposition-venus: Pleasant enough, with two things to watch: appetite, and the assumption that other people will supply what you want without your asking. The main effect is a wish for contact with some intensity behind it. You want to be genuinely involved with someone and you do not much mind whether the involvement is smooth — feeling and exchange are what you are after. So relations with those closest to you may be warm or rough, and even the rough version usually does more good than harm now, since it lets out what has been accumulating. Extravagance follows the same impulse.
moon-conjunction-mars: A short-lived irritability that distorts scale: you will defend the trivial as fiercely as the important because you cannot readily tell them apart. Poor timing for any conversation that actually matters to you, since your equilibrium is not reliable, though you certainly will not back down if pushed unfairly. Watch for haste — action taken now tends to lack foresight, and you may attract quarrelsome people without noticing the charge you are carrying. Under control, the same force is genuinely useful: you can take initiatives that would be difficult at other times and push through obstacles that usually hold.
moon-sextile-mars: Courage and self-reliance run higher than usual, and you can work alone or with others provided you are given some independence or something to lead. You will probably get it. Working with people, you can make your aims feel like theirs, so they come along willingly. Challenged, you argue your case with real conviction and without needing to wound anyone, which earns respect even from those who disagree. You say where you stand and leave no doubt about it. In personal matters you are drawn to people with the courage of their own convictions; you attract what you respect.
moon-square-mars: Irritability, haste and disputes nobody needed. The task for a few hours is to let off steam without wrecking anything, which is complicated by the fact that you have both real grievances worth expressing and minor annoyances that are not — and there is a strong pull toward the annoyance precisely because the real grievance is harder to face. If you are already feeling low about yourself, expect to read ordinary things as attacks, or to attract people who seem to be attacking. Physical carelessness is likelier than usual; domestic accidents and sharp objects deserve genuine attention.
moon-trine-mars: You can assert yourself cleanly, hold ground where you need to, and take the first step in reaching out to someone. Speech is direct and forceful without giving offence, which others tend to respect. This works particularly well leading a group: you can see what is needed and bring people round to it. There is an inner readiness that others pick up on, as if you were about to move. Energy is high and wants physical use. Projects begun now are begun with genuine impetus, though the transit is short — without other support, the risk is a strong start and nothing after it.
moon-opposition-mars: Emotionally excitable and quick to take offence, with far less patience than usual for other people's particularities. You may be contentious enough to need no provocation at all, so watch for argument entered into for its own sake. Real anger, by contrast, should be discharged rather than held. Sudden movements and impulsive action make this a poor few hours for anything requiring care. Domestic life is unlikely to be peaceful, and if trouble surfaces at home it is almost certainly something that has been simmering for a long time — worth addressing, but not right now.
moon-conjunction-jupiter: A brief spell of good feeling and easy generosity. You are not much bothered by small provocations and can absorb behaviour that would ordinarily land badly — though you will probably not have to, since this influence does not draw that out of people. What you put out comes back: kindness, support, the sense of being looked after. It can also turn your attention to the larger questions, though by way of the heart rather than the intellect; explanations will not satisfy you now. Anything involving the public or a large group tends to go well, because the rapport is genuinely felt.
moon-sextile-jupiter: Comfortable and congenial, and best spent with people you already know well and have some history with, though you are open to new company too. You make it plain that you care what happens to those around you and would help if it came to that, and the feeling is generally returned; the note of the hours is mutual support and belonging. Good for anything done as a group, since everybody genuinely stands to gain. Also useful if you need to persuade or represent, because you understand what the people in front of you actually want.
moon-square-jupiter: Mostly benign: benevolent, generous, and turned toward the larger view. The petty details that make daily life smaller than it should be are perfectly visible to you and simply seem not worth the attention. Optimism runs high, and thought drifts toward religion, philosophy, whatever takes in life as a whole. This is also where it can go wrong, since the same expansiveness produces self-righteousness — not necessarily conscious, but audible in the phrasing and unmistakable to everyone else. If people suddenly seem put off, that is the reason. Watch their reactions, then examine your own tone.
moon-trine-jupiter: A pity it is so brief, because the sense of well-being is real. You feel warm toward the people around you and willing to give whatever is needed, and you get back what you put out. Cheerful, positive company tends to gather. This is not a refusal to see that the world contains trouble; it is a genuine sense of belonging among others, and a corresponding feeling that helping someone helps you. Concern extends beyond your immediate circle, though the transit is far too short to start anything large. The same impulse turns you toward the meaning of things, felt rather than argued.
moon-opposition-jupiter: Generous, but only on your own initiative. Appeal to your sense of duty and you will not respond; leave you unencumbered and you will behave better than anyone had a right to expect. The drive here is toward personal freedom, and the more anyone tries to hold you to a line, the harder you pull the other way. The same applies at home: possessiveness from a partner will meet resistance, and a dispute can grow out of nothing but your insistence on room. On another level this can arrive as spiritual restlessness, a questioning of what you are actually for. Worth following.
moon-conjunction-saturn: Feelings get kept in, and loneliness or a flat pessimism comes with them. The important thing to know is that life looks considerably worse under this than it is, so do not treat the mood as evidence. Domestic dissatisfaction is common — a sense that home is not providing what it should, part of a wider feeling of going unsupported, which may or may not be true. Underneath is usually either being cut off from your feelings or finding them too unpleasant to hold. Old guilt can surface, especially near anyone who plays on it. Decide nothing about your emotional life now.
moon-sextile-saturn: A quiet, inward mood that is not low, just unfrivolous. You want your own company, or serious company, and conversation about something that matters. This is a natural moment to consult someone older, or anyone whose vantage point you respect, since you are genuinely willing to hear it. Emotional need and obligation sit in reasonable balance: you are aware of what you feel without being run by it. You are careful and economical in whatever you handle, and the work you do now will not have to be done again. Looking after someone else may fall to you, and will suit you.
moon-square-saturn: A short depression: lonely, out of reach, sometimes accompanied by a distinct conviction that nobody cares for you, whether or not there is any evidence. The crucial point is that these perceptions do not reflect the situation, however convincing they feel. Relating to anyone is unusually hard — you are either caught in your own negativity or too numb to register what is being sent to you, which produces genuine misunderstandings. A poor time to enter anything emotionally delicate. Watch particularly for the habit of turning on yourself, and for dwelling on old failures. The perspective is distorted, not accurate.
moon-trine-saturn: Feeling stays under control without being suppressed, which lets you take a sober and realistic view of your situation. There is patience here and a reserve of strength, a sense that you could stand alone against whatever came — and nothing needs to come for that to be worth having. You will not talk about your feelings to just anyone, but you do not dodge them in yourself, and going off alone to think about where you have got to is a natural use of the hours. The past pulls; old answers appeal; they will probably still work.
moon-opposition-saturn: A brief but disruptive isolation, in which it seems there is no one you could possibly reach. The trap is that it tends to be self-fulfilling: without meaning to, you signal that you would rather be left alone, and people oblige, which confirms the mood. Disappointments register far more strongly than encouragement, so the descent can happen over nothing at all. The right response is to do nothing — take no decisions, draw no conclusions, and let it pass, which it will shortly. You may need to explain afterwards that you were simply in a bad mood; most people know how that works.
moon-conjunction-uranus: Impulsive, quick-changing, and impatient with the ordinary shape of the day. Your moods can surprise you as much as anyone else, and you may find yourself alongside someone in the same state. Anything requiring sustained concentration will either not get done or get done badly, so let that go. If someone tries to hold you to your obligations you are unlikely to take it well. The real hazard is proportion: this lasts hours, and an action taken in it can last considerably longer. Sometimes what comes out is exactly what needed to come out, and clears the air.
moon-sextile-uranus: A pleasant restlessness — the wish for something to happen, without any real appetite for damage. You may want to shake the people around you out of their settledness, or, if you are not conscious of wanting that, find someone arriving to do it for you. Stimulating company is what appeals. At home you are not willing to accept things exactly as they are and may rearrange something, if only for the novelty. An unexpected friend, or an old one resurfacing, is a characteristic form of this. The appetite extends to ideas: you want to encounter a way of thinking you have not met.
moon-square-uranus: Contrariness, mostly. You are inclined to reject a suggestion because of who made it, and to be impatient with any duty that stands between you and doing something different. The craving for excitement is strong enough to produce behaviour you would not consider in a level mood, which for some people is liberating and for others is simply too much. Underneath is a genuine emotional unrest that unsettles you and everyone making demands on you. Remember how brief this is before rearranging anything permanent. Some people meet it entirely from outside, as upsetting news or an erratic arrival.
moon-trine-uranus: You want something other than the usual, and can have it without wrecking anything. Unfamiliar people appeal, or familiar people in unfamiliar surroundings; the impulsiveness here makes you feel more alive rather than making you foolish. Quietly, the same energy is good for making an overdue change at home. It may look abrupt from outside, but it will hold, and the people around you will accept it. In front of a group you will argue for change and may find yourself leading it — bearing in mind that this transit supplies the impulse and not the stamina to see it through.
moon-opposition-uranus: Excitable and prone to conclusions the evidence does not support, particularly about anything emotional, which makes this a poor few hours for a decisive move. You want stimulation and may attract people quite unlike your usual company — unsettling, and answering a real need. In existing relationships you can set something off without intending to: not picking a fight, but stirring feeling until one starts. Any restriction, however reasonable, will meet an immediate impulse to break it, and any firmly stated view will attract disagreement for its own sake. Reacting for the sake of reacting is the main thing to catch.
moon-conjunction-neptune: Subtle but not weak. Your sensitivity to the atmosphere around you rises sharply and you absorb the mood of whoever you are with, which makes the choice of company matter more than usual — a negative person unwilling to look at their own state will simply drain you. Fantasy is unusually available; you may want to sit and drift, and there is nothing wrong with that. Words come out imprecise, so communication may not land as intended. Alcohol and drugs are genuinely risky now, since the usual sense of how much is enough is not working. Watch for self-deception.
moon-sextile-neptune: Acutely tuned to other people's moods, which is useful and expensive: destructive company will exhaust you, and time with people you are devoted to will not. This is one of the influences that produces real selflessness — genuine care for someone with no accounting attached, and none of the martyrdom that usually accompanies it. Charitable work of any kind fits. Daydreaming is strong and worth attending to rather than dismissing; the fantasies mean something even if they cannot be taken at face value. Mystical and psychic interests sharpen, and insight arrives without being pursued.
moon-square-neptune: A dreamy, unfocused stretch in which what you imagine outweighs what is in front of you. In the mild version this is harmless daydreaming. In the less mild version you feel entirely in touch with the situation while being thoroughly wrong about it, which is why this is a poor moment for decisions or for anything requiring clear sight. Subconscious material runs strong — old habits, inherited prejudices, positions formed in childhood — and colours everything. Perception may be genuinely heightened, but nothing seen now should be taken at face value. If drink or drugs are a problem for you, take particular care.
moon-trine-neptune: The imagination opens and the day may go largely on daydream, which is a reasonable use of it — the spirit does need refreshing, and this is unusually good material for anything creative. Just keep hold of the line between what you are imagining and what is actually there. Sympathy runs deep and accurate: you can put yourself in someone's position and know precisely how it feels, and you want to help without calculating what it costs. The same porousness means you take on the moods around you, so avoid anyone in a bad state who is not open to being helped out of it.
moon-opposition-neptune: Strange moods, and impressions that feel significant without being reliable. You may sense something vague and troubling about a person or a situation and be unable to tell whether you are perceiving accurately or manufacturing suspicion. Misunderstandings are likely, usually of the kind where you feel criticised or disliked on almost no evidence. What is actually happening is that old complexes have taken over the machinery of perception, so you are reacting to the process rather than to the event. Feelings of guilt or inadequacy may arrive for no reason. Avoid drink; watch for allergic reactions to what you consume.
moon-conjunction-pluto: Emotional material comes up from a considerable depth, which makes this excellent for any kind of honest self-examination, formally or in conversation with someone. Feelings may be strong enough to remove your sense of proportion entirely; do not take the mood at face value, though it probably stands for something that genuinely matters. A characteristic form is obsession — a thought that will not leave and seems to be running you, which usually goes when the transit does. Intimacy is intense. Watch for the games in which two people manage each other's feelings for leverage, and for possessiveness and jealousy.
moon-sextile-pluto: Feeling runs deep and refuses the superficial version of anything. With people close to you, you want to know what is actually between you, and buried material in a relationship tends to surface in a manageable form — which is therapeutic, since what has been quietly weakening the connection gets released. Curiosity turns toward the hidden: mysteries of any kind, psychology, the occult. Domestically, the impulse is to clear out, repair and reorganise. The one caution is that even this mild contact can produce a fixed idea; if you notice yourself unable to let something go, that fixation is worth investigating.
moon-square-pluto: Compulsion is close to the surface. Feelings pick up enough momentum that sudden urges become hard to refuse, particularly if you have been sitting on them, and the transit is much easier if you are honest with yourself about what you feel. On the useful side, emotional self-examination is unusually effective now, and an encounter with someone may force a confrontation you would not have arranged and will benefit from. The negative form is a power struggle conducted through feeling — guilt, jealousy, the manipulation of somebody into what they do not want — with either of you playing either part.
moon-trine-pluto: Feeling is intensified and sensitivity along with it, so nothing registers lightly, yours or anyone else's. The mood is serious and wants encounters with some depth to them. Intimacy can be substantially enriched, because you can get underneath the surface exchanges that had quietly been separating you from someone. Even at this mild angle there is a pull toward fixation — one idea or mood taking charge — so let the feelings move without either running your life or being shut away. People you meet now may carry the same intensity, which is rewarding and tiring. Life is asking for some passion; it is worth supplying.
moon-opposition-pluto: Emotions run deep and not necessarily in harmony, within you and between you and anyone you are closely involved with. Expect intense encounters. The oldest and most powerful material in you is influencing what you do, and acting on impulse is hard to avoid; guilt, jealousy, possessiveness or the plain wish to control someone's feelings may take hold of you, or arrive through someone else. Whatever conflict occurs will reveal a great deal about both of you, provided you can look at it calmly afterwards. Seeing clearly now is not really possible — but a feeling that insists on being expressed should be.
moon-conjunction-node: The Moon crosses the axis of your own direction, and since the Moon is the planet of habit, this is where habit and destiny briefly occupy the same degree. What you feel drawn toward now is worth noticing precisely because it will feel natural. Rudhyar's distinction is the useful one: one end of this axis is the practised, effortless thing you have already mastered, the other is the work you have not done yet. Instinct will reach for the first. That is not wrong, but it is worth knowing which one your comfort is pointing at.
moon-sextile-node: A mild, feeling-level contact with the line of your own development. Something in the direction you have been slow to take becomes briefly attractive rather than daunting — often through a person, a domestic arrangement, an ordinary invitation that happens to point the right way. Nothing insists, which is why it is easy to let it drift past. The useful question for a few hours is simply which of your instincts belong to what you are building and which belong to what you already know how to do. Both feel like home; only one of them is new ground.
moon-square-node: Your habits and your direction pull against each other for a few hours, and the friction shows up emotionally: a reluctance, a pull toward the familiar exactly where something unfamiliar is being asked. Domestic and family attachments often carry this, since they are where our most practised responses live. Rudhyar's point about the far end of this axis holds here — an inherited gift or an old comfort is not the enemy, but being ruled by it is. Notice where you reach for the reliable feeling instead of the required one. That reaching is the whole content of the transit.
moon-trine-node: An easy emotional view along the line of your own development, with nothing demanding anything of you. Feeling and direction agree for a few hours, which is pleasant and mildly informative: what you are drawn to now is likely to be genuinely yours rather than merely habitual. If you have been putting effort into the newer, less practised side of yourself, some of the return on that shows up as plain contentment. If you have been coasting, the same clarity registers, without much sting. Take stock of which way the recent stretch of your life has actually been facing.
moon-opposition-node: The Moon stands over the accumulated end of your axis: inheritance, memory, the responses you learned before you could examine them. There is real comfort here and no reason to refuse it — this is the part of you that already knows how. The catch is that comfort invites repetition, and repetition is how a strength quietly turns into the thing that runs you. Watch for the moment you fall back on a familiar feeling and call it a decision. What you already carry is meant to feed the next stretch of your life, not to substitute for it.
moon-conjunction-chiron: A mood touches the old injury and lights it briefly. Something small will land disproportionately — a remark, a family echo, a situation that resembles an older one — and the size of the reaction tells you more than the occasion does. It usually comes up in a domestic or familial register, since that is where the wound was generally made. Nothing has to be resolved in a few hours. What is available is a clear look at the shape of it, and a rare readiness to say something about it to someone who would understand.
moon-sextile-chiron: A soft contact with the sore place. Someone is likely to need exactly the kind of sympathy your own experience qualifies you for, or to offer you the same in a form you can actually take — which is harder than it sounds and briefly easier now. The mood is receptive rather than defended, so what has hurt you is available to be talked about instead of managed. Nothing forces the issue and it would be easy to let the hours pass without using them. That is usually what happens, and it is a small waste.
moon-square-chiron: Something presses on the wound and the feeling arrives out of proportion to the cause. The two easy responses are both worth resisting: denying that it hurt, and settling into the hurt as a place to stay, which is more comfortable than it looks. Family and domestic matters often carry this, and an old pattern may be reactivated by something quite small. Take the intensity as information about the injury rather than about the person in front of you, and hold off on any conclusion until the mood has passed, which will not take long.
moon-trine-chiron: A rare few hours in which the old damage can be felt without being defended against. Nothing is pressing on it; it is simply legible. That makes this a good moment to say something out loud that you normally route around, or to be with someone in the same difficulty, since your sympathy is both accurate and unforced. What Chiron does not do is close; what it does is become useful, and this is the angle at which that transformation costs the least. What you understand now tends to stay understood, because it was not learned under pressure.
moon-opposition-chiron: You meet the wound in someone else. Somebody arrives carrying openly what you carry quietly, and the encounter can go either way: you can treat their trouble as entirely theirs and stay out of it, or recognise the shape and admit it is familiar. Feeling runs strong enough that the recognition, if it comes, will not be merely intellectual. What you find yourself able to say to them is usually the thing you have not managed to say to yourself. Take note of it afterwards, when the intensity has dropped and you can hear it.
moon-conjunction-mc: Feeling becomes publicly visible, which can go two ways. Usefully, you can sense the mood of a group and speak to what actually concerns them, which is valuable if you are leading anything or presenting to anyone. Unhelpfully, the same permeability leaves you feeling exposed, and the impulse is then to get out of view altogether, which is a reasonable thing to do if that is how it lands. What is not favoured is thinking and deciding: your mind is being run by personal preoccupation, protective habit and immediate need, none of which see very far.
moon-sextile-mc: Feeling runs unusually rich, with a real appetite for knowing yourself and for taking things in through the emotions rather than around them. Work requiring detachment will not appeal and is best deferred; whatever you do now, you will want to be involved in. The counterweight is that reactions run on habit — you are drawn to the familiar and inclined to avoid what you are not used to, and you may project more of yourself onto other people than you intended. Good for anything public-facing, where feeling the room is most of the job.
moon-square-mc: Moods shift fast enough to blur your sense of where you are going, and this bites hardest if your goals were set without much reference to what you actually need. Dissatisfaction with your progress is common, or the sense that whatever you achieve, something is still missing; tension at home often accompanies it. All of it points at one question: which of your working life and your private life genuinely comes first, and which should. There is no standard answer. Handled honestly, the same transit feels remarkably whole, with inner and outer needs met at once.
moon-trine-mc: Private needs and working life sit in unusual balance, with much less of the sense that two halves of you are competing for the whole. Feeling and intention point the same way, so you can go about your business as one person. That richness of feeling also makes you good with others: you sense what they need and can move them without manipulating them. Alternatively, and just as validly, it may make you want to withdraw into your own circle and be quiet. That is not retreat, it is recharging, and the impulse is worth obeying.
moon-opposition-mc: The Moon reaches the foot of your chart and the pull is inward and homeward. You want your own ground, your own people, company you need not perform for. A poor few hours for display, presentation, or showing anyone what you can do; if you must deal with someone, bring them onto your own territory and it will go considerably better. What the time is genuinely good for is finding out how you feel about things, since your feelings are strong enough now that you cannot easily talk yourself past them.
mercury-conjunction-sun: The mind sharpens and wants out. You are unusually clear about what you are actually trying to do and unusually able to say it, which makes this a good moment to put your case, even against resistance — you will hold your ground, and people tend to respect that whether or not they agree. The day fills with calls, messages and conversations, most of which you start. The two things to guard are the ones that come with any conjunction: talking so continuously that nothing gets back in, and mistaking your own view for the whole picture. Restless enough that travel suits it.
mercury-sextile-sun: Busy and mentally alive, with curiosity turned up: even the ordinary parts of the day look like they might contain something worth knowing. Frequently one of those stretches where the phone never stops and everyone seems to want you at once. Say plainly where you stand on things — the directness is what earns you standing now, and hedging wastes the transit. Particularly good for any discussion where a group has to arrive at a decision together, or where you have to report back on something you have been doing. Short journeys, even trivial ones, tend to be worth making.
mercury-square-sun: Not a difficult square, just a fast one: paperwork, correspondence and meetings, mostly running smoothly. The failure mode is speaking from ego rather than from the point. Make the statement and leave it; it carries enough force on its own, and turning it into a contest will attract someone equally inclined and stop the exchange dead. Difficulty with people in authority is the usual form of that. The other hazard is tempo — if the day accelerates past your capacity you get nervous, and nervous means careless. It is not that you stop caring, it is that you are vibrating too fast to be accurate.
mercury-trine-sun: Clear-headed, with a good grasp of what you want in any given situation and the ability to state it. Especially good for anything requiring an overview rather than detail. Spend it clearing the backlog: letters, calls, the paperwork that has been accumulating. Negotiations and business discussions go well because you can spell out the requirements exactly, and nobody will later be able to claim they were not told. It is also a good time to organise something, or someone, or a group. Your own needs and other people's balance easily now, and they can tell they are getting a fair hearing.
mercury-opposition-sun: Ideas and messages flow, and so, potentially, does conflict — this is where a difference of will gets conducted in words. Something feels urgent to say and hard to hold back, and once said may meet real opposition. Compromise is available but rarely direct; a genuinely neutral third party often does more than another round between the two of you. What you can rely on is that the message will land. Communication is clear here, if not harmonious. Negotiations begun now may not conclude; use the exchange to find out exactly where everybody stands and let the settling happen later.
