mercury-conjunction-moon: The best conditions of the month for saying how you feel, and among the worst for cool reasoning. You may be perfectly capable of logic, but logic will not carry what you actually want to convey, and your thinking is coloured enough by mood that objectivity is a stretch. If you are calm, you become an unusually good listener — receptive not just to words but to the state behind them, so that you follow someone by feeling with them. If you are already upset, the same permeability means no viewpoint but your own gets through, and you will be difficult company.
mercury-sextile-moon: You can feel the mood of whoever you are talking to and shape what you say to fit it, without having to be dishonest about the content — you are simply more aware than usual of the feeling that runs underneath speech. That is particularly useful in front of a group, and this is a good moment to persuade one, provided what you are saying is true; people pick up the gap between the words and the intent immediately at this angle. The same faculty turns inward: a good time to check what your own state actually is, or to take a stuck problem to somebody.
mercury-square-moon: You will at least know what you feel about everything that comes up, which is not the same as enjoying it. Thinking runs heavily coloured by feeling, and what you say may be shaped by old compulsions more than by the present situation. Patterns from long ago reactivate: habits of speech, inherited attitudes, positions you were taught rather than tested. It is worth asking of each one whether you have ever found it true yourself. Arguments with the people who carry your projections are common. You cannot dismantle all of it in a day, but this is a reasonable day to start.
mercury-trine-moon: The ordinary, unexamined part of your life gets more interesting, mostly because you are putting more of yourself into it. Tempo picks up without scattering. You are in closer contact with your own feelings than usual and show it in how you deal with people, which makes talking about something personal easier than it normally is. You would rather listen than lead the conversation, and that shows: people register the interest as genuine and understand you are not playing a game with them. Nothing large happens; the day is simply inhabited rather than got through.
mercury-opposition-moon: Emotional material keeps getting into your communication and colouring it. Some of that is worth having — better to let the energy behind a compulsion out into the open than to keep transmitting it in code — but you may also say something you did not intend. The subtler problem is that everything you say is being shaped by patterns of speech and thought laid down long before now, and today those come out as messages that do not quite fit the moment. Try to hear the sentence before you use it. If you are already under strain, take particular care.
mercury-conjunction-mercury: Your mind returns to its own starting point and works cleanly. Ideas that are usually hard to pin down can be formulated and said so that other people follow them, and you can also follow somebody else's complicated argument — and see the holes in it, which makes you hard to sell anything to. Curiosity is up; unfamiliar material and puzzles are attractive, so this is a good moment to begin studying something. The unusual gift here is detachment: subjects normally too charged to discuss can be discussed now, because for once you can hold them at arm's length.
mercury-sextile-mercury: Good conditions for detail. Your mind is clear enough to handle intricate work, figures, close reading — the sort of task where accuracy matters more than scope. Whether you actually want to do it is a separate question and depends on your temperament; some people get restless at this angle and others finally get the routine under control. The clarity also helps with any complicated explanation you have to give somebody. A contract or arrangement settled now tends to hold up, largely because you will not have left anything important out of it.
mercury-square-mercury: A challenge to something you believe, which is worth treating as useful rather than as an attack. Communication is heavy — conversations, messages, exchanges — and the right use of it is to try your ideas out and watch what comes back. If you are committed enough to a position that you cannot bear to see it tested, some of the reactions will sting; but corrections are cheap now and expensive later, once you have built more on top of it. Disagreement does not mean you are wrong. It means the position is worth re-examining. If compromise proves impossible, postpone rather than force it.
mercury-trine-mercury: Mental equilibrium: clear, precise, unhurried thinking, and a good moment for planning or for turning something over properly. Curiosity is roused and wants feeding — reading, an exhibition, a lecture, a conversation that hands you an idea you did not have. Getting a point across works well, chiefly because your motive is to communicate rather than to win; you are unusually interested in the facts for their own sake. If there is something important you have been meaning to say to someone, this is the day for it. Local travel, especially with something new at the end of it, suits the influence.
mercury-opposition-mercury: Ideas and conversations multiply, and if you are out among people you will have several that matter. Even alone, the mind runs hard, and it is well suited to reviewing the past as well as planning ahead — though the transit favours exchange over solitary thinking, so try your ideas on somebody. What comes back is the value. The risk is defending every opinion as though it were load-bearing, which costs you exactly the flexibility this angle is for. Watch also for the mind racing: nervous tension here produces sloppy reasoning and remarks you have to walk back.
mercury-conjunction-venus: Thought turns toward beauty and toward affection, which is a pleasant combination and a genuinely useful one. Something can be said now that is normally hard to say — that you love someone, or what you actually think about how things stand between you. Art, music and writing land more fully than usual, because for a while the line between thinking and feeling is thin: you may experience an idea emotionally or state an emotion precisely. On a more abstract level you may catch the pattern running through a stretch of your experience and see how the pieces have been connected all along.
mercury-sextile-venus: A light influence, easily missed. It turns the mind toward pleasant uses of itself — reading for its own sake, a concert or exhibition, talking with people you like about nothing much. That may look inconsequential, and it is not: days like this are what the harder ones are for. It also puts you in touch with the affection actually present in your life, which is worth knowing about. Words for feelings come more easily than usual, so you may say something you are normally too shy or too imprecise to manage. Put beauty within reach if you can.
mercury-square-venus: Little aggression in this, and generally good feeling, with the one point of tension in your close relationships. The right use of it is a conversation with someone about how things actually stand between you. You may find you agree on less than you assumed. Approached in a spirit of give and take, that is easily worked into a functioning arrangement; approached from righteousness, it can shut communication down for a long time. Elsewhere the day is mild and mildly indulgent. Avoid shops selling things you want and cannot afford, and take care not to concede a point that actually matters just to keep the peace.
mercury-trine-venus: Agreeable and easy: you feel well disposed toward almost everyone and are careful not to say anything that would spoil it. That makes this a good day for smoothing over whatever has been rubbing in a relationship, and a good day to meet people, since the version of you on offer is the pleasant one. You are in tune with what you feel and speak with some sensitivity. Aesthetic appreciation is strong — you want beauty around you and will avoid the noisy and the ugly. Talking about affection, ordinarily awkward, is unusually available; embarrassment is much less of an obstacle.
mercury-opposition-venus: This can pass almost unnoticed unless you are watching for it: a slight lift, a mind drawn to lighter subjects, people who seem more agreeable than usual, several pleasant conversations, possibly something sociable that turns out well. In personal matters you are inclined to meet the other person halfway and not much inclined to fight, which is excellent for a disagreement that has gone on too long and risky where the issue genuinely matters — you may concede something now and mind about it later. Poor conditions for demanding mental work; you would rather enjoy yourself, and you will change the subject if it gets heavy.
mercury-conjunction-mars: A considerable supply of mental energy: you can work with your mind far longer than usual and get a great deal done. You also feel competitive about ideas, enjoy arguing, and will state and defend a position with real skill. The other face of that is a readiness to fight over nothing. Small things set you off, you defend positions you have no stake in, and the underlying trouble is that your ego has attached itself to everything you think and say, so that a disagreement registers as an attack. Telling the necessary defence from the reflexive one is the whole task here.
mercury-sextile-mars: A hard-working day, provided the work is yours. You will drive a project you care about a long way and resent effort spent purely on someone else's behalf. Take any opening to show initiative; you may end up directing something. Working alongside others may frustrate you simply because you have more energy than they do — nothing to do with their reliability. Expect to have to convince someone of something, more presentation than argument. Push back at you and you will defend your ground vigorously and successfully, and be respected for it rather than resented.
mercury-square-mars: Touchy, and inclined to hear any remark as a challenge — obviously enough that people may start stepping around you. Anyone who does cross you will hear about it in detail. The milder version is simply having to defend a position, which this transit helps with. What makes it difficult is the habit of identifying yourself with what you think, so that a dispute over an idea feels like a threat to your existence. Do not go looking for the fight or manufacture the issue. You may also meet it from the other side, in someone defensive — worth asking what signal drew them.
mercury-trine-mars: Good conditions for hard mental work. Energy is up, obstacles read as challenges rather than as reasons to stop, and you are willing to go at a difficult problem until it gives. You also want to say what you think — not to start anything, just to get it into the open — and you are confident enough about it not to mind who hears. That makes this a strong day for anything that depends on impressing someone with your competence, asking for what you are owed included. Public speaking goes better than usual; stage fright is much reduced. Plans made now are bolder than your average.
mercury-opposition-mars: Some caution is called for, chiefly because you will not naturally supply any. You feel like telling people exactly what you think of them, flattering or not, and the combative mood may provoke others into starting something. Often the aggression is buried well enough that the only evidence is how many people seem to be picking fights with you: you may look entirely innocent, including to a neutral observer, while transmitting hostility at a level nobody is consciously reading. Better to know you are angry than not. Used well, this is a good moment for honest feedback about your work — if you actually want to hear it.
mercury-conjunction-jupiter: The frame widens. Whatever you are thinking about, you want to see it whole, and you are unusually willing to take in information that does not fit what you already believe — other viewpoints read as enlargements rather than threats, including ones you would ordinarily bristle at. That breadth makes you good at planning now: where other people see a mess, you can see the pattern. Useful for organising anything, for commerce, and for arranging people so their work fits together. You may find the right course before you can explain why it is right; the reasoning catches up later.
mercury-sextile-jupiter: Attention lifts to the larger questions. Meeting the day's demands does not satisfy you; you want to know how they fit into something. Fortunately you can see the shape of your own life fairly clearly just now, and the mind is alert to possibilities without losing precision. Being clear about what you actually want makes dealings with other people go better, so this is a favourable interval for negotiations, contracts, commercial arrangements and anything legal. Generosity is part of the mechanism: you recognise that you get what you want most efficiently by helping other people get what they need.
mercury-square-jupiter: Optimistic and expansive, with a real gift right now for thinking in large structures and long horizons. Good for setting goals, reviewing existing ones and for most commercial dealings, since you can see how a thing will play out. The weakness is exactly proportional: you are careless with detail and inclined to discard whatever does not fit the grand shape, and in conversation you may take a tone that sets people against you without your noticing. Plan carefully anyway. Every structure is made of parts, and one loose part will bring down a design that was otherwise sound.
mercury-trine-jupiter: Excellent for planning, for designing how something should be organised, and for mental work generally — with the standing Mercury–Jupiter caveat that you will take the easy route through a hard problem if one is available. Supply your own discipline and the day becomes genuinely creative. Business, contracts, buying and selling all go well, though not by luck: what actually happens is that your mind opens far enough to register the possibilities in a situation, most of it below the level of conscious noticing, and you act accordingly. The optimism is well-founded, and being well-founded, it works.
mercury-opposition-jupiter: One of the more agreeable oppositions — good feeling, a positive outlook, and real usefulness for conferences, negotiations, planning and discussion, provided you are careful. As with every Mercury–Jupiter contact, you see the whole more clearly than the parts, and precision about detail is the first thing to go. Read the small print, all of it, and check the angles you have decided are beneath the concerns of the day. In conversation, avoid the note of certainty; stay open enough to move. You may enjoy a friendly intellectual joust, and the other person may not experience it as friendly.
mercury-conjunction-saturn: Caution, precision and a strong sense of the distinctions between things — which cuts both ways, since it can make it hard to see anything but the parts, and inclines you to notice what is wrong with people rather than what is right. Sometimes this coincides with a farewell, a departure that leaves a mark for a while. Used well, the same faculty gives real intellectual exactness: if you have work needing rigorous thought and detailed planning, particularly detail on a structure you have already sketched, do it now. Poor for anything requiring breadth. Your critical eye is sharp — use it to correct rather than to undermine.
mercury-sextile-saturn: A good moment to look around critically and see what needs fixing. You register the flaws clearly without being swamped by them, and the interest is in making something better rather than in complaining about it. The mood is serious without being low, and unfrivolous. Teaching and being taught both suit it: you respect people with more experience and are inclined to consult them, and someone may come to you in the same spirit. Careful, exacting work goes well. Anything requiring scope and vision does not; the attention is on the parts, not the pattern.
mercury-square-saturn: Excellent for demanding mental work and disciplined thinking — the critical faculty is sharp and the standards high. Communication is another matter: either you will not be understood, or you will come across more negatively than you intended, which makes this a poor time for negotiations or anything that depends on the impression you leave. Postpone the contact. The same critical turn can settle into pessimism, and there is a pull toward withdrawal, toward ending something rather than repairing it. The point to hold onto is that you are being shown the flaws and not the whole; the imperfections are real, and they are not all there is.
mercury-trine-saturn: Serious thinking, practical concerns, and no appetite for the trivial — not from low spirits, simply from a preference for weight. The mind works steadily and will stay with a problem until every part of it is solved. You are unusually good with detail now, as attentive to the small pieces as to the structure they add up to, so the work you do will not have to be checked afterwards. Good for organising anything intricate, and for seeing quickly what an arrangement needs in order to function. The approach is conservative; scope and daring are elsewhere.
mercury-opposition-saturn: Thinking turns serious and turns toward your actual position in the world rather than toward abstractions — practical questions, and beneath them the question of who you are. The characteristic difficulty is dwelling: on isolation, on the difficulty of reaching people, on whatever is not working. Some of that will be real and none of it is helped by circling it. A farewell may be contemplated, or an ending considered; do not act on it now, since the perspective this transit supplies is systematically dark. What it does give you is an accurate eye for what is wrong with a situation. Note the diagnosis; postpone the verdict.
mercury-conjunction-uranus: The tempo of thought jumps and every exchange gets more interesting. Intuition runs so fast that insights seem to arrive from outside you, which is excellent for anything requiring originality — invention, technical and scientific work, mathematics, astrology, puzzles of any kind. The corresponding risk is scattering and haste, and whether you get the brilliance or the mess depends largely on your usual mental speed. Test the insights before you build on them. Do not be afraid of a new idea, and do not accept it merely because it is new; the novelty itself is unusually seductive right now.
mercury-sextile-uranus: A day of small discoveries, new faces and a general sense of interest, none of which you have to go looking for — your ordinary surroundings will supply enough. The influence is mild and rarely disruptive; if it does feel disruptive, that is worth examining as a sign of how tightly you are holding your plans. Particularly good for an old problem you have been failing to solve, probably by trying the same approach repeatedly: fresh solutions become visible now. New difficulties read as challenges rather than threats. Do not spend the day in the usual routine, and leave room for something unplanned.
mercury-square-uranus: The mind is lit up and hungry for whatever it has not met, which means you bore quickly. If you are flexible, that is mostly pleasant. If you are not, this is a jangling day of small surprises and upsets, and the more precisely you were counting on a particular set of conditions, the worse it will be. Either way, thoughts move faster than you can hold them — worth writing down, since some of what arrives is genuinely valuable. It is also sloppy. Treat today as the creative half and tomorrow as the checking half, and do both.
mercury-trine-uranus: Mentally awake in a way that does not happen often. Everything encountered carries some charge, boredom is not a risk, and although the thinking lacks discipline it more than makes up for it in reach. This is the day for the problem your reliable methods have failed on: the answers that have been eluding you tend to become obvious. Anything new attracts, and travel especially — break the routine and go somewhere, even for a few hours. Good for beginning a subject that opens up a part of the world you have not seen: science, technology, mathematics, astrology, the unfamiliar in general.
mercury-opposition-uranus: You will need to brake. Thought and speech both run ahead of themselves, other people seem intolerably slow, and in the hurry you will miss something. At worst this is scattered and jumpy. At best it works like a stimulant: you grasp things faster, perceive more quickly, and get intuitions ordinarily out of reach — most of which will turn out to be accurate and all of which need checking, since a mind moving this fast makes errors as a matter of course. Impatience with routine is high. Meet someone who will argue with you rather than attempting work requiring care.
mercury-conjunction-neptune: Two possibilities, as usual with Neptune. The useful one is subtlety: you can think and say things you normally have no language for, which makes this genuinely valuable for anything artistic — with the caveat that not everyone will follow you. Imagination is unusually powerful and can carry you into ideas that are otherwise out of reach, and mysterious subjects hold real attraction. The difficult one is the same faculty unchecked, at which point imagination becomes illusion and thinking becomes fog. Be precise in anything that matters, and put every idea that arrives now through the test of a few days before acting on it.
mercury-sextile-neptune: Imagination opens in a manageable way. Your sensitivity to the finer texture of things rises and intuition works better than usual. Some of this goes on daydreaming — you would like the world to be more beautiful than it is, and may reach for fiction, romance, or anything that lets you out of the day for a while. That is not a waste. Everyone carries an interior world that supplies the reason for bothering with the exterior one, and this is one of the few doors into it. With people, you sense what is actually going on in them, though sorting the perception from the projection is still work.
mercury-square-neptune: A day for misunderstandings: messages that arrive distorted, or do not arrive at all. Say everything more precisely than feels necessary, because any available ambiguity will be found. Watch for idealising a person or a situation past the point where you can deal with either. Daydreaming is the mild form and harmless enough, provided you keep some track of what is actually happening. There will be a temptation to withhold something in order to avoid a confrontation, and it will only thicken the fog. Any evasion attempted now tends to come back; keep what you say factual and grounded.
mercury-trine-neptune: The imagination runs freely and pleasantly. You could spend the day in fantasy, though you may get more out of music, poetry, or anything written for the pleasure of it — this is a good day to leave the practical world by the front door and come back later. There is little danger of not returning. Conversations will not be about practicalities if you can help it; you want to talk about ideas, dreams, or getting away. Sensitivity to other people's states is high and entirely sympathetic, and any advice you give, however imperfect, will at least be honestly meant.
mercury-opposition-neptune: Mental fog, of a specific kind: too much arriving at once for any of it to be sorted. The confusion is a by-product of heightened sensitivity — you are picking up material you would ordinarily filter out, most of it below the level of conscious notice. Occasionally this produces genuine insight into what lies under the surface of things. The difficulty is telling that apart from noise, and the practical answer is not to try today: make no commitments and no decisions on what you learn now, and let a few days sort it. Poor conditions for precision, logic and figures.
mercury-conjunction-pluto: Thinking gets intense and penetrating. You want the bottom of the question and will not accept the surface answer, which makes this excellent for research, investigation, or anything that amounts to solving a mystery. It also gives real persuasive force: you speak as though you were stating the answer rather than offering a view, and people believe you — including when you do not actually know. That is a responsibility rather than a gift. Where you disregard someone's sensitivities, expect resistance in proportion to the force you used. Be particularly careful about what you say concerning other people.
mercury-sextile-pluto: A taste for mystery and for difficult problems, which is the surface of something deeper: the wish to get under the visible layer of things to where the actual knowledge is. Good for studying anything of that kind — psychology, astrology, the hidden generally. In ordinary matters you examine and probe everything that arrives, not from suspicion but from wanting the whole truth; put a proposal to you now and you will question it until you know exactly what it contains, and it would be difficult for anyone to mislead you. When you do reach an answer you will work hard to make other people see it too.
mercury-square-pluto: Keep the mind open, because it will not want to be. A single idea can take up residence and crowd everything else out, sometimes an idea you do not even care about. If it is one you do care about, nothing else will get through. In conversation, resist the urge to force your view on people — it may feel like the most important thing in the world to bring everyone round, and you may find yourself in arguments over matters you have no real stake in. You may equally meet someone doing this to you. Turned inward instead, the same intensity can bring up something genuinely worth knowing.
mercury-trine-pluto: You want what is underneath — of events, of people, of yourself — and you are willing to dig for it. Mysteries of every kind attract, from a puzzle to a lost object to a question you have not been able to answer. Turned inward this is particularly productive: Pluto counteracts Mercury's habit of treating you as a purely intellectual proposition, so you can get at what is actually happening at depth. Solitude helps. Psychology, astrology, and any discipline that opens the interior will draw you, and a session with anyone who does that professionally would be unusually fruitful.
mercury-opposition-pluto: Good for getting to the bottom of something between you and another person, and equally good at producing a contest of wills conducted in words. Someone may work hard to convince you of something you would rather not accept, or you may be doing it to them. Take care with that: persuasion at this angle can settle into a long, unspoken, smouldering conflict that is hard to bring into the open — and there may be no real grievance under it at all, only a straightforward attempt at control. This aspect governs propaganda of every kind. It is also excellent for surfacing what has been hidden, particularly in yourself.
mercury-conjunction-node: Mercury crosses the axis of your direction, and what arrives is usually information: a conversation, a piece of news, an introduction, something read at the right moment. Small in itself, and pointed. Rudhyar's reading of this axis is worth holding — one end is the work still to be done and taken in, the other the accomplished thing you can already perform. What reaches you now tends to concern the first. Pay attention to what is being said to you today rather than to what you are saying; the message is usually inbound.
mercury-sextile-node: A light contact between your thinking and the line of your own development. Something in the direction you have been slow to take becomes briefly easy to talk about, or somebody mentions it, or you come across it without looking. Nothing insists. The useful move is simply to notice whether the ideas you are drawn to now belong to territory you already know your way around or to territory you do not. The familiar argument is always more available than the new one; that availability is exactly what makes it worth questioning today.
mercury-square-node: Your habits of thought and the direction of your life pull against each other briefly. What you already know how to think about is not what is being asked for, and the mismatch usually shows up as an argument, a piece of advice you do not want, or a conversation that goes wrong in an instructive way. Rudhyar's point about the settled end of this axis is the relevant one: an inherited competence is not the problem, being ruled by it is. Watch for the moment you reach for the practised explanation instead of the accurate one.
mercury-trine-node: An easy view along your own axis, in words rather than in feeling. You can articulate, at least to yourself, what you have actually been working toward — which is harder than it sounds and does not often come without pressure attached. If the effort of recent years has gone into the newer and less practised side of yourself, you can see it clearly now. If it has gone into repeating what you already do well, that shows too, without much sting. Good conditions for saying the thing out loud, or writing it down while it is legible.
mercury-opposition-node: Mercury stands over the settled end of your axis, the practised knowledge and the well-worn arguments. There is real competence here and nothing wrong with using it. The risk is that a fluent explanation is not the same as an accurate one, and today the fluent one will be right at hand. Watch for the moment you resolve something with a phrase you have used many times before. What you already know how to say is meant to be the starting material for the next thing you have to work out, not a way of not working it out.
mercury-conjunction-chiron: Something touches the old injury by way of words. A remark, a memory, a piece of news, a conversation that goes somewhere you did not intend — and the reaction is sharper than the occasion accounts for. That disproportion is the useful part. What Chiron offers in exchange is articulacy: for a short while you can put language to a thing you normally have no language for, which is precisely how the wound becomes something other than damage. If there is someone who would understand, this is the day to say it to them.
mercury-sextile-chiron: A gentle verbal contact with the sore place. Someone may say the useful thing, or ask you for exactly the kind of understanding your own history qualifies you to give. Either direction counts. What is briefly available is the ability to talk about it without the usual armouring — the words are there and the defence is down at the same time, which is a rarer combination than it sounds. Nothing forces the issue and it is easy to let the day pass without using it. That is usually what happens.
mercury-square-chiron: Something said presses directly on the injury, or something you say does it to someone else. The reaction will outrun the cause. Both of the easy responses are worth resisting: the flat denial that anything landed, and the long recitation of the grievance, which is more comfortable than it looks. What the angle is actually asking is whether you can put the thing into words that describe it rather than defend it. Take the intensity as information about the wound and not about the person in front of you, and postpone any conclusions.
mercury-trine-chiron: One of the rare intervals in which the old damage can be described rather than defended. Nothing is pressing on it, and the words are available — which makes this a good moment to say out loud something you normally route around, or to be useful to somebody in the same difficulty, since your understanding is both accurate and unforced. Chiron's wound does not close; what it does instead is become teachable, and this is the angle at which that conversion costs the least. What is understood now tends to stay understood.
mercury-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury in what somebody else says. Someone describes, openly, a version of what you carry quietly, and you can either treat it as entirely their business or recognise the shape. The second is harder and much more useful. Oppositions work by putting a thing outside you where it can be looked at, and this one hands you your own vulnerability in another person's words. What you find yourself able to say back to them is usually the sentence you have never managed to say to yourself. Remember it afterwards.
mercury-conjunction-mc: Attention goes to work, profession, or some public obligation you have taken on. A good moment for planning that part of your life and for discussing your course with the people involved. You are likely to announce something — to state your plans, or make your position clear, in person or in writing. Occasionally this coincides with being discussed publicly, or with receiving an important communication about your standing. Private life is comparatively untouched. If you are the sort who works things out before acting, take the time alone; if you are not, you will simply go and talk to everybody.
mercury-sextile-mc: Good for communication and for planning, in your work or your private life, and you will spend a lot of it thinking — enough that others may conclude you are doing nothing. This is the phase for plans, not for execution. The mind is clear and you are more than usually in touch with the parts of yourself you normally keep quiet because you cannot phrase them, which means the plans you make now match what you actually want. Reasonable for negotiating, though perhaps not for concluding. Also a good time to clear away the trivial end of your work, since you can attend to detail properly.
mercury-square-mc: A good day for acting on plans already made, for deciding, and for saying something that needs saying about your work. You are clear about your objectives and willing to let people know exactly what you are doing, and willing to hear other views — but there is a difference between entertaining an idea and letting it change your mind, and only the first is guaranteed here. Do not get so pleased with your own cleverness that you cannot see anyone else's. Give the mind something substantial to work on, or it will fasten on something trivial and analyse it out of all proportion.
mercury-trine-mc: Good conditions for mental work: you plan effectively, see the facts without distortion, and attend properly to detail. A complicated problem comes apart into its components easily, so each can be handled on its own. Worth spending on plans for your working life even if you are not going to act on them yet — a detailed scheme made now will almost certainly hold, and it is unlikely you will overlook anything. Conversation goes well too, including on subjects you normally find awkward. Your objectivity reassures people that you are not trying to manoeuvre them, which makes most things discussable.
mercury-opposition-mc: Time to think about your private life rather than your public one — what you actually want, as against what you have absorbed from other people's expectations and mistaken for your own. That substitution is easy to make and hard to notice, and this is a good angle from which to catch it. More practically, it also suits domestic planning: the household, the family, the bills, the shape of the coming week. The one caution is subjectivity — your own view may crowd out anyone else's entirely, which makes this a poor moment for serious negotiation, though a reasonable one for buying something for the house.
venus-conjunction-sun: A day for pleasure and for company, and for creative work if you have any in you. You feel affectionate, sociable and physically well, though inclined to luxuriate rather than exert yourself. The hard edges of ordinary life hold no appeal and there is no great harm in avoiding them for a day. Venus attracts rather than pursues, so you may find you do not have to go looking for enjoyment — it arrives. Your own attractiveness is quietly enhanced without your having done anything about it, which is the characteristic mechanism of this planet rather than an accident.
venus-sextile-sun: Sociable and well received, which makes this a good day to be among people and an unusually good one to ask for something. That applies to personal favours and to anything depending on someone's goodwill — an application, a loan, an interview. It works best face to face rather than on paper. You get on easily with whoever is around, and a friendship begun in the course of ordinary business may take its lasting tone from the easy circumstances of the meeting. Because the Sun carries authority, openings for advancement can come out of somebody's good opinion of you today.
venus-square-sun: A mild square. You want enjoyment and are not much drawn to work; the only real defect in the day is that self-discipline is nowhere to be found and your own comfort interests you more than accomplishment. Social contact of every kind goes well and affections are favoured. You are not assertive: in a disagreement you will compromise rather than push, which is often the right instinct and occasionally the wrong one. Check whether you are making peace because you believe in it or because a contest would be unpleasant, and be careful not to concede something you actually need.
venus-trine-sun: One of the pleasantest transits there is, and nothing much depends on it. Work done with other people goes smoothly because you generate a genuine sense of common cause, and if you need to make a good impression you will. But this is really for enjoyment: whatever you do is likely to turn out enjoyable, and it is particularly good for time spent with friends. Affections run easily and are easy to show, and people respond in kind. Also a good day for making something with your hands, since both the energy and the eye are available.
venus-opposition-sun: Untroublesome, as Venus oppositions tend to be, and full of agreeable things: good company, attraction, easy relations. The characteristic problems are all versions of one problem — overindulgence, no discipline, and a marked reluctance to work. If nothing has to be accomplished there is no harm in that at all. If something does, expect to fight yourself for it, and take some care with food and drink, since today's pleasures have a way of becoming tomorrow's headache. You are in an amorous frame of mind and not a discreet one, and your judgement of a new attraction is not at its sharpest. Let it wait.
venus-conjunction-moon: Affection with a domestic and reminiscent flavour: dreamy rather than urgent, drawn toward quiet company and a familiar setting rather than toward anything spectacular. What you want is somebody you have history with, or at least somebody whose experience overlaps yours; conversation turns toward old times. Family feeling is strong, and this is a good day to spend at home or to see the people you are related to. Affection is easy to express and easily received. The only real caution is the standing one for this pairing — appetite, and the comfort of familiarity taken slightly too far.
venus-sextile-moon: The feelings soften. Anger and resentment are genuinely hard to hold onto, particularly toward the people close to you and those you deal with daily. Toward friends you are protective and want to be useful. Working with others, you keep things running smoothly because you can feel what is going on with them. Better to have people come to you than to go out; the benevolence of this angle is best expressed on your own ground. As good a moment as any for doing nothing much, and if you must face the public, they will register that you are speaking with feeling as well as with words.
venus-square-moon: Not a difficult square: mostly an affectionate, slightly romantic mood with one hazard in it. The nurturing impulse here can shade into the protective and then into the possessive, and love expressed as management is suffocating to receive, however well meant. The closest relationship still needs air. This will only be a problem if the tendency is already in you. The same emotion, given a better outlet, is a genuinely warm and sustaining kind of love — the feeling itself is neither good nor bad, it simply has to be aimed somewhere useful rather than aimed at controlling somebody's movements.
venus-trine-moon: Good for the whole domestic and personal region of life. Relationships run better than usual because you want to be warm to whoever is in front of you and they can tell it is meant. Feeling is quiet rather than turbulent, which makes this a good day for two people to be alone together without needing anything to happen. Dealing with a group also goes well, though not because you are especially persuasive — simply because people like you more than usual today. Good, too, for anything sociable held at home.
venus-opposition-moon: Untroublesome, with the usual proviso about excess. Affections are roused and you are willing both to give and to receive, with the maternal end of Venus prominent: the wish to look after someone, and to be looked after. What it also produces is a certain indiscriminacy — the desire to love somebody overriding your normal judgement about whom. That is rarely dangerous and still worth noticing. Do not commit to anything that begins now until you have seen it in ordinary daylight, and be aware that feeling may run high enough between you and someone close to make any real problem impossible to discuss sensibly.
venus-conjunction-mercury: Thought turns light, and taking anything seriously is a struggle. Conversations go easily and sociably, with humour in them; heavy topics will not hold you, though you are perfectly willing to discuss affection and how things stand between people. The creative side of the intellect is stimulated — you may want to write something, and you will certainly appreciate what others have written or composed. A good day for a pleasant journey, for visiting, for looking at something beautiful. Saying what you feel about someone is much easier than usual, even if you are ordinarily tongue-tied about it.
venus-sextile-mercury: Good for arranging something sociable and for being in it. Nobody will want to talk about anything weighty, but it is a fine moment to tell people close to you how you actually feel, and if there is a small tension in a relationship it can be raised, resolved, and left behind without residue. Your ordinary surroundings look better than usual, mostly because you are noticing what is good in them. Contact with friends and neighbours tends to be fruitful and may hand you a pleasant surprise. Commercial dealings of all kinds go well; you have a better feel than usual for how the money moves.
venus-square-mercury: Easy, like most Venus squares: light thoughts, pleasant company, and a firm avoidance of anything that might turn into a disagreement. That last part is the catch. This is a poor day for negotiating anything contentious, because keeping the peace will matter more to you than getting a good outcome, and the real problem you smooth over now will still be there later, larger. In relationships you want to be interested and entertained rather than stirred up — an exhibition, a performance, something to look at together. Save the difficult conversation for a day with more edge in it.
venus-trine-mercury: Pleasant thinking, easy exchange, and a generally light mood. A good day to tell someone you are fond of them, and an equally good one to raise something that has been quietly bothering you, since you can say it in a way that leaves no bad feeling behind — the message that you are trying to improve things rather than score off anyone comes through clearly. Travel suits this: a journey begun now tends to be enjoyable and to leave you with more than you set out for. A meeting where you have to get people working together should go well if you are running it.
venus-opposition-mercury: The most unsentimental of the Venus contacts. You are calm, rational and slightly detached about matters that usually carry a charge, which makes this a genuinely good moment to put a problem in a relationship to the other person: the detachment lowers the temperature and the air actually clears. What it will not do is stop a confrontation that heavier transits have already set in motion; it will only guarantee that the thing gets said. The corresponding risk is that the mercurial half of you does not take feeling seriously. Watch what you say about people today — a casual remark may be taken at full weight.
venus-conjunction-venus: Your Venus return, and like every conjunction it favours starting rather than continuing. Take the initiative in your relationships, particularly the ones that matter: if you have something to say about how you feel, say it now rather than leaving it to be inferred, since a declaration made here can genuinely turn a relationship in a new direction. The appetite for beautiful things is strong, so you may buy something to look at or to wear or to put in your house. Sociable, warm, easily pleased. Something begun here would need other support to become more than an agreeable episode.
venus-sextile-venus: Contentment, more or less. Everything involving other people — family, friends, the person you love, whoever you do business with — runs well, because what you are projecting is warmth and some genuine interest in them. Connections made now may be worth something later. You want pleasant surroundings and would rather escape the practical for a while, though if you must work you will do it more cheerfully and efficiently than usual. Money matters are favoured: a negotiation should go your way, and anything bought today has a fair chance of turning out to have been worth it.
venus-square-venus: Usually pleasant, occasionally a test — of whether your relationships rest on anything, and of whether you can stay yourself inside them. This is one of the transits that inclines you to concede rather than hold your position, and someone may take advantage of the good nature on offer. Not a disaster, just worth watching. Energy is low in a particular way: not unwell, simply disinclined, so work may get done without your heart in it, and you may be quietly assuming it will come out fine regardless. It generally does not. Watch the spending, and put in the effort anyway.
venus-trine-venus: Agreeable and mildly lucky, in a specific sense: what actually helps you is that you are relaxed enough to let things in. A great deal is kept out of people's lives by tension — the unconsciously alienated ally, the opportunity missed through caution — and this angle temporarily removes that. So circumstances, people and sometimes money arrive that will matter later. Relationships run smoothly. You are drawn to beautiful people and beautiful things, which is pleasant and worth watching, since the surface is unusually persuasive today. Romance runs high. Go and look at something well made.
venus-opposition-venus: Comfortable, benign and self-indulgent, which is entirely fine so long as nothing has to get done. The prevailing feeling is that there is nothing you do not deserve, and it tends to be expressed at the till: an expensive frivolity bought on impulse and reconsidered later. Work is what you will avoid; do not schedule anything demanding here if you can help it. Relationships run smoothly, with one specific risk — in a disagreement you may concede a point you had every right to hold, simply because holding it would be unpleasant. Postpone any difficult negotiation.
venus-conjunction-mars: Attraction sharpens and you go after it rather than waiting. Because Venus is the one acting on Mars here, the effect is to soften the Martian edge: you are more willing to meet what the other person actually wants, which makes for a considerably better encounter than the reverse arrangement produces. Even apart from that you are livelier and more attractive than usual and may find yourself at the centre of things, working hard for people's approval because you want the affection. Creative work is favoured for the same reason — self-expression through pleasure. Anything begun here needs more than this to last.
venus-sextile-mars: A good balance between asserting yourself and reaching for someone else, which shows up in relationships as the ability to give and receive in roughly equal measure, and in friendship as being able to be yourself without that costing anything. Creative work is favoured; if you make nothing, you may spend the energy improving your surroundings instead. Get involved in something with other people — the liveliness needs an outlet and company is the right one. The energy you are carrying attracts the people you would like to attract. Financial openings are possible, particularly in something new or unusual.
venus-square-mars: Desire is roused, which is straightforwardly good where a relationship is in decent shape and abrasive where it is not. The friction is the point: this angle tests what ego tension has been quietly built into an attachment. A healthy connection has plenty of energy here to spend however the two of you like. A strained one will produce arguments whose real subject is not what is being argued about. The underlying difficulty is that Venus wants ease and Mars wants satisfaction on precisely its own terms, and those do not naturally reconcile. Compromise helps considerably; wanting it is the hard part.
venus-trine-mars: You can go after what you want without treading on anyone, and people notice that you have been direct without being abrasive. You also want them to have the same latitude, and will help them get it if the favour is returned — there is an unusually good balance now between being an individual with your own appetites and being someone in relation to others. Desire is roused, more gently than at the harder angles, and you genuinely care whether the other person is enjoying it too. Something begun here has a fair chance of lasting, and even a brief version leaves no bitterness.
venus-opposition-mars: Desire and creative energy both rise. Where a relationship is working and there is room for both people to be satisfied, that is simply good. Where it is not, the Martian energy has nowhere to go and converts into conflict — which is what most of the trouble at this angle actually is. If one of you is going unsatisfied, expect that to surface as friction over something else entirely. With no ongoing attachment you may find yourself attracted to more or less anyone, so treat a new one carefully: you are looking for an outlet and are not currently assessing much else.
venus-conjunction-jupiter: Possibly the most agreeable transit in the book, and it lasts a day. Every kind of relationship benefits — professional, social, intimate. You are optimistic, warm and outgoing, and have no appetite whatever for a dispute. Money can behave generously, though the more usual manifestation is that you spend it, particularly on things that are lavish or beautiful. Self-discipline is at its lowest and is rarely needed. Anything celebratory works unusually well, partly because your mood is infectious and people want to be near it. A love affair may begin; it will need other support to become anything.
venus-sextile-jupiter: Contented, benevolent, at peace with the world and wanting to share it. Friends are the usual beneficiaries of that, and you of theirs — everything done here tends to come out as a fair exchange in the long run. Favourable for financial matters, particularly anything foreign, medical or legal, and anything legal decided now tends to go your way. A friendship or attachment beginning under this brings out your better qualities and can fairly be called a growth relationship; you are drawn to people with some largeness about them. The only drawback is a total absence of discipline.
venus-square-jupiter: Agreeable, and almost entirely lacking in restraint. Excellent for anything you actually enjoy, provided nothing has to be done. Appetite runs ahead of judgement in every direction — rich food, drink, and shops selling jewellery, clothes and art objects you do not need. A poor day for a diet and a poorer one for a credit card. And yet: if you know what you are doing and go about it deliberately, this can be a genuinely good moment to invest in something, because the judgement is sound. It is the impulse that is unreliable, so decide first and buy afterwards, not the other way round.
venus-trine-jupiter: Classically one of the best, with the one flaw that it is over in a day. It brings ease, grace and pleasant company; the laziness and indulgence that come with it will only be a problem if they were going to be anyway. Mostly this is a respite. You feel content, and the contentment spreads, so everyone around you has a better day for your being in it. Excellent for anything social. You may meet someone who matters later, and there may be a romantic turn, though rarely enough on its own to build on. A good day to begin a journey, or to invest in something you enjoy.
venus-opposition-jupiter: The most self-indulgent transit of the lot, and also one of the most enjoyable, provided you keep some hold on the reins. Ambition is entirely absent; what you want is to sit down, or to go out and buy something luxurious. This is the worst possible day to shop with economy in mind — you will want every pretty thing you see and will probably buy several, against your own better judgement. The likeliest real trouble is the table: Venus and Jupiter together mean rich and sweet. A relationship may begin, and may be lovely, but check that you are not being persuaded entirely by surfaces.
venus-conjunction-saturn: Affection is still there but is expressed with restraint and measured against practical reality. This is the gentlest of the Venus–Saturn contacts and still the soberest of the Venus ones. You may find yourself asking someone older for advice about a relationship, because you are genuinely taking stock of where your life is and what a particular attachment means in it. Sometimes it coincides with a goodbye, temporary or otherwise. Unusually for Venus, there is no pull toward indulgence, which helps if you need to economise. The risk is seeming indifferent when what you actually are is lonely.
venus-sextile-saturn: Obligation inside relationships comes into focus, and pleasantly: you get real satisfaction now from being useful to the people you care about, and are willing to put a shared standard ahead of your own preference. What matters to you is that a relationship be real, which makes this an unusually good moment to sit down with someone and establish plainly what each of you expects from the other. A great deal of trouble in attachments comes from nobody having said. Favourable for business, particularly anything dealing in beautiful objects, and for creative work that depends on craft rather than inspiration.
venus-square-saturn: Relating is difficult; you feel cool and reserved even toward people you love. What is actually happening is a reckoning — an involuntary audit of what you put into your attachments and what you get back — accompanied by a sharp awareness of being a separate person nobody can get inside of. That can collapse into loneliness, or it can produce a sober and genuinely useful reappraisal. The illusions in even a good relationship have to be set aside occasionally and the thing looked at as it is. Beware, though, of concluding that it is worse than it is; Saturn's standard is unforgiving and not necessarily right.
venus-trine-saturn: The least showy of the Venus transits and much the easiest of the Saturn ones. What satisfies you now is something reliable rather than something exciting, and you make no unrealistic demands: you accept that the people you love are people, and ask only that they meet their obligations, as you will meet yours. A good moment to talk through a difficulty in a relationship, since your sense of what is actually the case is strong and you are not being carried anywhere by an ideal. Conservative with money and fair in business. What begins here is undemonstrative and tends to outlast the demonstrative kind.
venus-opposition-saturn: Little warmth in this one, though nothing destructive either. The conflict is between duty and enjoyment, and it will be set up so that you cannot have both. If you feel cold toward someone despite their overtures, the honest course is to do nothing rather than to perform an affection you do not feel — they will sense the performance, and it will hurt more than the coldness. Obligations may simply prevent something you were looking forward to; there is nothing to do but bear it, since neglecting the work would only have spoiled the pleasure anyway. Loneliness and self-pity are the standing hazards. It is short.
venus-conjunction-uranus: You want excitement by way of affection or creation, and Uranus being what it is, the form is unpredictable. An existing attachment may be disrupted by your own sense that it has gone flat — you want stimulation, and if none appears you will get irritable. Or something arrives unexpectedly and is not unwelcome: a new interest from a direction you were not watching, or with someone unlike anyone you know. What begins here is exciting and rarely stable. Money can move suddenly in either direction. Whatever you do to amuse yourself must be new; nothing routine will hold you at all.
venus-sextile-uranus: You want a break from the usual, and you want interesting people to have it with — anyone likely to bore you will be avoided. You also attract new company, because what you are showing today is the unexpected and rather charming side of yourself. The people you meet will seem immediately agreeable, and may not last, which is fine: you are not looking for permanence just now. Good for a party or an outing with friends. If something that starts today does last, expect it to rearrange your life somewhat, and expect it to require you to leave the other person a great deal of room.
venus-square-uranus: You want excitement through a relationship, to the point of picking a fight to get it. The established patterns between you and someone will chafe now even when you know perfectly well they are sound, so watch for impatience aimed at whoever is nearest — unless an argument is what you are after. That said, this is a reasonable day to get something out into the open where the two of you can look at it. Where there are no constraints, it can be a genuinely good time together. Flirtation is likely and harmless if you do not make more of it than it is.
venus-trine-uranus: A good day for doing something other than the usual, in your amusements and in your company. The people who turn up will not be much like your regular friends. Anything beginning now is electric, unstable and short, which is roughly what you are after; you are not looking for steadiness. Unconventional arrangements appeal, and attachments formed here tend to run through all their stages very quickly. Choose your entertainment against type — the unfamiliar version of whatever you usually like. What this brings is a small charge of the unexpected, which is what makes the ordinary days bearable.
venus-opposition-uranus: Something sudden may happen in an attachment, upsetting or not, or something unusual and stimulating may begin — though either would need other support to amount to much. More often the day simply drives you to look for entertainment with some novelty in it, because the ordinary version of a relationship will not satisfy you. Where there is unresolved tension between you and someone, one of you may break for air abruptly, and a flirtation elsewhere can supply the occasion. Unless the tension was already severe, no lasting damage follows. What begins here is an escape from routine and is not meant to be permanent.
venus-conjunction-neptune: At its best, a refinement of affection into something genuinely unselfish — the sense of meeting someone at a level below personality. At its worst, disappointment in a person who has failed to be what you had decided they were, an expectation that was never realistic. In between, and most commonly, daydreaming, which is pleasant and harmless as long as you keep hold of the actual. Beauty affects you strongly and you want to be surrounded by it. Judgement is not available: postpone anything requiring it, in relationships or money. Creative work, by contrast, can be genuinely inspired, since you can see the thing whole before making it.
venus-sextile-neptune: The romantic and creative imagination opens, either as heightened sensitivity to beauty or as a pleasant drift into fantasy. If it is the first, put yourself deliberately in the way of art, music or landscape today; they will reach further into you than usual, and you will register aspects of things that ordinarily pass you by. In relationships the double Neptunian potential is plain. At best you become acutely aware of what someone else needs and are content to put it first without resentment and without losing yourself. At worst the fog closes and you fall in love with your own picture of them.
venus-square-neptune: The romantic imagination runs well ahead of the facts, which is usually harmless and occasionally expensive. Mostly this is soft lights and reverie, and the same faculty turned to creative work can produce something good. In relationships, take care: you may be requiring somebody to live up to an ideal that nobody could meet and nobody should be asked to. Attachments have to function in the actual world, and today you do not want to deal with the actual world; real people will seem disappointing next to what you have imagined. Anything that begins now should be given a long look in daylight before you commit to it.
venus-trine-neptune: Pleasant, and useless for getting anything done — most of it will go on imagination rather than on work, unless the work is the kind that has to be complete inside your head before it can be made, in which case this is excellent. At its best it gives you real tenderness toward people: you can feel what they are feeling and act for everyone's benefit rather than only your own, which is as close to unselfish love as the ordinary week gets. The catch is that the same dreaminess can convince you that you are being unselfish while you are merely drifting. What begins here may be genuine or may be vapour; time tells.
venus-opposition-neptune: Take care with relationships. Unrealistic expectation can turn into sharp disappointment unless you make an effort to accept what is actually in front of you. Watch particularly for one specific illusion: casting yourself as the one who gives everything and asks nothing. That is very often an ego position rather than a generous one, and its real function is to place the other person permanently in your debt. It also does not work; you have needs, and an arrangement that does not meet them will fail. There is a genuine risk here of being deceived about somebody, or of deceiving yourself. Commit to nothing.
venus-conjunction-pluto: You want love that takes you somewhere else, out of ordinary life altogether, and that appetite can disturb an attachment that was perfectly happy simply because you are unwilling to leave it as it is. Insecurity may surface as sudden jealousy or possessiveness — passing, since Venus moves quickly, but capable of doing real damage on the way through. If the other person can meet the intensity, it can be a remarkable few days. A new fascination should be treated with suspicion: you are under the influence of something deep in yourself that has very little to do with the actual person.
venus-sextile-pluto: Feeling deepens and with it the need to belong — to someone, or to something larger. Friendships matter unusually much today and may change the direction of things. Attachments intensify, and physical love takes on a quality that is not merely physical. A good moment to work out how your feelings actually operate inside your relationships, because you are experiencing them at full strength rather than at the usual volume. Nothing superficial will satisfy you, and if someone is avoiding a real conversation you will keep digging until you reach it. What begins here often carries a sense of having been arranged in advance.
venus-square-pluto: At best, an intense and genuinely transforming experience with someone. At worst, the discovery that a relationship is changing in ways you will have to accommodate, and cannot ignore without breaking it. Change is not the problem; our craving for stability is, and stability is not on offer now. The instinctive response is to hold on harder and tighten your grip, which is precisely what will make the other person experience the relationship as a cage. Look honestly at what has already changed and what needs to. Resist the subterranean methods — the guilt, the jealousy, the leverage — for getting your way.
venus-trine-pluto: Feeling runs deep all day, and you can express it as well as have it — love here is not an idea about someone, it is something registered in the mind, the emotions and the body at once. Desire is stimulated as part of that rather than separately. What happens now tends to reveal how your relationships actually work and what you bring to them, and the psychological insight available is genuinely useful; do not flinch from it, since it will improve things. Something beginning under this can be very intense, drawing you as if by force — that force is your own psyche recognising something it needs.
venus-opposition-pluto: Experience in love intensifies, and what you are after is feeling that carries you out of the ordinary. The same appetite produces indiscretions that cost something later, so keep half an eye open. Anything beginning now may be compulsive: a fascination strong enough to prevent you from assessing the person at all, sometimes an attraction to someone you already know is bad for you. Wait and see what it actually is. Existing relationships may run into obscure friction, with subconscious material driving behaviour neither of you can quite account for. Do not let old resentment surface disguised as something else.
venus-conjunction-node: Venus crosses the axis of your direction, and what arrives usually arrives as a person: an introduction, an attraction, a connection made at the right moment. Rudhyar read the far end of this axis as the practised, effortless thing and the near end as the work still to be done, and Venus is the planet of what returns to you from the world — so what turns up now is a small return on which direction you have actually been facing. Note who it is and what they represent. It is rarely accidental in feel.
venus-sextile-node: A light and pleasant contact with the line of your own development. Something in the direction you have been slow to take becomes briefly attractive rather than daunting, often through a person or an invitation. Nothing insists, and that is why it usually slips past. The question worth holding for a day is whether what appeals to you now belongs to the new faculty you are meant to be building or to the accomplished one you already enjoy performing. Both feel agreeable. Only one of them is unfamiliar, which is the reliable way to tell them apart.
venus-square-node: What you are drawn to and what you are meant to be developing pull briefly against each other. The friction is soft rather than sharp: an attachment that makes the harder road less appealing, a pleasure that argues persuasively for staying where you are. Rudhyar's point about the settled end of this axis is the relevant one — the comfortable gift is not the enemy, being ruled by it is. Watch for the moment you choose the agreeable option and call it the sensible one. Venus makes that substitution easy and almost invisible.
venus-trine-node: An easy view along your own axis, with affection rather than effort supplying the light. What you value now is likely to be genuinely yours rather than merely habitual, and if the last stretch of your life has gone into the newer and less practised side of yourself, some of the return on that arrives as plain contentment. If it has gone into repeating what you already do well, the same clarity shows that too, gently. Nothing here compels anything. Good conditions for noticing which direction your attachments have actually been pulling you.
venus-opposition-node: Venus stands over the accomplished end of your axis: the charm you can turn on, the role you play well, the affection that comes without effort. It is a real asset and there is no reason to refuse it. The catch is that ease invites repetition, and repetition is how a gift quietly becomes the thing that runs you. Watch today for the moment you fall back on the version of yourself that always works. What you already do well is meant to be the material of the next thing, not a comfortable place to live.
venus-conjunction-chiron: Affection touches the old injury directly, and the two do not sit easily together. Something tender presses on something sore: a kindness that is hard to accept, a closeness that reactivates an older loss, a moment of being valued that shows you how long you have gone without. The reaction may be larger than the occasion. What is available in exchange is a rare gentleness toward the wound itself, yours or someone else's, and an unusual capacity to offer exactly the sympathy your own history qualifies you for.
venus-sextile-chiron: A soft contact with the sore place, usually through someone else. A person may offer you the kind of care that your particular injury makes hard to take, or ask you for the kind only your experience could have taught. Both are the same transit and either is worth accepting. Defences are lower than usual and nothing is pressing on them, which is a combination that does not come round often. It costs almost nothing to use and is easy to let pass unremarked, which is generally what happens.
venus-square-chiron: Something in your affections presses on the injury. Often it is the discovery that you cannot quite receive what is being offered, or that what you want from someone is shaped by an old deficit rather than by them. The two easy responses are both worth resisting: pretending nothing landed, and settling into the ache as a familiar place. What the angle is asking is whether the wound can be brought into the relationship as something to be spoken about rather than acted out. Take the intensity as information about the injury, not a verdict on the person.
venus-trine-chiron: A rare interval in which the old damage can be felt without defence and without pain sharp enough to obscure it. Nothing is pressing; it is simply legible, and there is enough warmth around to look at it kindly. That makes this a good moment to say something you normally route around, or to be genuinely useful to someone in the same difficulty. Chiron's wound does not close — what it does instead is become something you can offer — and this is the angle at which that conversion costs the least.
venus-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury through someone you care about. They carry openly what you carry quietly, and the encounter can go two ways: you can treat their trouble as entirely theirs and stay comfortably outside it, or recognise the shape and admit it is familiar. The second is harder and much more useful. Affection makes the recognition possible and also makes it uncomfortable. What you find yourself able to say to them is usually the thing you have never managed to say to yourself; remember it once the feeling has settled.
venus-conjunction-mc: Affection is uppermost, and more interesting to you than ambition — you are conscious of the people you care about and of what you feel for them, and with other support you might fall for someone new. One version of this is a pleasantly unproductive mood in which nothing gets done except creative work. If you work in anything Venus governs — art, entertainment, anything that trades on relationship or on beauty — the day is favourable; in any other line, you will at least be good at creating the conditions in which business gets agreed. Do not spend it alone; Venus alone turns into loneliness.
venus-sextile-mc: You think about your relationships, and think well of them. You are in a conceding mood — willing to give up what you would normally consider your rights for the sake of keeping things pleasant, and disinclined to believe any problem is worth a fight. Mostly that is cheering. You are more tolerant of people's faults, may not notice them, and are genuinely willing to listen to somebody's trouble and say something kind. The one difficulty is that this makes solitude uncomfortable: if circumstances leave you alone today, the same influence registers as loneliness. Creative work is stimulated and worth doing.
venus-square-mc: For most people an amorous, companionable transit, with a real sense that you are not quite complete alone and want somebody to make up the difference — not from insecurity but as a genuine appetite for giving and receiving. Where it goes wrong it goes the other way entirely: so wrapped up in yourself that nothing gets through, or demanding more affection than you are prepared to return. A third possibility is that one relationship inflates in your mind until you cannot see it accurately, and possessiveness follows. All three require the tendency to be there already; the transit only enlarges what it finds.
venus-trine-mc: Good for anything creative, and if you work in a creative field you should be unusually productive. It is also a good moment to make your surroundings better — to redecorate, to rearrange, to put something worth looking at where you will look at it — since your eye is more sensitive than usual. Affection runs warm and wants expressing, and people can feel how you regard them, which makes them pleasant to be around in turn. As with the sextile, you would rather keep the peace than win the point, and are ready to concede. Just check that what you are conceding is not essential.
venus-opposition-mc: Venus at the base of your chart: the pleasure is domestic. Your own surroundings and the people closest to you are where the good of the day is, and entertaining at home will be more rewarding than going anywhere, because your house is unusually easy to be happy in right now. Ambition is entirely absent and there is nothing wrong with that; this is an interval for enjoying what is already around you. You feel affectionate, and if you meet someone new it will probably be on your own ground. Watch the eating and drinking, and accept the laziness unless something genuinely must be done.
mars-conjunction-sun: A large amount of energy with a real edge on it. You can stand up for yourself against almost anyone and will not be easily taken advantage of, which is worth having and comes with an obvious cost: other people have egos too, and you do not actually have to defeat them to remain yourself. Be careful with anyone who supervises you — they will not be expecting this version of you. Physical energy is high and wants physical use; desk work leaves a residue that turns into irritability. Overstrain and carelessness are both real risks here.
mars-sextile-sun: Vitality is up and can be spent on getting a great deal done. Health is usually good and you approach things with confidence, which carries over into being able to hold your position in a disagreement without needing to make it one. Openings to be effective tend to appear — a responsibility offered, a chance to show you can run something on your own. You can also work well within a group, since your energy complements rather than competes with theirs. What makes this productive is clarity: you know what you want and how to get it without provoking resistance.
mars-square-sun: Energetic and productive, and tested at every point. Circumstances or people will require you to demonstrate that what you are doing is worth doing. Acting on unexamined ego drive is the reliable way to fail here. Even at best, expect disputes: you will not want to back down on anything, which is exactly when you should be conceding the inessential points and holding only the essential ones — and the difficulty is telling them apart while your pride is engaged. Anger and impatience are common. Occasionally a real fight is required; more often the fight is a substitute for the work.
mars-trine-sun: Energy is high and confidence with it, and because you are not braced against anyone the work comes out better than usual. Good for beginning things, especially physical ones, though more often you will find yourself carrying forward something already started. You are not feeling competitive but will not back away from a challenge either, which makes this excellent for sport — you want the contest rather than the victory, and that turns out to be the more effective attitude in most things. Also good where a decision has to be made and acted on: you are clear about what you intend.
mars-opposition-sun: This goes one of two ways depending on what you have been doing. If recent action has alienated people whose cooperation you needed, the accumulated opposition may now be more than you can handle, and this is where you lose the argument. If you have been inactive instead, the same force turns inward as irritability and general difficulty, felt most sharply in your closest one-to-one relationships. The other version is a genuine culmination: something you have been pushing at reaches its point, and the confrontation that comes with it sharpens rather than defeats you.
mars-conjunction-moon: Irritability that does not seem to be about anything. Often it is not about anything present — something in the day resembles an older provocation you did not express at the time, and the anger arrives now with the accumulated force of both, which is why a trivial incident sets it off. The people closest to you are the likeliest targets, family most of all. It is not all waste: the same charge lets you stand up for yourself with a whole-hearted conviction that is usually hard to summon. Just watch the point where confidence turns into something harder to apologise for.
mars-sextile-moon: Strong feeling with initiative behind it. You want experience that engages the whole of you rather than only the mind, and you will defend what you believe with some passion — not looking for a fight, but not avoiding one either. Nobody is going to walk over you while this lasts, and yet you are not particularly pugnacious, just high-spirited and disinclined to lose. You are drawn toward people who rouse you. Work will get done, hard and well, but only on what actually touches you; anything that leaves you cold will not get started.
mars-square-moon: Moody irritability with a compulsive edge — snapping at somebody for no reason you could defend, or reacting to a small thing in a way that makes no sense from outside.
