Home is the usual theatre. What is actually happening is that buried tension has surfaced in disguise, so the upset is significant without being about what it appears to be about. Do not take the content at face value and do not act on it. There is a pull toward genuinely childish behaviour; feeling it is unavoidable, acting it out is not. Rashness makes accidents likelier than usual.
mars-trine-moon: Everything is felt more strongly, and you want it that way — you would rather have experience that touches you than experience that is merely efficient. Relationships intensify, and what you do gets done with feeling and intention pointing the same way, which gives your manner an unusual directness. You take things seriously, which is not a problem here, because the same seriousness makes you straight with people: you are not going to play games with anyone's feelings, and they respond by not playing games with yours. Emotion drives action, but not past the point where you can steer it.
mars-opposition-moon: Close relationships come under pressure and may be difficult. Without some self-awareness, what drives your behaviour now is old material — patterns formed in childhood, compulsions you would not defend if you saw them. Like every opposition, this is also a culmination: the pressures and the strengths in your closest attachments both become visible. The characteristic form is that you see your own unconscious drives acted out by somebody else, usually as a conflict in which the other person behaves irrationally and against your interests. Look at that person carefully. A good deal of what you are seeing is yours.
mars-conjunction-mercury: Your ego gets thoroughly entangled with what you say, which makes you touchy and quick to dispute — and quick, without meaning to, to phrase things in a way that leaves other people feeling got at. The same charge is a considerable asset if you point it at work: you can sustain mental effort for a long time now. Keep the mind occupied and the energy will not leak into arguments. If you have to persuade somebody, you will be effective as long as you stop short of pressure. Travelling, watch the speed; recklessness is part of this combination.
mars-sextile-mercury: Good conditions for mental work that requires you to decide something and commit to it. Also a good time to negotiate: you are confident about your position without being defensive about it, which is usually what convinces people. Planning alongside others works well — differences can be talked through without anyone feeling cornered, and everyone can come away feeling they contributed. Energy is high and makes you restless to get things settled. Travel connected with work suits it better than travel for its own sake, since the restlessness wants an outlet as much as a destination.
mars-square-mercury: Watch how you speak to people. Energy is high and your ego is closely bound to your opinions, so offence is taken quickly and not kept quiet. Any obstacle in your way produces irritation immediately. Disputes are likely at home and at work, and looking back you may find there was no issue in them at all beyond two egos. If you do have something real to defend, this is the day for it and you are strong enough to carry it. Wasting the charge on nothing, and making enemies over nothing, is the actual risk. Others may seem to start it; check what you are transmitting.
mars-trine-mercury: Mentally alert and able to put a case so that people understand it, whether or not they agree — and they will respect it either way. In a negotiation you can make your position carry, mostly because you state it without ambiguity and leave nobody guessing. Excellent for study, formal or otherwise, since you are confident enough not to feel threatened by a view that differs from yours and can therefore actually listen. Good for planning, writing, and anything predominantly mental. Also good for travel: the energy is there and wants to be on the move.
mars-opposition-mercury: Expect disputes, whether or not you feel combative — and you probably will. This is a poor day to try to settle an argument, since both of you will dig in and neither will move an inch. What needs recognising is that your ego is thoroughly wrapped up in your opinions just now, so a challenge to an idea registers as a challenge to you. Occasionally that is accurate; usually it is not. If you have something real to defend, defend it and you will have the energy for it. Excellent for mental work done alone. Watch for haste and for accidents.
mars-conjunction-venus: Desire rises, and with Mars leading rather than Venus, the emphasis falls on wanting rather than on relating. Energy is high and demands satisfaction, and if none is available it converts into friction with whoever is nearest. You may want somebody physically while feeling very little for them otherwise. Beyond that, the transit rouses creative energy in general — good for any making that involves the body: performance, dance, sculpture, anything where the work is done with the hands and the whole self rather than in the abstract. Poetry and composition will not discharge it.
mars-sextile-venus: Desire is roused and finds a workable outlet. An existing relationship benefits, since both of you can give and take without one of you doing all of either. Enjoyment and company are the themes — a party, a gathering, anything shared, since almost everything is better now for having somebody else in it. Good for creative work too, and if you make nothing you may spend the energy making your surroundings better: painting, clearing, rearranging. Whatever you do will be shaped by the double need to express affection and to have something to look at afterwards.
mars-square-venus: You assert your individuality inside a relationship, usually because the balance has gone off — you have been giving more than you get, or giving less and your partner has noticed. A working relationship is a fine equilibrium between what each person needs as themselves and what they want from being together, and that equilibrium is easily disturbed now. The remedy is unglamorous: say explicitly what you want and what you are prepared to give, because what goes unsaid is generally where the trouble actually lives. Where things are basically sound, this is simply energy, and welcome.
mars-trine-venus: A near-perfect balance between being yourself and being with somebody. You can express what you want inside a relationship and take real satisfaction from it while leaving the other person the same room. The effects are physical rather than psychological: a purely romantic arrangement with nothing bodily in it would feel thin now, though that is unlikely to be the situation. Desire is stimulated and your erotic imagination with it, and people you would not normally look at twice acquire a certain interest — worth a small amount of discretion, though rarely a problem at this angle.
mars-opposition-venus: Almost the strongest stimulus to desire in the book, and quite capable of causing trouble with it. Venus governs the wish for connection, Mars the need for satisfaction, and in most species the sexual and the combative are not entirely separable — which is unusually true now. What happens is that tenderness goes missing: the encounter starts to serve dominance rather than exchange, and you may find it hard to give as much as you want to take. One of you can end up feeling that something was taken rather than given, and the conflict that follows is really about that.
mars-conjunction-mars: Your Mars return. Physical and ego energy both run very high and must be given somewhere to go, or they will find somewhere themselves. Hard physical work is the best answer, provided you get something out of doing it; resentful labour brings out the worst of this. Sport works. Sitting still produces itchiness, then restlessness, then a readiness to snap at whoever is nearest over nothing. If you notice none of this, look harder — repression is the most dangerous response, because the charge comes out anyway, as an accident, or through somebody else's aggression aimed at you.
mars-sextile-mars: Energetic and physically well, with a genuine opportunity in it that is easy to waste. Sitting through it does no harm, it simply throws the transit away. Athletic activity suits it, and so does anything done alongside friends or neighbours — a shared project of some kind, which you will enjoy because it makes you feel alive. Where you need to be personally effective, in business or in a negotiation, you can be: there is enough self-confidence here to make an impression and win a point. The one caution is that this transit offers energy without compelling you to use it.
mars-square-mars: Avoid acting on impulse. Ego energy is high but badly aimed, so self-assertion tends to land in the wrong place: unnecessary challenges issued to people who were not in your way, impatience with how everyone else is doing things, a general readiness to take offence. You may instead have to deal with somebody else in exactly that state, in which case patience is the answer until something genuinely serious is at stake — remembering that under this transit anything touching your pride will feel serious. Good for work needing sheer physical output and little finesse.
mars-trine-mars: Vigorous self-assertion without excess. You can make it plain that you are willing to work for what you want, and people take it well. Energy is high enough to get a great deal done in a short time, with physical labour discharging it most cleanly. A good moment to take initiative and start something, since you have both the drive and the judgement to carry it through. You can work with others, though you may do better alone unless they can keep your pace. If a project has been stuck, this is what gets it moving again.
mars-opposition-mars: A strong need to assert yourself, expressed in a way that tends to provoke. Suppress it and you will find yourself dealing with somebody else being overbearing instead. The other possibility is a stretch of genuinely successful work in which you get somewhere precisely by insisting on your own way of doing it. What has to be learned here is that your success does not require anyone else's failure — which is exactly what it will feel like it requires. Watch for resentment of another person's success, as though it had been taken from you. Where opposition comes, bring it into the open rather than letting it work underground.
mars-conjunction-jupiter: Excellent for physical activity of almost any kind: energy is high, you feel strong, and the muscular tone that comes with this combination is genuinely improved. The hazard is proportional — exuberance leading to unnecessary risk, in sport or in any work that carries some danger, and overconfidence here does produce accidents. The same appetite extends to gambling and speculation. This is called a lucky transit and is not really luck; what actually operates is that total confidence makes an enterprise far more likely to succeed. Good conditions for launching something.
mars-sextile-jupiter: Openings appear for more or less anything you want to undertake, and what is started now tends to do well. Particularly favourable for business and for negotiating something to your own advantage: your objectives are clearer to you than usual, which lets you deal intelligently and come away with the better arrangement. There is buoyancy in it without the carelessness — you are optimistic and still attending to the details that decide whether a thing works. Good for dealings with authority, who will be unusually open to you, and for anything legal. Health and spirits both run high.
mars-square-jupiter: Energetic and potentially very successful, with one condition: keep track of what you are actually doing. The temptation is to move fast on an unjustified conviction that whatever you touch will come out well. It may, but not by luck — it will come out well through planning and foresight, both of which are available here if you deliberately use them. You are acting for what could be rather than for what is, which is exactly right for launching something and exactly wrong for judging your own limits. Do not overextend, physically or otherwise; the bill arrives later.
mars-trine-jupiter: One of the best transits for almost anything. Energy is high, you feel well, and you can genuinely do about twice the usual amount of work. Muscular tone is good, so this strongly favours physical activity. It gets called lucky, and what is actually happening is that you can see the whole of what you are doing and plan around the pitfalls that other people fall into and then call misfortune. Particularly good for anything that advances your own interests — with the standing caveat that self-aggrandisement suits this transit just as well as growth does, and costs more later.
mars-opposition-jupiter: Either one of the fortunate transits or a stretch of conflict and overreach, depending largely on how conscious you are of what you are doing. This is the culmination of an effort to widen your scope, and you now resent anything that narrows it. Handled with some self-knowledge, it is enlightened self-interest and works well. Handled blindly, you come across as overbearing, and the people you steamroll now will be absent when you need them. The characteristic error is presenting yourself as rather more than a person, which invites others to test the claim. Overestimating your capacity is the physical version of the same mistake.
mars-conjunction-saturn: Frustrating, and full of small irritating obstructions. Do not launch anything risky; the energy has no vigour behind it. Concentrate on routine work with an established shape to it. Other people may seem deliberately obstructive, and you will be angry without much opportunity to express it, which is the specific difficulty here — anger with nowhere to go turns physically corrosive. Find hard work and put it there, and then deal with the actual problem separately. The transit is genuinely good for anything requiring concentrated effort, careful technique, or patience with resistant material.
mars-sextile-saturn: Good for planning and executing something that needs diligence rather than flair. This is not an energetic Mars contact — you will not feel like moving mountains — but it supplies sustained effort, which is more useful. Intricate work suits it, especially with hard materials. You can work patiently now toward something that will only pay out later, and be content with modest results in the meantime, because your concerns are practical and you know what is actually achievable. Immediate gratification is subordinated without much struggle. Useful in any period of scarcity, where getting by well matters more than getting ahead.
mars-square-saturn: Go slowly and do it thoroughly; carelessness here has almost no chance of success. Usually this is a frustrating stretch in which every attempt to assert yourself is blocked — and the blockage is more internal than external, a sense of inadequacy rather than a real obstacle. Fear is often the mechanism: the conviction that you will fail because of something lacking in you. Authority figures may say something that lands squarely on your own worst suspicion about yourself. That is not evidence. What the transit is asking is that you find out what you actually are and can do, without being flattened by the imagined version.
mars-trine-saturn: Patience, and a willingness to do exacting work. Mars energy is usually too erratic for anything requiring concentration; here it comes out at a controlled and steady rate, so you can point it at a task and keep it there. That makes this the right moment for work you simply have to keep plugging at, unrewarding or not — Saturn does not require the work to be interesting, only that it be met. If this falls during an otherwise difficult period, it guarantees you can cope for the moment however hard things get. Detailed work, mathematics, fine craft, resistant materials.
mars-opposition-saturn: Irritating in a specific way: it asks for patience, forbearance and a willingness to stay in the background, none of which is comfortable. Anger tends to smoulder rather than explode. The particular difficulty is that when somebody hits you, they hit exactly where you are weakest, and in a way that leaves you feeling unable to respond — so the hurt gets internalised, which is what you will want to do. The correct response is the harder one: recognise that it landed, and say so. Relationships are less satisfying than usual for the duration, and a general sense of inadequacy comes with the territory.
mars-conjunction-uranus: Nothing is more conducive to sudden upset and rash behaviour. Energy bursts out in unexpected forms and directions, which makes planning around this transit almost impossible. Directly expressed, it is a sudden demand for freedom — the impulse to kick away every limitation at once — and difficulty with anyone who tries to hold you to something. Relations with authority go badly unless you are given a great deal of room. The haste is the danger: moving this fast, you can miss something that matters. An accident here is not fate, it is the direct product of your own carelessness.
mars-sextile-uranus: Restless and impatient with routine, though not so strongly that anything gets wrecked — you will simply make a number of changes to your days in order to get some interest into them. Thinking is more impulsive and changeable, which makes you somewhat unreliable from outside and genuinely original from inside: you can see the situation freshly and, more usefully, put the fresh view to practical use. You may seek out new company, or the friends you normally find too unsettling to spend much time with. Just now that is exactly the company you want.
mars-square-uranus: Restlessness and impulsiveness, with a real appetite for rebellion. The question underneath is whether you can be yourself, and whether you can keep renewing your life so that it does not go stale. The aim should be ongoing change rather than a choice between total revolution and total stasis — which means not waiting until a situation has become unbearable before reforming it. Wait, and you will get the worst of this: rashness, haste, and obligations abandoned. Authority and long-standing relationships are the likely targets. You anger easily now because almost anything reads as a constraint.
mars-trine-uranus: New activity and new encounters, some of them unexpected, all of them enlivening. The daily routine will not satisfy you, and this is the angle at which you can break out of it without breaking anything else. Inhibition is what usually stops people doing what they would like to do, and here you find the nerve to set it aside for a while and gain some genuine freedom by it. You may also be released from obligations that have been in the way. You are willing to take a risk, and the risk itself is part of what makes you feel alive. Extraordinary things are possible.
mars-opposition-uranus: Most often this comes out as striking back — suddenly and rashly, at whoever has been holding you back or wearing you down, or as an abrupt move to get out from under obligations you never chose. The characteristic form is an explosive release of accumulated tension aimed at someone close, who will make you feel restless and irritable in a way you cannot account for. Expect impatience. You may also meet it from outside, as somebody making a sudden move against you, or as an event that forces you to abandon your plans. If you are not the agent of change here, change arrives as disruption.
mars-conjunction-neptune: A strange one, and usually accompanied by odd feelings: irritable and itchy without knowing what about, and simultaneously discouraged and convinced you are incapable. That combination is Neptune's ego-thinning meeting the sheer egoism of Mars, and it is not worth taking seriously as a report on your abilities. Avoid anything requiring you to know exactly what you are doing, and avoid starting things. Be wary of anyone who appeals to your favourite ideals and then makes use of you; your illusions can be the raw material of somebody else's plan. Genuinely good for selfless work — charity, care, service that asks nothing back.
mars-sextile-neptune: The ego makes fewer demands, which leaves you more perceptive — of the world generally and of what the people around you need. The satisfaction available now comes through doing something for someone else, and charitable or institutional work of any kind suits it particularly. Also a good moment to go off alone and think, since nothing feels urgent enough to interrupt you. Physical energy is on the low side without being a problem. Anything psychic or occult is worth studying now precisely because the ego drives that get in the way of such things are quiet.
mars-square-neptune: Doubt, discouragement, and a sense of inadequacy, often accompanied by the consequences of something you did earlier and hoped had gone away. About twice a year this transit puts the same question to you: are you doing what you should be doing with your life? The temptation is to answer no and give up, and other people may offer demoralising advice that confirms it. You may genuinely be wrong about something, and where you are, change course. But judge it in your own terms rather than someone else's, and decide either way without self-recrimination. Devious shortcuts taken now do not work.
mars-trine-neptune: One of the few Mars transits that does not raise physical energy. You may want to do very little, and you will not be at all self-assertive — but you also will not feel weak or inferior, as you may under the harder Mars–Neptune contacts. What you get instead is genuine capacity for self-sacrifice: you can work with real concern for other people because your own ego needs are quiet, and you can manage on remarkably little. A good moment to look at your life and the world as they actually are, without judging either. The one trap is casting yourself as somebody's saviour, which is the subtlest ego trip available.
mars-opposition-neptune: Debilitating, like the conjunction. You are likely to feel discouraged and unequal to ordinary demands, physical energy is low, and your resistance is genuinely reduced — avoid anything that puts real strain on the body. Encounters with people may be dispiriting, and it is worth checking that anyone you are dealing with is representing themselves honestly, because deception is likelier now and lands harder. Do not attempt anything devious yourself; you will not be good at it and will not enjoy the consequences. Close partnerships, personal or business, are where the confusion tends to concentrate.
mars-conjunction-pluto: A ruthless burst of ego energy that does not accept limitation and wants to take charge of whatever is happening. Ambition of any kind is strongly stimulated, and so is the possibility of trouble — either you attempting to have power over someone, or being on the receiving end of somebody else's attempt. It is worth avoiding genuinely dangerous places for the few days this runs. Positively, it is excellent for heavy work, particularly anything involving major change: even if you believe you have no interest in power, you will get considerable satisfaction from moving something that would not otherwise have moved.
mars-sextile-pluto: A good moment to move on something that matters to you, though you will have to alter the plan you started with — and the revision will almost certainly be an improvement. You work with real drive now and have enough of it to get through opposition. Better used cooperatively than alone: Mars–Pluto energy is considerably more effective aimed at a shared objective than at a private one. What you reach may take hard effort and will tend to last. If you are unclear about what you actually want, this is a good angle from which to look, and you may find forces in yourself you had not known were there.
mars-square-pluto: This swings between two poles: creative transformation of the situation around you, and a fierce struggle for control. Ambition is roused and energy is very high, and the difficulty is that you will pursue it in a way that generates serious opposition — or find yourself facing somebody else's version of the same. Either way your position gets seriously challenged, and you may have to change course. Make sure nothing has been left half-finished behind you; loose ends will be used. Above all, resist acting ruthlessly, however deserved it feels. Pluto cycles have a habit of destroying what was built that way.
mars-trine-pluto: Good for reform, in your life and in what surrounds it. Ambition is strongly stimulated but subtly enough that you do not put people on their guard, which is unusual for this pairing. Set long-range objectives now: work out what you actually want changed and begin, because the energy available will sustain the effort for a long time. You may be given more scope at work and with it more power to be effective. Plutonian force does not submit to purely personal ends, though — used solely for your own benefit, it plants the trouble you will meet at the harder angles later.
mars-opposition-pluto: Your attempts to change things and to affect other people meet substantial resistance, and you press on anyway. This can be the culmination of a long effort or the point where the opposition simply becomes too much. It is a strong signature for power struggles, and the real danger is that one of you — possibly you — acts with no regard for ethics or for what it costs the other person. You can govern your own conduct and not theirs. Secure your position, and gather as many people to it as you can: going it alone is what brings out the worst of this.
mars-conjunction-node: Mars crosses the axis of your direction, and what arrives usually arrives as a push: a demand, a challenge, an opportunity that requires you to move rather than deliberate. Rudhyar read one end of this axis as the accomplished, effortless thing and the other as the work still to be done — and Mars, being the planet of initiative, tends to force the question of which one you are actually pursuing. Whatever you start now bears the mark of that choice. Notice whether the effort you are about to make is genuinely new ground or a well-practised manoeuvre.
mars-sextile-node: A brief opening on the line of your own development, with enough energy behind it to act on. Something in the direction you have been slow to take becomes not merely visible but doable — a chance to begin, a person who needs exactly what you have been meaning to build. Nothing forces it, which is why it is easy to spend the impulse elsewhere. The question worth holding is simply whether the effort you are putting out today belongs to the new faculty or to the old competence. Both feel like work; only one of them is unfamiliar.
mars-square-node: Your drive and your direction pull against each other, and Mars being what it is, the friction shows up as action rather than as mood — something started in the wrong direction, an argument over exactly the thing you are avoiding, a push that meets an unexpected wall. Rudhyar's point about the settled end of this axis applies: the practised strength is not the enemy, being ruled by it is. Watch for the moment you reach for the manoeuvre that has always worked, in a situation that is asking for something you have never done.
mars-trine-node: Energy and direction agree for a stretch, which is a rarer alignment than it sounds. What you feel like doing is broadly what you ought to be doing, so the effort goes further than usual and meets less resistance in you. If recent years have gone into building the newer and less practised side of yourself, some of the return shows up now as straightforward effectiveness. Worth spending on the thing you have been meaning to begin rather than on the thing you already know you are good at. Nothing compels it; the alignment simply makes it cheap.
mars-opposition-node: Mars stands over the accomplished end of your axis: the practised move, the familiar fight, the strength you can deploy without thinking. It is real and there is no reason to refuse it. The catch is that a reliable weapon invites use, and using it is how a strength quietly becomes the thing that runs you. Watch today for the moment you reach for the response you have made a hundred times before and call it decisiveness. What you already do well is meant to supply the next thing, not to stand in for it.
mars-conjunction-chiron: Something strikes the old injury directly, and the reaction is anger — sharper and faster than the occasion accounts for, because what is actually being defended is much older than what is in front of you. That disproportion is the useful signal. The other face of it is genuine fight on behalf of the wound: this is an angle at which people finally push back against something they have absorbed for years, or act for someone else in the same position. Both are the same energy. Which one you get depends largely on whether you can see what you are actually angry about.
mars-sextile-chiron: A workable opening onto the sore place. Something can be done about it now rather than merely felt — a step taken, a boundary set, help offered to someone whose trouble you recognise because it is yours. The energy is available and nothing is pressing hard enough to make you defensive, which is an unusual combination and easy to let pass. Chiron's wound does not close; what it does is become the source of the help you are qualified to give. This is one of the cheaper moments to act on that.
mars-square-chiron: Something presses on the injury and the response comes out as force — an argument, a refusal, an action taken in heat that is really about something years older. Both easy routes are worth resisting: hitting back at whoever happens to be standing there, and the slower version where you turn the same force on yourself. Take the size of the reaction as information about the wound rather than about the provocation. If there is a real fight to be had on the wound's behalf, this is an angle that supplies the nerve for it; just be sure you have identified the right opponent.
mars-trine-chiron: Strength and the old damage occupy the same space without conflict, which does not happen often. You can act from what has hurt you rather than around it — set a limit, say the difficult thing, take on the situation you have avoided precisely because it touched that place. Nothing is inflamed and nothing is denied. Your capacity to be useful to somebody in the same difficulty is at its most available and costs the least effort. What Chiron does instead of healing is become teachable, and this is the angle at which the conversion is easiest.
mars-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury in conflict with somebody else. They carry openly what you carry quietly, and the collision can go two ways: you can fight them and treat the trouble as entirely theirs, or recognise the shape and admit the fight is not really with them. The second is harder and much more useful. Oppositions put a thing outside you where it can be looked at, and this one does it in the middle of an argument, which is a poor moment for insight and an excellent one for evidence. Note what you said. It usually applies to you.
mars-conjunction-mc: The strongest stimulus to ego drive there is, so handle it deliberately. You are entirely certain who you are and not open to correction. Often it comes out as a drive to work, and it is excellent for work — provided you get the credit. This is a poor time to labour anonymously on someone else's behalf; you will fall out badly with anyone who takes the credit for what you did. If your employer gives you no room, expect to be angry about it. Aim the energy at the task rather than at the people, and keep the impulsiveness in check; carefully planned effort here goes a long way.
mars-sextile-mc: Confidence and courage, spent in a way that does not put anyone's back up. You pursue what you want with unusual assurance and can reconcile your interests with other people's, which makes this a good time to take an initiative at work and to get others behind it. You can work with people without depending on them, and it shows: you present as self-reliant and willing to be useful, and that is precisely what makes others willing to back you, materially as well as morally. The clarity about your objectives lets you plan decisively. There is no need for anything covert; direct is what works.
mars-square-mc: Aggressive and self-assertive, which is not in itself a fault — the risk is overdoing it and picking up conflicts you had no need of, or getting so absorbed in your own objectives that you forget it matters to get on with people. Working hard alone, with nobody in your way, is often the right answer, at least as it will seem to you. Conflict is likeliest at work, at home, or anywhere your ego is directly involved, and disputes with anyone in authority are probable if you feel obstructed. The energy is explosive and takes on a life of its own if frustrated.
mars-trine-mc: Self-assured, and with the practical means to match — you have the resources, the energy and the people to carry out what you have in mind, and you will gather whatever is missing rather than wait for it. You take the initiative without needing direction and finish things quickly, putting everything you have into them. Confident enough to accept some risk, and the risks tend to come off. Others look to you for direction now because you give off the authority they are short of. Physical energy is high; build something strenuous into the day.
mars-opposition-mc: Mars at the foot of your chart: your light is under a bushel for a while. Efforts to advance in your working life meet opposition that is hard to deal with, and people may be actively working against your advancement. You will feel assertive and it will not translate. The energy is turned inward, toward home and private life, and that is where it can actually accomplish something. Watch for anger and irritability as the signal of tension there. Often the source is not current at all — something now has reactivated an older pattern. Bring it to the surface rather than sitting on it.
jupiter-conjunction-sun: The start of a twelve-year cycle of growth, and traditionally one of the best transits there is — though a heavier transit running at the same time can mask it, in which case this mostly provides a breathing space. Health and mood are good and things appear to fall your way, which they will if you act, and will not if you sit and enjoy the weather. The point of it is to widen the frame: begin things, take on more, get out from under whatever narrow arrangement has been holding you below your actual size. Travel is possible; more often the journey is mental.
jupiter-sextile-sun: Life runs easily for a while. You move in the direction you meant to without much friction, and even your ideals look reachable. Relations with anyone in a position to help you are good, largely because you project the air of somebody who gets things done and therefore attract people who do. Enthusiasm is infectious and the company is enjoyable. It is also a good stretch for planning, since you naturally think in large terms and notice openings you would ordinarily overlook or be too cautious to take. The one drawback is that the impetus to act may be missing exactly when the opportunity is best.
jupiter-square-sun: A test of restraint disguised as a gift. If you are not naturally restrained, this is where you overextend, spend what you will shortly need, or settle into a comfortable conviction that nothing can go wrong. The belief that fortune will supply what effort should is the specific error here, and it is expensive. Handled with some self-knowledge, the same energy provides real growth and genuine openings — but only if you know where you actually stand and what you actually need. Knowing when to stop is the whole skill. Watch also for inflation: there is an arrogant streak in Jupiter's less attractive expression.
jupiter-trine-sun: Agreeable enough that the temptation is to enjoy it and do nothing, which would waste something worth having: this is a period in which you can reach into unfamiliar territory and make more of it than you could at almost any other time. Creative capacity is high and things that are usually difficult come easily. Health and spirits are good, with a tendency to put on weight if left entirely to itself — get outdoors and move. Where you are athletic, note that the risk is overestimating your energy rather than any real accident-proneness. Confidence here is mostly justified; it is simply not unlimited.
jupiter-opposition-sun: A culmination, and a good one, with the standing temptation to expand past any sensible limit. You have a real chance of succeeding at several things now and should pursue them within reason. What is worth adding is that material growth alone will not do what you want it to. Possessions, money and standing are devices for producing the feeling of satisfaction rather than the thing itself, and if your life is smaller than it should be, the constriction is usually internal even when the outward problems are real. This is a turning point at which it is worth beginning to look there.
jupiter-conjunction-moon: Emotionally secure, in touch with what you feel, and able to say it — to yourself as much as to anyone else. Generosity runs high in a way that costs you nothing: you can give a great deal now without any sense of being diminished. The nurturing side of you is engaged, both the wish to look after people and the willingness to be looked after, and if you need help you will get it. Home matters, and you will work on it, practically or socially. A good period to invest in where you live. Your past looks like something that contributed rather than something that happened to you.
jupiter-sextile-moon: Optimistic and warm, with a real wish to look after whoever is in front of you — friends and the people you see daily especially. The effects are subtle rather than spectacular, and the right use is to notice how you actually relate to your ordinary world, because unusually deep satisfaction is available in interactions that look entirely routine. Family, relatives and familiar surroundings give something now that they often do not. The narrow limits of the everyday can be the vehicle of real opportunity here. Cultivate friendships: there is a good chance one of you does the other a substantial service.
jupiter-square-moon: A favourable square. Feeling is amplified, and you are more in touch with it than usual; at the same time you want to be genuinely close to people, to hear what is going on with them and to be some use. Sentiment about the past runs strong, and if there is material back there you have avoided, it is likely to surface — worth treating as an opportunity rather than an intrusion, since this is a good angle for healing an old injury. In close relationships, watch the tension between wanting to be close and wanting to be free, and give the other person the same latitude you are claiming.
jupiter-trine-moon: Pleasant, and not very energetic; without something else to activate it, this may pass without much to show. What it reliably gives is good feeling — optimism, generosity, real concern for the people you love. A good period for being at home and among familiar things, which will recharge you more than usual. Circumstances and resources tend to arrive without your going after them, which is agreeable and should not be relied on to continue. People may seek you out, and some of them will turn out to matter. An interest in religious or philosophical questions sometimes stirs here.
jupiter-opposition-moon: Feeling and the relationships built on feeling become important, and mostly this is warm: emotionally generous, well received, with attachments you have been building for years starting to yield something. You can also see clearly now which of them are worth continuing. The other face of it is indulgence without discipline — the sense that the world owes you a living whether or not it does, and that other people should be putting themselves out on your behalf. In a close relationship this can turn demanding while offering little, and passive: waiting for the first move and resenting the suggestion that you make it.
jupiter-conjunction-mercury: Breadth and precision working together, so that you can hold the general and the particular in mind at once and see the whole shape of what you are involved in. That comes out as foresight. A good period to map out where you are going, because you can see how the elements bear on each other, and you proceed believing it will work — which, since you are not being grandiose about it, it probably will. The standing risk is under-weighting the detail, which turns into hasty or careless thinking. Slow down slightly. Otherwise excellent for deciding, concluding, buying and selling.
jupiter-sextile-mercury: Good for planning and for judgement: perception is sharp and you can take a proper overall view of whatever you have to decide. Also good for communicating something that matters, since you are unusually able to sense what a group thinks and to arrive at something everyone can accept. Favourable for negotiation, contracts and commerce, and financially favourable in each. A useful stretch for resolving a difference with someone — you have the diplomacy to smooth it over so that both sides feel fairly treated. Friends may bring good news or point out something you would have missed. Good for writing.
jupiter-square-mercury: Mental activity increases along with the wish to tell people something you consider important. It may be; it is worth checking, since the conviction arrives more reliably than the substance. When you do speak, listen to what comes back — with Jupiter the details are the first casualty, and you may be unwilling to hear the correction that would save the plan. Take it and this becomes an excellent stretch for deciding, planning, negotiating and concluding. Refuse it and the same confidence carries you past something you needed to know. Optimism runs high and communication of every kind matters to you now.
jupiter-trine-mercury: Not a transit to wait on: it rewards going out and talking to people, looking for openings, and paying attention to what is worth buying or selling. You can see the situation clearly and plan intelligently, which serves in all of those. Also good for putting a view across — you come over with confidence and warmth, and people believe you and respect the clarity. You can even tell someone something unwelcome and have them think well of you for saying it. Excellent for taking up a new subject, the more abstract the better, and you can currently turn abstractions into something practical.
jupiter-opposition-mercury: Large plans, and the culmination of ideas you have been carrying for some time — they can be realised now, provided you avoid the obvious trap of thinking so big that nothing is actually workable. If you can hold all the detail of a properly constructed arrangement in view, this is an excellent moment to sign something or conclude a transaction. More than any other Jupiter–Mercury contact this one lets you see the whole pattern and plan with real foresight, and it can equally produce sloppy work. The practical answer is to have somebody else check it. Projects begun up to six years ago may come to fruition.
jupiter-conjunction-venus: Difficulties in relationships smooth over and a genuine appetite for peaceable, enjoyable company takes their place. You will probably find yourself at, or hosting, several gatherings, and may enjoy being the centre of one. A new attachment is possible, and if other things agree, an unusually good one: notable for the balance it strikes between closeness and freedom, and for the near-absence of jealousy and pettiness. Existing relationships benefit from the same quality — you are interested in the large questions and disinclined to make trouble over anything small, and little that is small is likely to arise. Your taste turns more elegant and rather more expensive.
jupiter-sextile-venus: Pleasant, and easily missed, since one of its effects is to leave you agreeably unambitious. If you know it is coming you can use it, but you will have to make the first move, and you may not want to. Good for a relaxed holiday or any enjoyment that asks little of you. Favourable for relationships of every kind, because warmth comes off you easily now and draws people in; occasionally this marks the start of something significant, and at minimum you will feel like flirting. If you have to make a good impression, this is the time — and what you feel toward people is sincere, which they notice.
jupiter-square-venus: This can produce real warmth and a genuine wish to give, or it can leave you unenterprising and passive, waiting for what you ought to be going after — usually the first, though it is hard to tell in advance. It may bring someone into your life with whom something significant is possible, not necessarily something easy; you will probably gain in maturity from it whether or not you enjoy it at the time. The characteristic difficulty is compulsive feeling that leaves you no room to manoeuvre, so that what you feel overwhelms the other person. In every Venus–Jupiter contact, closeness and freedom are pulling against each other.
jupiter-trine-venus: One of the most pleasant transits, lightly and briefly. You feel sociable and want company, which makes this good for a holiday, a gathering, or any straightforward amusement, and poor for serious effort — you are agreeably lazy and disinclined to push at anything. There is a strong indulgent streak: watch the eating and drinking, since even a transit this benign can leave you paying for it. You have a real capacity to lift other people's mood now, so they enjoy having you around, and favours done here tend to come back. A new attraction is possible, though more likely a passing one.
jupiter-opposition-venus: Usually pleasant: harmony in your relationships, and possibly a new one that matters. You want affection and can give it, and you feel more yourself in company than alone. Taste runs to the lavish, and you are not inclined to let much stand between you and what you want, so watch the spending — with care, this is actually a good moment to invest, but only if you examine what you are investing in properly, since carelessness is the standing Jupiter fault. Occasionally, with harder transits alongside, this brings turmoil instead: an argument, internal or shared, about how much freedom the two of you should have.
jupiter-conjunction-mars: Exuberant, with high energy and a real sense of physical fitness — you feel strong, willing, and rather more inclined to take a chance than usual. Vigorous physical activity is the best use of it: it does the body good and lets you get more done than you normally would. Fortunate action is the traditional phrase and it fits; whatever you point this at tends to move as though you were not pushing. The risk hides inside that. You are in fact working hard, and because it does not feel like it, you can overwork yourself badly. Rest afterwards, and expect to need it.
jupiter-sextile-mars: High energy and independent initiative: confident, capable, and clear about what you intend. A good period to begin something, and most of what you take up now should come out well — with the usual sextile condition that you have to act, since this supplies openings rather than compulsion. That is rarely a problem here, because you will want to move. Will is strong and aimed at definite objectives, so you act decisively and can bring other people with you. Unusually for a Mars–Jupiter contact, this one works well collaboratively: you can get people to see their interests inside yours.
jupiter-square-mars: Constructive, provided you keep some hold on the exuberance — which in this combination has forms other people find genuinely hard to take. Confidence is high and self-assertion comes easily; in some hands that turns arrogant and domineering. Watch also for overconfidence leading you to attempt what is simply beyond you, and, in anything physical, for the foolish risk that produces an accident. Excess of any kind will undo what is otherwise a good transit. Keep a sense of proportion and you can get more work done than usual, tackle what you normally avoid out of self-doubt, and take the lead where you would normally wait.
jupiter-trine-mars: Without the irrepressible quality of the harder Mars–Jupiter contacts, this gives an easy flow of energy that makes you notably more effective and supports initiatives requiring foresight, planning and self-confidence. Almost anything you start now works out as intended; it is a good moment to begin an enterprise. What governs it is a strong sense of integrity — you may be ambitious, but it matters to you that you get there properly, and other people can see that, which increases their confidence in you. There is a real drive to make something of yourself, and to create: this transit sometimes coincides with wanting children.
jupiter-opposition-mars: Extremely exuberant, inclining you to do everything on a larger scale than necessary. Energy is high and ambition with it, and there is a great deal of physical force wanting an outlet. Restraint is the requirement. Do not overestimate your capacity, to others or to yourself — you are capable of a lot here and do not need to exaggerate, and the danger of believing your own account is that you will genuinely attempt the impossible and exhaust yourself. The sense of omnipotence is not accurate. Sometimes this brings a conflict in which you try to break out from under someone's restrictions; whether the restriction is real is worth examining honestly.
jupiter-conjunction-jupiter: Your Jupiter return, at roughly twelve-year intervals: the opening of a new cycle of growth. It attracts inflated expectations — windfalls, luck, sudden fortune — and occasionally delivers them, but most people should expect something subtler and just as useful. What tends to happen is that events, meetings, or shifts in you open a way toward being wiser and understanding more. You reach out and ask more of the world now, and are simultaneously willing to give more to it. That second half is not decoration: this transit rewards giving and yields very little to anyone who only calculates what can be got.
jupiter-sextile-jupiter: A balanced interval in which your affairs run smoothly with little effort and growth seems to happen on its own — in understanding, in your work, in whatever part of life you are actually developing. Enjoy it, and also use it: this is a rare chance to look around and see what needs doing, from a position calm enough to be accurate. You will probably not act much now, but knowing what you are looking at means you can act properly later. Perspective is very hard to come by in the middle of a change and unusually easy to come by here.
jupiter-square-jupiter: Keep your affairs from getting away from you. The pull toward excess is strong enough that you may take on more than you can actually carry. Money deserves particular attention: you are likely to spend on the assumption that there is plenty behind you, and the pinch, when it comes, arrives shortly after this transit rather than during it. The same applies to time — projects committed to now may need more of it than you have. Check the resources genuinely at your disposal. Avoid that and this is fruitful: the confidence lets you take on things you would ordinarily refuse.
jupiter-trine-jupiter: Optimism and a quiet point of balance from which you can survey your affairs and see them fairly, which makes this a good moment for long-range planning and for reorganising. Worth spending on something that widens your view — study, travel, anything that puts you among people thinking about what you are thinking about. Psychologically and physically this is an interval of equilibrium; if you have recently been ill in either sense it substantially helps the recovery, and it is an unlikely moment to fall ill. Also good for examining your goals, since conditions are unusually favourable for actually enacting them.
jupiter-opposition-jupiter: Confidence enough to handle more or less anything, and the accompanying risk of taking on more than you can. Several long-running projects may culminate at once, which is either excellent or unmanageable depending on how accurately you judged your capacity earlier; you may have to cut something back. Restlessness is common — your ordinary world simply does not feel large enough — and the answer is genuinely to widen it somewhat, without overreaching. Conflict with authority is possible even if you have followed every rule, because you may have given the impression of wanting more than your share, and they may act to prevent it.
jupiter-conjunction-saturn: You come up against your own inhibitions and the restrictions circumstances have placed on you, and there are two honest responses. One is to break out — to go and do what the structure has been preventing. The other is to grow inside the structure, using it rather than escaping it. Neither is generally better; which is right depends entirely on your life. If you take the first route, restlessness builds and events make plain how much has gone undone, until responsibilities you have carried for years become genuinely intolerable and you leave. The second is quieter and no less real.
jupiter-sextile-saturn: Growth approached carefully and pragmatically. Every plan you make is marked by prudence: you are interested in what could be, and equally attentive to what already is, so you are neither idealistic nor merely cautious. Duty does not read as a limitation now but as a route to something — which is a fundamentally sound view, and only available when your need for freedom and your need to get work done are in reasonable balance, as they are. You can also see which apparent obligations are not actually yours, and are not inclined to carry somebody else's share without good reason. Financially thrifty and unusually well judged.
jupiter-square-saturn: A period of adjustments: separating from people and situations that are doing you no good, revising standards you can see are not right, and bringing your sense of what you owe into line with what is actually true. That produces tension, and for a while genuine confusion about whether to go forward or back, expand or cut. You would probably do better alone with it than taking advice, unless you choose the adviser carefully. The task is to grow in some directions and retrench in others; you cannot keep everything going, however much you want to, and there is no advance notice of which is which.
jupiter-trine-saturn: You can build something slowly and patiently, without the tension and ambiguity of the harder Jupiter–Saturn contacts. You keep your long-range aim in view while dealing with the day's actual demands, which is why work done now tends to be good work — you understand unusually well how the parts relate to the whole. A good period for practical matters of every kind, and specifically for expanding a business, starting one, or moving into new territory. Once you find the workable solution you move on it. Unusually for Jupiter, you will not particularly want company; go off alone and think.
jupiter-opposition-saturn: One of Jupiter's more difficult transits, because the two principles are so unlike: you may feel yourself expanding and contracting at once, and it is genuinely hard to tell which way your life is trending. Judge cautiously, since misjudgement is the standing risk. Decisions are difficult because caution and optimism keep undermining each other — whichever gets the upper hand, the other arrives to unsettle it. This is worse if you overextended in the past and had to pull back, since the old loss of confidence resurfaces now. Underneath is a straight conflict between wanting more room and wanting to keep what is safe.
jupiter-conjunction-uranus: Surprises and sudden openings, and a push toward a kind of freedom you have not had before. You may throw over responsibilities, or reach after a youth you feel you missed. The specific hazard is letting down people who are genuinely relying on you; the balance to strike is between what others legitimately ask and your real need to be yourself. Idealism is roused at the same time, and you will find unjust or sordid conditions unusually hard to tolerate, which may draw you into reform of some kind. The other form this takes is straightforward: a sudden break, a windfall, an unexpected opportunity from a quarter you were not watching.
jupiter-sextile-uranus: A wish to change things in ways that lead to knowing and experiencing more. Not usually disruptive, though it does make you impatient with the routine constraints you live under, and you will probably rearrange something in your immediate surroundings to relieve that. Some of the change may happen more or less by itself. Mentally this is exciting: you are drawn to ideas that challenge you productively, and you can take hold of them faster than usual. Old problems often yield now because you can approach them from an angle you had not tried. Science, technique, and social reform all attract, without the revolutionary compulsion of the harder angles.
jupiter-square-uranus: This varies considerably. It can be a bolt from nowhere — a sudden opening that changes your situation significantly. It can equally be restlessness and impatience with restriction sufficient to make you blow something up in the name of getting free. Either way you will see change as the only route forward, which is partly true and partly the trap: the risk is changing for the sake of it, without examining which change would actually help. There is a strong pull toward doing the opposite of whatever you are being pushed toward. In relationships this is disruptive, since anything that holds you to a line will meet hostility.
jupiter-trine-uranus: A strong need to do something other than what you usually do, and to find a kind of freedom you have not had. That may take an inward form — a search for something true at the philosophical or metaphysical level — or an outward one, in a new activity altogether. You are much more receptive to unfamiliar ideas, which is mostly good and worth a small amount of caution, since novelty alone is unusually persuasive. This is one of the transits that keeps a life from settling into a rut. It can also bring a sudden opportunity that appears entirely out of the blue; if one arrives, take it.
jupiter-opposition-uranus: A powerful wish to be released from obligations that you feel have narrowed your life unnecessarily, and the exact transit often coincides with a sudden break — from a person, a job, or simply a way of living. The relief is enormous, and that is precisely why you should look carefully at what is being thrown over: the danger is discarding what was worth keeping along with what was not, which would waste most of the freedom you gain. Relationships that carry obligation are the most affected, and a partnership of either kind may be hard to hold together while this runs.
jupiter-conjunction-neptune: Idealism is roused as it rarely is otherwise, and you approach things with markedly more compassion. People who cannot help themselves attract your sympathy in particular, whether you meet them directly or through some organised effort; the impulse is to help the individual rather than to reform the system that produced their situation. Interest in spiritual and mystical philosophy tends to grow, because the world as ordinarily arranged has stopped meeting your needs. You may find that the ego's own demands are what has been standing between you and what you actually want, and that quieting them slightly is what lets you hear anything else.
jupiter-sextile-neptune: You are unusually concerned with living up to your ideals and will frame your aims in idealistic terms. Less troubled by the darker side of things and better able to appreciate what is good — worth a mild check, so that real problems do not get glossed over. Your own needs feel less pressing than usual, and helping someone worse off gives you a satisfaction that outweighs whatever it costs, which may draw you toward charitable or institutional work. Religious and philosophical concerns run high and may not be satisfied by an orthodox form; you may find a group, or a person who shows you something.
jupiter-square-neptune: You will work hard to make your ideals actual and to find some practical form for what you believe — and the world will offer resistance, requiring you to show that your convictions are not merely impractical abstractions, and that they rest on something real rather than on a dream. This transit is how you find out. Generosity is genuine and freely given, and your discrimination about who receives it is not: some people can be helped and are worth the time, some cannot, and you may be unable to tell them apart. Watch also for the false optimism that makes a foolish risk look reasonable.
jupiter-trine-neptune: The idealistic and possibly the spiritual side of you is stimulated. You look for the subtler forms of what is true and are unusually inclined to enquire directly into things most people leave alone; religious, mystical and philosophical study could bring real insight now. Someone may appear who acts as a teacher or guide in that search, or you may play the part for somebody else. The only caution is against over-idealising such a person, or being over-idealised, since disappointment follows. Compassion runs high and wants to be acted on, and if you need help yourself, it tends to be available.
jupiter-opposition-neptune: Keeping the real and the ideal apart is difficult now. This is a strongly spiritual transit which can make the actual world seem inadequate and send you looking for a better one — usually in speculation and high ideals rather than in anything chemical, though a predisposition can find its outlet here. The practical hazard is a scheme that only looks plausible through extreme optimism: you want to gamble, in the broad sense, and unchecked that can be genuinely costly. A few people handle this well and make apparently wild investments pay, but they are the ones who can calculate the odds. Know which you are.
jupiter-conjunction-pluto: The urge to achieve comes to the front and you will make extraordinary efforts toward success as you personally define it, spending everything you have on it. This transit often coincides with the moment a long effort finally yields. There is a strong drive for power, which may arrive whether or not you were seeking it — and power here means whatever kind is genuinely available to you, which may look modest from outside and matter enormously to you. The drive is difficult to deny, and denied entirely it turns into conflict with authority. Find somewhere legitimate for it to go.
jupiter-sextile-pluto: A period for making creative changes: remaking your immediate surroundings so they express something truer about you, and spending real energy to gain more room to move. You may get some power over other people; if you do, use it for what you and they collectively need, because Pluto is oriented toward the group rather than the individual and purely private use of it tends not to serve you. Some changes may happen around you with little effort of yours — take advantage of them. You may come into favour with somebody in a position to help. The underlying idea is regeneration, at whatever level it reaches you.
jupiter-square-pluto: Ambition is roused and you feel your energies could carry you further than usual — and the effort meets substantial resistance, particularly where your methods will not bear inspection. This can bring success and standing or remove them. Rather than gaining power you may simply provoke a conflict with those who hold it, sometimes entirely innocently. Another form of the same energy is a project to repair, restore or rebuild something, physical or institutional; your aim is improvement and you may still meet opposition from people who disagree or feel threatened. Avoid becoming obsessed with a single plan or course.
jupiter-trine-pluto: You will move to change things, in your own life and in the world you touch, and the question worth asking is in whose name. Power is unusually easy to exert now and openings to take control tend to appear, which is precisely why the motive matters: aimed purely at your own advancement, this produces trouble later and results that do not last. Enlightened self-interest is the working principle — you gain most when your interests are genuinely coupled to those of the people you live and work among, and genuinely is the operative word. The drive to reform and renew is strong; give it something real.
jupiter-opposition-pluto: The culmination of a long drive toward success or power, and it demands caution, because whatever is opposing you is likely to be strong unless you take trouble to conciliate it. This can bring a promotion or real influence over the conditions other people live in. It can equally be the point at which the whole effort comes to nothing against entrenched opposition. There is a pull toward ruthlessness and toward cutting corners, which here specifically risks trouble with authority or the law — do as little as possible to draw that attention. Watch also for the conviction that you alone are right.
jupiter-conjunction-node: Jupiter crosses the axis along which your life is supposed to be developing, and it tends to arrive as enlargement: an opportunity, an introduction, a door held open in roughly the direction you were meant to be walking. This axis has two ends — the accomplished thing you can already do without effort, and the unpractised work that is actually yours to build — and Jupiter's habit is to make both look inviting. The one worth taking now is the one you are not yet good at. Openings of this kind are generous and do not repeat often.
jupiter-sextile-node: A mild, favourable angle on the line of your own development. Something in the direction you have been slow to take becomes easier and more attractive — a chance to study, a person who knows the territory, a suggestion that fits better than you expected. Nothing forces the issue, so the offer can pass unused without anything appearing to have been lost. The one question worth holding is whether what appeals to you now belongs to the new ground or to the old competence. Growth here is generous, and it is still paid for by effort rather than granted.
jupiter-square-node: Expansion and direction pull against each other. What you are being offered is genuinely good and may not be where you are meant to go — Jupiter enlarges whatever it touches, including the well-worn talent it would be easier to keep exercising. The friction usually arrives as an opportunity that flatters an existing strength at exactly the moment you were supposed to be building a new one. Turning down a real chance is uncomfortable and occasionally correct. Watch for the version of yourself that is being invited to grow, and check whether it is the one you have already outgrown.
jupiter-trine-node: An easy and unusually generous view along your own axis. What you have been building shows some return, and the direction of the last stretch of your life becomes visible without anyone forcing you to look. Where the effort has gone into the newer and harder side of yourself, this is where the growth registers, often through someone who arrives to confirm it or open the next stage. Where it has gone into repeating what you already do well, the same clarity shows that, without much sting. Nothing compels anything here; the good conditions simply make the truth cheap to see.
jupiter-opposition-node: Jupiter stands over the settled end of your axis, enlarging the thing you already do effortlessly. That can be extremely comfortable and mildly dangerous: a talent given more room is a talent more likely to run you. Success may arrive now in exactly the area where success is least useful to you, confirming a competence that was meant to be the foundation of something else rather than the whole building. Take what is offered, and notice whether accepting it makes the next step easier or quietly unnecessary. Growth that only repeats what you have already grown is not growth.
jupiter-conjunction-chiron: Jupiter reaches the old injury and does what it does to everything — enlarges it. Sometimes that means the wound is felt at full size for a while, more visible than it has been in years. More often it means the wound acquires a frame: you can see what it has actually cost, what it taught, and what it makes you able to do for someone else. This is a characteristic angle for taking up teaching, healing or advocacy in the exact territory where you were damaged. What is offered is meaning rather than repair; Chiron does not close.
jupiter-sextile-chiron: A generous, low-cost contact with the sore place. Something opens — a conversation, a book, a person, an opportunity to be useful — that lets you make something of the injury rather than merely carry it. Your understanding is available and your defences are not up, which is not a common combination. Someone may need exactly what your history has qualified you to give, or offer you the same in a form you can finally accept. Nothing insists on any of it, which is why the moment usually passes unremarked. It is worth using.
jupiter-square-chiron: The wound is enlarged, and the enlargement is uncomfortable: what has hurt you starts to look like the whole picture rather than part of it, or a conviction built on it becomes something you want to preach. Both are the same inflation. What the angle is actually asking is whether you can make the injury useful without making it your entire philosophy — whether the meaning you draw from it can be tested against something outside itself. Generosity offered from the wound is real and can go badly astray in the choosing. Watch who you are giving it to and why.
jupiter-trine-chiron: An unusually kind angle on old damage. Nothing presses on it, and enough perspective is available that you can see the shape of it whole — what it cost, what it taught, and what it lets you understand about other people. This is a good period to do something with that: to help someone in the same difficulty, to say the thing you normally route around, to take up the work your history actually qualifies you for. What is learned here holds, because it was learned with room to breathe rather than under pressure.
jupiter-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury in someone else, magnified. Somebody arrives carrying openly, and probably at some volume, what you carry quietly — a teacher, a casualty, or both — and the encounter puts your own vulnerability where you can look at it. The generous response is available now and is the right one, provided it does not become a way of managing your own wound by treating theirs. Watch for the impulse to instruct from a place you have not actually healed. What you find yourself telling them is usually addressed to you.
jupiter-conjunction-mc: A culmination: you make a real push toward where you want to be, and it produces results more readily than at almost any other time. You feel better about yourself and confident of handling whatever arrives. Professionally this is often a period of substantial progress — a business expands, work gets recognised, a promotion is quite likely. It is not the peak of a career, which belongs to Saturn in this position; it is the rapid ascent toward it. If the business is your own, the specific caution is expanding faster than your foundations can carry, which is exactly what prosperity tempts you to do.
jupiter-sextile-mc: Confident and benevolent: secure in what you know about yourself and in the direction you are travelling, and still willing to learn, with opportunities to do so. Work and home should both run smoothly, and openings for advancement may appear, occasionally a real position of leadership. Relations with whoever holds power over you are good, which matters for any of that. The confidence is unlikely to curdle into arrogance unless that is already your habit; more likely you will take this as a chance to grow up somewhat. Good for study — law, philosophy and medicine suit it particularly — and for getting in touch with what you actually feel.
jupiter-square-mc: You will try to achieve something that counts in your work, and continuing as you have been will not satisfy you: ambition runs stronger than usual, which is good or bad depending entirely on how you go about it. At best it carries you past limits that were really only fear and lack of confidence, and you find yourself capable of more and willing to work for it. The risk is confidence tipping into overconfidence — your life will not run itself while you attend to more important matters. The extreme form is genuine inflation, attributing to yourself powers well beyond anything you have.
jupiter-trine-mc: Optimism and self-confidence, with a sense that you could do considerably more than you have and a willingness to try. This often coincides with professional success, possibly a promotion. Others look to you to lead, because the confidence is visible and evidently earned. You have a clear idea of where you are going and, unusually, have already mastered the skills and gathered the resources to get there. You may gain financially and are not inclined to fritter it — you will use it to advance. A larger or improved home may follow. Even where nothing visible happens, this is usually an interval of real contentment.
jupiter-opposition-mc: Jupiter at the base of your chart: expansion turned inward, toward home, family and the search for a secure private footing. It may be necessary to look back over your own history to find out what it can tell you about yourself, and that need not be uncomfortable — you are likely to feel good about what you find, and your parents may be able to help. On the material side, a larger or more comfortable home, or land. Improve where you already live if nothing else. What you are actually building is the inner security from which the next move outward is made.
saturn-conjunction-sun: Both fulfilment and difficulty. What you began fourteen years ago, during a period of adversity and low vitality, now either reaches its climax and works, or shows plainly that it failed. Either way this is a stretch of heavy responsibility and hard work — to finish what has succeeded, or to salvage what can be salvaged from what has not. Even where things are going as you wanted, the burden of bringing them to completion restricts your freedom, and you may feel restless under it. Take on nothing new that is not directly part of what you are already carrying.
saturn-sextile-sun: Opportunities for real achievement, none of which will be handed to you. What this offers is the chance to strengthen the parts of your life that will have to withstand pressure later, and it asks for care, responsibility and attention to what you have actually committed to. Not lucky in the ordinary sense; capable of being extremely fortunate if you work at it. What you began at the last conjunction or opposition has come through its first crises and is running smoothly, so many of the goals you set then are now reachable. Recognition may come from people above you. Deserve it.
saturn-square-sun: A critical development. The outside world challenges you at several points and your freedom of movement narrows; vitality is low and discouragement comes easily. Do not struggle too hard against whatever adversity arrives — patience will carry you until your energy returns, where force will not. Anyone in authority over you may prove unreceptive and obstructive; work patiently to bring them round rather than withdrawing or fighting blindly, either of which guarantees the loss. This period connects directly to something you began about seven years ago, now meeting its first serious crisis, and it is harder because the project has been going well.
saturn-trine-sun: Circumstances and your own energies are working together, though it will not feel like luck — just a life that runs and work that comes out right. Without any particular sense of effort you can make real progress, so make as much as possible. If a chance for training or for widening your experience appears, take it: what you build now is the bulwark against the demands that arrive a few years from now. Like the sextile, this is preparation rather than culmination. Either you are laying the ground for a success that comes in nine or ten years, or you are consolidating one you already have.
saturn-opposition-sun: Vitality at a twenty-nine-year low, and adversity from several directions at once. Employers and anyone in authority may oppose your plans; ambitions get blocked by circumstance even where everyone concerned means well. This is not a good period for reaching your goals, and it is a very good one for conserving what you have. People commonly feel old under this transit whatever their actual age, with a heavy world-weariness attached. Take your health seriously and avoid real strain, particularly if you are older. The exhaustion is genuine and temporary; you will have plenty of use for your energy later, whatever it feels like now.
saturn-conjunction-moon: A period demanding introspection and self-examination, and often accompanied by loneliness and depression. Saturn stands for your sense of what is real and where you fit in it, and carries an ideal of order and rectitude; measured against that ideal you become severely self-critical, and where you fall short, confidence goes and a sense of inadequacy takes its place. The Moon stands for the opposite need — for nourishment, belonging, and being treated humanely. Saturn's strict accounting does not sit well with that, and the danger of this transit is exactly there. How you handle it has consequences for your well-being for years.
saturn-sextile-moon: Discipline and self-control, which makes it easier to deal with the emotionally complicated matters you usually go around. A difficult relationship you could not handle before can be handled now with genuine detachment: you can look at what you feel without being run by it, and make changes in your private life with reasonable confidence that you are seeing clearly. The Moon is your past and Saturn what you are building, so this angle lets you build constructively on what you came from. Anything undertaken now should connect to your own history; this is not the moment for a break with it. Family matters, and parents, may come to the front.
saturn-square-moon: Difficult for your personal and domestic life. Loneliness and a sense of being cut off are common, sometimes with a conviction that you do not deserve to be loved, or guilt about not having lived up to your own expectations. Externally, emotional communication seems to shut down, and your work may make demands that force you to neglect home, or the reverse. Parents may be a concern.
