In your dealings with people, be as clear and straightforward as you can possibly manage. Leave nobody in any doubt about your intentions, because where a misunderstanding is available it will be taken, and misunderstanding turns readily into mistrust and then into opposition.
neptune-conjunction-moon: Considerable change in your emotional life, hard to handle at first and workable if you take the trouble. Sensitivity to everything around you increases sharply — this is one of the genuinely psychic transits, and the difficulty is that your conscious mind has no idea what to do with the material arriving, so it gets misread. The characteristic trouble is being confused about your own feelings: believing you feel one way while something quite different is actually happening. Sasportas notes the other cost — people in difficulty find their way to you now, and you can be drained by it unless you learn to say no.
neptune-sextile-moon: Emotional sensitivity rises and you become much more aware of what other people are feeling — often intuitively, without being told. That is useful and expensive: in this state you are influenced by whatever mood you stand next to, so avoid company that is negative and unwilling to look at itself. Even where you cannot put the perception into words, the gut-level understanding is unusually accurate. If you make anything, the imagination is much more active and will help the work; if you do not, you will still be more imaginative than usual. The one thing to watch is drifting into endless daydream.
neptune-square-moon: Strange moods, and hunches that feel entirely reliable. Be careful: the unconscious is speaking loudly now and it does not speak the language of the conscious mind, so the hunches can mislead badly. You are also more porous than usual — stand near anyone in the grip of a strong feeling and you will take it on. Avoid people running on strong negative emotion, and avoid anyone inclined to steer you by suggestion and implication, because what they plant will feel like it came from inside you. Domestic difficulties are common. Take nothing you feel at face value for a while.
neptune-trine-moon: Sensitivity to everything around you increases, particularly to what other people are feeling and to some extent to what they are thinking. This is strongly intuitive, and the impressions you get about a situation will be remarkably accurate. At the same time you want experience that goes past the surface, and the same sensitivity makes that easy. Compassion runs high — you feel other people's difficulties so exactly that you want to get involved and help, which is good, provided you first check that help is actually wanted. Underneath it is an awareness of the fundamental connectedness of things, which you will want to act on.
neptune-opposition-moon: Odd moods and fixations that will make your life difficult if you take them at face value or too seriously. Your perception is not sharp now and you see things as you would prefer them, not as they are — which is why psychic and spiritual study, usually valuable, should be approached with real caution here, since it is easily misunderstood or misused. Often this marks weariness with the world and a wish to be out of it, and a teaching can serve as the excuse. Feelings deceive: idealising someone out of all proportion and then insisting the picture is accurate is the classic form.
neptune-conjunction-mercury: Difficult, because the two principles have almost nothing in common. Your logical faculties get scrambled and you are no longer sure what you think about anything, or you fall under the influence of ideas you would previously have refused. The worst use of this transit is to reorganise your life with it — Mercury's ordering function and Neptune's dissolving one are so at odds that whatever arrangement you make will not make sense to you or anyone else afterwards. A poor time for important decisions, and for business, since you are quite likely poorly informed about what is actually going on.
neptune-sextile-mercury: Imagination is stimulated productively: inspiration arrives, and you grasp ideas that are ordinarily too subtle for the intellect — and, unusually, you can convey them to other people. Genuinely creative conditions if you write, paint or compose. Any latent psychic capacity may be activated, and at minimum your sensitivity rises enough that you understand what people are trying to tell you rather than only what they manage to say. Sasportas puts it well: this is one of the rare periods when the reasoning half and the feeling half operate as a team rather than at cross purposes. The ordinary world may look dull by comparison.
neptune-square-mercury: The challenge is keeping your thinking straight, inside your own head and with other people. The quality of your mind is being tested, and any loose end in it becomes a real source of trouble; anything you have never quite thought through will now produce confusion across several areas at once. Avoid important decisions, particularly about your work and your general direction, since you are unlikely to be seeing all the relevant factors. Avoid buying and selling too: you may be operating on a misconception, acting from a compulsion you cannot see, or dealing with someone who is not honest.
neptune-trine-mercury: One of the most imaginative periods of a life, and unusually, one in which you can still tell the difference between what you are imagining and what is there — which is not true of the harder Neptune–Mercury contacts. If you have ever wanted to write, this is the time to attempt it, bearing in mind that a transit can only stimulate a capacity that already exists. What makes this fertile is that the reasoning mind and the intuitive one, which normally work against each other, are for once cooperating. The same sensitivity extends to your dealings with people, who become considerably easier to read.
neptune-opposition-mercury: Thinking and communication are the problem areas for the duration. You are more liable to confusion now than at any other time, which makes this a genuinely dangerous period for important decisions: either you misread the circumstances, or you are missing facts, or someone has misled you about them. Be very careful that what you say is clear, and clarify to yourself anything you do not understand, because misunderstanding is the standing hazard and turns unpleasant quickly. Strange ideas have unusual purchase and delusion is hard to identify from inside. The principles that have served you until now are more reliable than the new ones.
neptune-conjunction-venus: The idealistic side of you is stimulated beautifully and you see beauty in everything. For anyone who makes things this is among the most powerful transits there is: the imagination supplies image after image to work from, and even if you make nothing, art and music enter your life. But the crucial distinction is that this brings the beautiful image and not the beauty itself. You have an ideal in your mind and you project it — onto a situation, onto a person — and it is not yet real. You have to make the fact, as an artist makes a work. Believing the ideal has already arrived is where the trouble starts.
neptune-sextile-venus: The creative imagination is stimulated and the mood turns pleasantly dreamy, which is excellent for making anything and poor for practicality. Colour, form and design all register more finely, so surround yourself with something worth looking at even if you produce nothing. In relationships you will idealise whoever you are attached to and handle their less ideal features badly — the transit may in fact bring something genuinely romantic, and your view of it will not be realistic. The effect is mild enough that you can adjust afterwards without much damage. Do not commit to anything on the strength of the picture alone.
neptune-square-venus: Unrealistic attitudes in your relationships cause trouble, and disappointment here can reach into your domestic life. You are inclined to avoid the truth about yourself and about how things actually stand, and the reluctance sets up a fall that costs you confidence as well as the relationship. What is being tested is your ability to accept people as they are. If someone new appears you may be swept off your feet — not by them but by something in you that you are projecting onto them — and finding out who they actually are may be hard to accept, even though there is nothing wrong with the reality. Attraction to the unattainable is the specific hazard.
neptune-trine-venus: The romantic imagination is strongly stimulated, which may bring an unusually romantic attachment, or may open creative capacities you did not know you had. The image of this transit is the beautiful dream, and the useful thing about the trine is that you can actually make the dream real, provided you accept that a dream becomes real through work. If an attachment does begin it will be more idealised than anything in your experience — a sense of perfect union, of a most exact ideal met. You will eventually see the flaws, and this transit tends to widen your understanding enough that you can accept them.
neptune-opposition-venus: Relationships cause trouble, because one of you holds an unrealistic view of what is going on. When the romantic weather lifts and the actual situation appears, disillusion follows. Everybody idealises a new attachment somewhat; that is part of the ordinary process. What makes this transit severe is the unwillingness to let reality in at all. You are looking for someone who can carry you out of the everyday into something more magical, and you have to choose from the human race, in which people who could sustain that are extremely rare. So the image gets built and a particular person is required to fit it, usually well past the point where the evidence has stopped cooperating.
neptune-conjunction-mars: A poor moment to strike out on your own behalf. Energy is low and discouragement comes easily, and the two principles are almost directly opposed: Mars is the drive to assert yourself and take your place, and Neptune quietly removes the ground it stands on. Whatever you attempt along those lines will be hard to push through, not because you are unlucky but because the follow-through is not there; efforts come out half-hearted, and even where you want the thing you may simply be too tired. What this is good for is anything undertaken with no self-interest attached — service, care, work that asks nothing back.
neptune-sextile-mars: Winning and getting your own way stop mattering much. What concerns you instead is whether your life serves anything beyond itself, and whether your own individuality has a place in a larger arrangement. So you are likely to work alongside others toward something shared, possibly of a religious or philosophical kind, and to stay out of the front of it — pushing yourself forward would disturb a peace that matters more to you now. A period for reflection rather than action. As the ego's demands quieten, you begin to hear the smaller voices underneath, and may find that much of your furious activity meant less than you assumed.
neptune-square-mars: This challenges your sense of who you are, the course you have set, and your picture of yourself as someone effective. The specific danger is being set up to lose — at work or at home, sometimes by someone who arranges matters so that you must act without knowing what is actually going on. Expect little reinforcement from anyone, which means you will have to supply your own. Stay clear of dubious schemes and check that anything you commit to is real; avoid anything you know to be dishonest, since you will almost certainly lose and lose face with it. Defeats here are informative, not final.
neptune-trine-mars: One of the few Mars transits that does not raise physical energy. You may want to do very little, and you will not be self-assertive — but you will not feel weak or inferior either, as you may under the harder Mars–Neptune contacts. What you get instead is a genuine capacity for self-sacrifice: you can work with real concern for other people because your own ego needs are quiet, and you can manage on remarkably little. A good stretch for charitable work, or for looking at your life and the world as they are without judging either. The one trap is casting yourself as somebody's saviour, which is the subtlest ego trip available.
neptune-opposition-mars: Be careful in several directions and keep your expectations modest. Do not get drawn into anything bogus — this combination has an old association with deceitful action, and you can appear in it as either the victim or the perpetrator. Scrutinise every apparent opportunity and stay away from anything speculative. Do not attempt any deception yourself, not only on principle but because schemes rarely work out under this transit. Watch your health as well: this can produce the debilitating sort of complaint that simply leaves you tired all the time, and the tiredness is easy to mistake for a verdict on your life.
neptune-conjunction-jupiter: One of the most idealistic passages of a life. Sympathy is roused and wants to be acted on — helping someone close who needs it, or working with people who are ill or disadvantaged. It also pushes you to make your convictions actual: believing something is no longer enough, you want it to be true in practice. The corresponding risk is believing that what you want to be true already is. Philosophy and religion may start to interest you, and questions about how you fit into the larger order; you may find the ordinary business of daily life tedious by comparison, which is where the transit starts costing you something.
neptune-sextile-jupiter: A strong appetite for a particular kind of knowledge. You are still interested in what the reasoning mind can tell you, and you also want the subtler sort of understanding that gives a life dimension. That may take you toward metaphysics, occult study, or a religious group that offers real insight; some people go the other way and abandon the whole apparatus of knowledge for pure faith. All these paths turn out to have the same destination. On a plainer level it may stir an interest in places entirely unlike your own, and travel undertaken now is unusually rewarding because your sense of wonder about the unfamiliar is intact.
neptune-square-jupiter: You will be impatient with the restrictions of ordinary existence and preoccupied with whatever helps you escape it. What is being tested is your grasp of what you can and cannot actually do, and accepting the real limits matters — if you can, this transit genuinely expands your life by showing you the possibilities inside your actual situation, imperfect as it is. The fantasy usually takes the form of an inflated belief in your own strength. Give in to it and the day arrives when you lose badly, and the overconfidence turns into discouragement of the same size. Avoid speculation and risk altogether.
neptune-trine-jupiter: Optimistic and hopeful about what is coming, and not deluded about it — under this transit you gain the kind of insight that actually improves things. You feel idealistic and are simultaneously concerned to understand, so the idealism does not obstruct your view of the truth. Truth matters now, not so much facts as how things work. The only caution is against making it so abstract that you cannot meet it in daily life. Philosophy, metaphysics and occult study all repay effort, and you want to understand what you are studying rather than be told the conclusion.
neptune-opposition-jupiter: Inflated expectation, impractical idealism and abrupt disappointment are the standing hazards unless you make a deliberate effort to stay grounded. You feel that nothing can defeat you, extraordinarily fortunate, and inclined to take risks you would normally refuse — financial ones above all. Any form of speculation is dangerous here and should be left alone. The same overconfidence can make you overlook a factor at work or at home that later trips you badly. Underneath, your genuine idealism is roused: the limits of the actual world are hard to bear because you want it so much better than it is.
neptune-conjunction-saturn: Difficult, confusing, and at times close to despairing, with a considerable brighter side worth working toward. You discover that your picture of the world is in several ways wrong — sometimes through plain disappointment, more often through an anxiety with no identifiable cause. Fear and loss of confidence are the hardest features; you may become afraid of things that threaten nobody else, as though disoriented. Saturn is the structure you give your world, Neptune the disclosure that there are other orders of reality besides yours. When the second reaches the first, reality itself gets confusing. Sasportas adds the sharpest point: Neptune dissolves the defences over exactly where you feel weakest.
neptune-sextile-saturn: The ideal and the actual are well balanced, which puts you in an unusually good position to think about how they relate. Ask what is genuinely true for you, and then what you would like to be true; here you can tell them apart without the usual confusion. You can also see what would actually bring the ideal a little closer, and make it a solid part of your life rather than a private wish. You are not impatient now, and considerably more willing to accept what is real. There is no contest between the real and the ideal at this angle, and no need to have one.
neptune-square-saturn: Insecurity and anxiety without an apparent cause; your grip on things seems to be slipping and you feel disoriented. Whatever your material circumstances, this is ultimately a psychological transit — it works by altering your mood and your view, and any problem you have now most likely originates there. That is the first thing to grasp: handle its effect on your consciousness and you can handle the rest. The main difficulty is a growing doubt about whether you are adequate to your own life, and a wish to withdraw from everything, which is the wrong move — you need other perspectives to balance a view this pessimistic.
neptune-trine-saturn: Idealism and reality are in balance, which lets you work hard and practically at making your ideals actual. You understand exactly what is true for you and can operate inside that structure while changing it. Your attitude is not pessimistic; experience has taught you what you need and what you do not, and you are reluctant to take on possessions that are pleasant to own and complicate your life. Others may read that as austerity. Excellent conditions for psychic, spiritual and occult study, because your sense of reality is now robust enough to take the disorienting shock such subjects deliver to most people.
neptune-opposition-saturn: Significant, and rarely pleasant. Some part of your reality is severely challenged, in a way that leaves you unable to tell for a while what is actually so. Your sense of proportion distorts: you give great weight to what does not deserve it — usually whatever frightens you — and overlook what matters. Fear and anxiety without identifiable cause are the main feature, and the thing to hold onto throughout is that matters are almost certainly not as bad as they look. Underneath the fear something valuable is happening: your perception of reality is being radically altered so that a larger version can be experienced.
neptune-conjunction-uranus: Because Uranus travels faster than Neptune, this arrives later and later in a life as the decades pass, and most people who meet it at all meet it in old age. What it brings is close to the Uranus–Neptune conjunction in character: an unusually permeable period in which entirely unfamiliar states and ideas become available, some of them illuminating and some simply disorienting. Sasportas reads the late timing directly — one part of you fears the ending of things while another senses that the moment has come to disengage from ordinary life and let go of what is known. Both are present, and neither is the whole of it.
neptune-sextile-uranus: Interest is roused in states of being outside the ordinary. You become aware that life has a dimension you had not been accounting for, and you want to know everything about it. If you are firmly rooted in the material world and treat as real only what can be handled, you may be surprised to find yourself concerned with principles and abstractions, and even discover that you hold ideals you would stand up for, having always thought of yourself as a pragmatist. If you were never much interested in material concerns, this simply takes you further in. Consciousness genuinely widens here, and without much cost.
neptune-square-uranus: Sudden shifts of mood, and opinions that change abruptly. You are repeatedly exposed to other dimensions of reality that you have long half-suspected mattered and been reluctant to acknowledge. At the plainest level, something you have been keeping quiet may be revealed — or something somebody has been keeping from you — and the first reaction will be upset rather than relief, because you did not want to deal with it. Dealt with, it improves things considerably, since the secret was limiting you. At another level this exposes you to truths about yourself you have not been willing to look at.
neptune-trine-uranus: The urge toward freedom and the urge toward dissolution agree for once, and the result is a genuine widening of what you can take in. Ideas that would have seemed too strange or too abstract become both interesting and usable, and insight arrives without the disorientation the harder angles produce. This is good ground for any study that opens the world up — metaphysics, the occult, anything that shows you a different order of things — and for putting what you find to actual use rather than merely admiring it. Nothing here compels anything, which is why the whole passage can slide by unremarked.
neptune-opposition-uranus: A large revolution in consciousness. You are exposed to aspects of life you never supposed possible, and once you have understood them your view of reality has to change. The revelation can arrive with enough force that you take up a philosophy or a movement dedicated to remaking the world in the light of it — occult study, astrology, altered states, a group with radical and idealistic aims. What is actually happening is that new understanding is asserting itself hard enough to seem to overturn everything you previously thought. That is a problem of vantage rather than of substance; you are in the middle of it and cannot yet see how the two connect.
neptune-conjunction-neptune: This happens to nobody except in the first year of life, when Neptune stations and crosses its own place again. As an early signature it marks an experience of sacrifice or loss right at the beginning — to some degree true for everyone, since being born means giving up the undivided oneness of the womb, and more sharply true where a mother was for any reason unable to provide what an infant needs. Sasportas reads it as being made to relinquish something that was yours by right, very early, before there was any self to understand the loss.
neptune-sextile-neptune: This falls at around your first Saturn return, and the two work together. It is an awakening to what your life is actually about. Until now you have been establishing who you are among adults, and by this point you probably know; you may also have discovered that what you are doing with your life is not entirely right — that you were driven by too narrow a picture of yourself, by a need for security, or by ordinary ego. Because Saturn is returning at the same time, and Saturn is material reality, you begin to see the whole thing in a wider frame. Then arrange to live according to what you have seen.
neptune-square-neptune: Part of the crisis of middle age, arriving at about forty-two. You are likely to question your life intensely — your aims, and how far you have actually lived up to what you believe — and depending on the answer, to want to change things. The difficulty is that Neptune supplies the worst conditions for making well-considered changes. There is a real risk of going off in pursuit of a dream that is unreachable and, on inspection, not worth reaching. Use the period for self-examination, which is exactly what it is for, and hold off on acting; the ideas you are working from are only half formed, and at this age you have probably persuaded yourself otherwise.
neptune-trine-neptune: Arriving in the mid-fifties, this is the gentler counterpart of the crisis at forty-two. The same questions about ideals and how far you have honoured them are present, without the pressure and without the temptation to act half-formed. What has actually been learned since then can be seen clearly now, including the parts where the dream was worth abandoning. This is a good stretch for spiritual or contemplative practice of any kind, and for the sort of quiet reassessment that holds afterwards because it was not made under duress. Compassion is available, including toward the version of yourself who got it wrong.
neptune-opposition-neptune: Nobody meets this before their mid-eighties. It arrives near the Uranus return and shares much of its significance: the old categories of living stop carrying real meaning. Consciousness heightens, though the first sensation is confusion, and the lessons here are only available to someone willing to be patient and let things be revealed rather than demanding them. The general effect is a blurring of divisions — an ability to see relationships between things you had never connected, and a better grasp of how thoroughly everything is of a piece. Greater empathy comes with it, and the capacity to stand somewhere other than your own place.
neptune-conjunction-pluto: This has not happened to anyone since the 1890s and will not happen again for a very long time, because the two planets have been travelling in near-step for the whole of the modern period. Where it does fall, it marks the meeting of the dissolving power and the regenerating one at the same degree — the point at which an entire order of belief goes into solution before anything is rebuilt. It is a generational signature rather than a personal one, and the last people to carry it were shaped by it collectively rather than individually.
neptune-sextile-pluto: A great deal of the life you have known passes out of existence, leaving you positioned to begin again at a different level. This is unlikely to be troublesome under any circumstances, and it is least troublesome if you do not try to hold onto whatever is going. Everything decays in order to be reborn somewhere else; this is your turn in that cycle. Much of what happens will come from larger social forces rather than from anything you did, and you still have to answer it in your own daily life. Beliefs you have held all your life may prove invalid, without your losing your bearings.
neptune-square-pluto: Subtle psychological change with consequences that may be dramatic or may be entirely invisible to anyone else. Either way you are changing inwardly, and it shows up in what you value: things that mattered stop mattering. The process brings real tension, because you will feel pressures and compulsions surging in you that you have not felt before, which is disconcerting. This is particularly unsettling if you have habitually stood back and let other people have their way at your expense — the new demands feel like they belong to somebody else. They do not. They are the part of you that was set aside, arriving late and at full volume.
neptune-trine-pluto: Interest sharpens in the hidden forces actually operating in your life. That may draw you into a group or a practice devoted to understanding them, or simply into a private investigation. Often it starts from dissatisfaction: a sense that you have not managed your life well and want to understand the compulsions that everyone experiences and few people can account for. Those are emotionally rooted drives that operate without the conscious mind's permission and produce behaviour that does not fit the situation. Wanting to change that is what makes this a good moment to begin therapy. Mystical and occult interests often arrive alongside, from the same root.
neptune-opposition-pluto: Most people alive now meet this in their early sixties or later. It marks encounters that transform parts of your life, most often through disappearance — people, circumstances or possessions you had grown used to simply going. You will also meet forces that try to show you what you have long kept hidden from yourself, and you will probably resist, on the grounds that nothing constructive could come of looking. What such a transit usually reveals is the material you were taught to regard as bad. It is generally a source of real energy, and because you refuse to own it, the energy is wasted and runs outside your control.
neptune-conjunction-node: Neptune reaches the axis of your direction and dissolves its outline. What you thought you were working toward loses definition — not because it was wrong, but because the version of it you were holding was too specific, too much a picture and too little a direction. Often something you had been aiming at simply comes to nothing, and the disappointment is the mechanism rather than the setback. What replaces it is vaguer and larger. Expect to be unable to say clearly where you are going for a while, and expect that inability to be more accurate than the certainty it replaced.
neptune-sextile-node: A soft contact with the line of your own development, arriving as an intuition rather than an event. Something about where you are supposed to be going becomes briefly legible in a way you could not argue for — a sense of direction rather than a plan. It costs nothing and proves nothing, and it is easy to talk yourself out of afterwards. Worth noting down, since what is available now is not evidence but orientation. Neptune supplies no schedules. What it does supply here is the feeling of which way is forward, and that is not nothing.
neptune-square-node: Your ideals and your actual direction pull against each other in a way that is genuinely hard to see clearly. Something you believe in argues persuasively for a course that happens to avoid the harder work — sacrifice offered where effort was required, a spiritual reason found for a practical evasion. Neptune specialises in exactly this substitution, and it does not feel like evasion from inside. The useful question is not whether your motive is noble but whether the direction is yours. Where you cannot tell, wait: this is a period for examination rather than for acting on what you find.
neptune-trine-node: An unusually clear intuition of your own direction, arriving without pressure and without much to argue about. What you are for becomes briefly apparent, generally as a feeling of fit rather than a conclusion you could defend — and where recent years have gone into the newer and harder side of yourself, the sense of rightness is genuine rather than wishful. Compassion and direction agree here, which they do not always. A good stretch for contemplative work, and for letting a decision settle rather than forcing it. What is understood now tends to hold, because nothing was demanded of it.
neptune-opposition-node: Neptune stands over the accomplished end of your axis and starts dissolving it. The practised competence you have relied on begins to feel unreal, or simply stops satisfying — the achievement is intact and the meaning has drained out of it. That is disorienting and it is not a mistake. What has been outgrown does not always announce itself by failing; sometimes it announces itself by continuing to work while ceasing to matter. Do not conclude too fast that the answer is elsewhere. Notice first that the old ground has gone soft, which is usually the whole message.
neptune-conjunction-chiron: Neptune reaches the old injury and softens its edges, which cuts both ways. At best the wound stops being a hard particular thing and becomes something you can feel compassion about, in yourself and in other people — the boundary between your damage and everybody's damage genuinely thins. At worst the same dissolution makes the injury impossible to locate: a diffuse sadness with no object, or an identification with suffering in general that quietly excuses you from dealing with your own. Both are available. What distinguishes them is whether the compassion has an address.
neptune-sextile-chiron: A gentle, permeable contact with the sore place. Sympathy is available — for yourself, unusually, as well as for anyone else in the same position — and the defences that normally guard the area are simply not up. That makes this a good moment for anything contemplative aimed at the injury, and for accepting care that your particular damage usually makes hard to take. Nothing insists, and the whole passage can go by unnoticed. What is on offer is not repair; Chiron does not repair. It is a temporary suspension of the effort of holding the thing at a distance.
neptune-square-chiron: Something dissolves the defences around the injury at exactly the wrong moment, and what surfaces is diffuse rather than specific — a general helplessness, a sense of being wounded in a way you cannot name or address. The temptation is to make it meaningful: to read the pain as a calling, to cast yourself as the one who suffers for others, to find in the wound a reason not to act. Sasportas is precise about the mechanism, that martyrdom can carry real compensations. Watch what the suffering is buying. Where it buys nothing, it is simply pain, and can be treated as such.
neptune-trine-chiron: The old damage becomes permeable without becoming overwhelming. You can feel it without defending against it, and feel it in other people at the same time, which is the particular gift here: the wound stops being only yours. That makes this good ground for any work — formal or otherwise — where your own history is what qualifies you, and for the kind of quiet practice that changes your relationship to a thing rather than removing it. Chiron does not close; what alters is what it costs to carry. Here it costs less, and what you understand about it tends to last.
neptune-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury dissolved into somebody else. Someone arrives carrying, diffusely and often helplessly, what you carry precisely — and the boundary between their trouble and yours will be genuinely hard to find. That is the difficulty and the opportunity together. Real compassion is available and so is a complete loss of proportion, in which you take on what is not yours and call it kindness. The test is whether you can be moved by someone without merging with them. Where you cannot, the help does neither of you any good, whatever it feels like at the time.
neptune-conjunction-mc: This can have a powerful and lasting effect on your direction, and on how you see yourself. Very commonly it brings sudden confusion to someone who had a perfectly clear idea of what they were doing: the way seemed obvious and now you feel lost. If you can, avoid permanent decisions about your work or long-term course while it runs. The characteristic feelings are that what you have been doing is inadequate, that your work is too confining, that you are too taken up with the merely practical. A romantic and idealised alternative may appear entirely plausible now and look ridiculous later.
neptune-sextile-mc: You are likely to change your objectives in a way your friends find hopelessly impractical and you find the only way to give your life real meaning. Both views are probably partly right, which makes your task striking the balance: no way of living will serve you unless it can be made to work in the actual world, however little the actual world interests you just now. Often this brings a new interest in spiritual or metaphysical matters, usually of a direct-experience kind rather than an orthodox one. What it teaches, at its best, is that the ego has to get out of the way before it can be any use.
neptune-square-mc: Confusing and full of doubt, especially if you were not secure about your direction to begin with. You will ask fundamental questions about what you are actually trying to do with your life — and if, like most people, you have not been living entirely for your own objectives, you will probably conclude that the whole thing is pointless. Even at best you will question the plan. With other people you may find it hard to hold your ground, because you are questioning it yourself, and may end up letting yourself be treated badly for want of confidence. Watch particularly for making yourself into a victim in order to attract sympathy.
neptune-trine-mc: You are likely to put the practical and material side of things second in favour of understanding, which is genuinely positive as long as you do not lose your grip on the actual world altogether. Stay connected to it without letting it fill your whole horizon. Service becomes more central: caring for someone close, or working through an institution with people who need it, or in some cases changing your work entirely toward that end. Nursing, social work and their relatives all fit the symbolism. What happens underneath is that personal satisfaction becomes identified with service, so recognition stops being the point.
neptune-opposition-mc: The danger here is that the props go out from under you. In your work, or in whatever matters most, something may happen that makes it very hard to continue as you were — and it will be difficult to see coming and difficult to describe even while it is happening. It may take the form of a psychological crisis, a sense that you simply cannot go on, in which you feel weak and ineffective for reasons nobody else can identify. Or events in your private life may make it impossible to work with your usual confidence. Domestic difficulty, or someone close saying discouraging things, is the common form.
pluto-conjunction-sun: A period of great change in which you will strive as you never have and refuse to let obstacles stop you. Pluto is elimination and rebirth — the removal of what is genuinely finished so that something can be built — and with it on your Sun you become the agent of that. Two limits apply. The drive is enormous and it only works for clearing away what is actually outworn, not for whatever you happen to want. And the force is impersonal: used purely for your own advancement it turns on you. Sasportas is blunt about the cost — this is where a version of yourself dies.
pluto-sextile-sun: Subtle forces are at work that let you make real changes and act more effectively than at almost any other time. Openings appear to take on more responsibility and some authority over others, but nothing here compels you — no circumstance and no inner pressure will force your hand, so the whole passage can go by unused unless you deliberately take hold of it. A good period to establish yourself with anyone in a position of power, since they can supply the opportunity. Working with a group or an institution suits this better than working alone: Plutonian force is more effective collectively than personally.
pluto-square-sun: A test of your strength and of how firmly you have established yourself, and it requires that you actually know who you are. Where you do not, this brings crises that change your life substantially. One common form is a test of self-control: ambition and the appetite for power are stimulated out of all proportion, and any ruthlessness in you will surface — while forces in your world work hard to stop you. Overcoming them by force would take more ruthlessness than you can afford. The alternative is to know exactly what you need, go after that, and let the rest be negotiable.
pluto-trine-sun: You arrive at this with a strong sense of having survived what was thrown at you and reached a level where you can actually be effective — and you can, if you make the effort. This transit will deliver even to someone entirely passive, and it repays working with deliberately. You can express yourself more powerfully and completely than at almost any other time, and people register you as effective and respect it. A good period for advancement, including being handed real power inside an organisation to reform something. You will be seen not as a revolutionary but as someone who gets things done.
pluto-opposition-sun: Difficult for relationships of every kind, because power struggles are likely. Either you try to force someone onto a course they have not chosen, or somebody tries it on you. If you are the one doing it, stop, whatever your reasons — you may be certain you are acting for their good, and it is more likely that you simply cannot leave the thing alone. An excessive appetite for interfering is the characteristic fault here. If you are on the receiving end it is harder, because at some level, probably unconsciously, you have signalled that it is permitted.
pluto-conjunction-moon: Extremely powerful emotional change, affecting your home, your family and the deepest part of your psychological life. The feelings raised are raw and urgent, and the intensity of what you find in yourself may surprise you; making yourself deal with it is the hard part. Pluto is breakdown and reconstruction, and the Moon is precisely the region you rely on to be stable and supportive while you deal with everything else. That region is now in acute transformation, which is why this transit carries the weight it does. Sasportas's phrase for the whole process is a descent, followed by a return.
pluto-sextile-moon: A chance to get properly in touch with your own emotional workings and experience what you actually feel — including your real motives and the basis of the compulsions you cannot usually account for. The feelings are profound and intense without being difficult, which is what makes this so useful: you can learn about parts of yourself that are normally hidden from you as much as from anyone. Excellent for any serious study of how people work, and you will not have to keep it abstract, since your ordinary dealings will carry more depth than usual. Changes at home often follow, and reflect the interior ones.
pluto-square-moon: Intense experience in your emotional and personal life, and a test of your innermost workings — you may have to dig further into yourself than you ever have to get the answers. Old behaviour patterns, entirely inadequate to the present, get dredged up, along with memories that turn out still to be operating. Driven by compulsions you cannot see, you may do things you would not do if you were clear. Deep change is under way and should not be swept aside. In your personal life expect an emotional power struggle, conducted subversively — through guilt, jealousy, obligation — rather than in the open.
pluto-trine-moon: A period of profound experience that should be genuinely good for your development. You want your life to be deeper and more emotionally rewarding, and are no longer satisfied living at the surface: what you have only understood you now want to feel. Your understanding deepens correspondingly, being built on intuition as well as reasoning. This affects your relationships and may well bring an important new one, sexual or not, which will be emotionally serious and a real education about your own psyche. Existing attachments acquire far more content than they have had and become a source of self-discovery.
pluto-opposition-moon: Extreme emotional confrontation, in which you and someone else attempt to manage each other by feeling. In an attachment either of you may use guilt, jealousy or the threat of leaving to force the other into something. Or the relationship may simply be too possessive, with one of you allowing the other no room to be a separate person — and pressure of that kind builds to an explosion the relationship may not survive. Often the motives are good. You may be smothering someone while believing it is love, and they may sense only that something is badly wrong and feel guilty for sensing it.
pluto-conjunction-mercury: An educational period, in the strong sense. Your ideas about a good many things may change radically, or you may find yourself working to bring other people round to yours; either way, thinking and exchange take on real weight. Your concern for the truth deepens and you want the bottom of any question that matters to you, which makes this excellent for research or investigation, particularly into what is hidden. Perception sharpens. And once you have your position, you can make it carry — this transit gives real power to influence, which is a responsibility rather than a convenience.
pluto-sextile-mercury: Good conditions for deep intellectual probing. If you need to find something out, this is the time: perception is keen, and you are in the right frame of mind to be exhaustive about it, unsatisfied by any partial answer. The same applies inward — an unusually good period for examining your own mind and what actually makes it work. Communication takes on a heavier register; you value exchange that means something and have no appetite for banter. Your ordinary daily traffic with the world becomes the vehicle for discoveries that will eventually change how you think altogether.
pluto-square-mercury: Either your ideas about the world get seriously challenged, or your thinking deepens enough to handle material that would previously have been beyond you — often both. In the second case you will probably try to convince other people, and your ordinary exchanges can turn into intense encounters as you press your convictions on them from a sense of your own rightness, or as somebody does the same to you. The issue is knowing precisely where your limits are and what you actually think, and letting other people's views exist alongside yours. Where experience invalidates an old belief, do not pretend otherwise.
pluto-trine-mercury: Insight deepens and you can learn a great deal about whatever you take up. Your positions become subtler, so that ideas you had only grasped superficially are properly understood. A good period to begin studying something, and you will be most drawn to whatever explains things at depth, particularly what is hidden. You may also meet someone with a powerful effect on your thinking — a friend who changes how you see, or a teacher who opens something up. You can be taught now, and you can teach: your words carry more weight because the depth behind them is visible.
pluto-opposition-mercury: Communication becomes difficult where its purpose is to coerce rather than to inform. Coercion produces resistance, and resistance ends the exchange altogether. Let people think what they think. If you are on the receiving end of somebody else's coercion you will have to stand up for your position, so examine your ideas thoroughly first and know exactly where their strengths lie — and remember there is nothing wrong with changing a position that turns out to need changing. Avoid fanatical certainty, and avoid the company of people who deal in it, since you can be possessed by a conviction of very little real content.
pluto-conjunction-venus: This affects your attachments and your erotic life considerably. If you have no current relationship it may bring one, intense and not necessarily smooth, possibly with a genuinely obsessive quality. Whatever begins here will not be lukewarm — you will be entirely in it or not at all — because you are not treating love as part of ordinary life but as something that could transform the whole of it. That is a great deal to ask, and it may be delivered. What drives the choice, though, is compulsive rather than reasoned: unconscious patterns will have far more say in who you pick than any judgement about what you need.
pluto-sextile-venus: Existing attachments deepen and become more serious, and a new friendship or love may arrive that matters. Your relationships generally become less routine, and through them you can change your life and understand a great deal more about how you actually operate with people. None of this needs to be feared: the process is comparatively gentle and mostly increases what you get from the people you care about. Your capacity for enjoyment is heightened too, and everything is approached with more intensity. Whatever begins here will carry a depth of feeling that may surprise you.
pluto-square-venus: Your relationships become a source of challenge, and point toward changes you have to make in yourself. Something will change — an old attachment transformed, or a significant new one — and several difficulties come with it. The desire for love is strong and urgent, and in the haste you may take the first person available rather than someone who would suit you, then become so fascinated that you cannot see them at all. What is actually driving this is not operating in your interest. Even a settled and happy marriage can be disrupted by a fascination that arrives now.
pluto-trine-venus: The creative and romantic sides of your life are given real power. This can bring a new attachment or deepen an existing one, and anything new will be notable for the strength of the feeling — it could hardly be called casual. There is a compelled quality to what draws the two of you together, and it is not all negative: it will simply feel to both of you as though the thing was inevitable, and it will teach you a great deal. You may discover that love is far less conscious than you supposed and that you act from compulsion more than you knew, which is the first step toward not doing so.
pluto-opposition-venus: Relationships are strongly affected, erotic ones particularly, since both planets are involved in that in different ways. If there is no important attachment in your life this may well bring one, with cautions attached. Powerful subconscious material is what makes you fall for someone now, so the shape of the thing will be determined far more by old patterns than by judgement. You may be irresistibly drawn to someone you know perfectly well is bad for you. If that happens, expect little pleasure from it — you are using the relationship to get at something in yourself, and that is not what relationships are for.
pluto-conjunction-mars: A period of great striving. You may overcome every obstacle and succeed at whatever you set yourself, or you may struggle against enormous resistance and win exhausted; it is genuinely hard to tell in advance which. The energy is very high and has to be discharged somehow, and if you do not use it you become the object of it — of circumstances, or of somebody else applying that kind of force to you. In extreme cases this carries a real association with violence, and that risk belongs specifically to not using any of the energy yourself. Find something enormous and legitimate to do with it.
pluto-sextile-mars: A chance to work and accomplish on a large scale, and to change a situation in the direction you think it should go. Energy is high and, more usefully, sustainable — you can keep the effort up over a long stretch, which is what makes real progress possible. You can do this alone, and you will do it better with other people toward a shared objective: you need not fear being submerged, since you will emerge as the significant figure in it and your own identity will be strengthened rather than lost. Excellent for anything involving substantial reform, rebuilding or repair.
pluto-square-mars: Considerable danger if handled badly, and a great deal of constructive work if handled well. The transit rouses ego energy, in you or in someone able to affect you, and frustrated energy of this kind is very difficult. In you directly it stimulates ambition and the wish to get ahead at any cost — which is why you can work extraordinarily hard for long hours, and also why you can work to genuine physical exhaustion without noticing the fatigue until too late. The more dangerous possibility is pursuing success or power by methods you would not defend, which under Pluto has consequences of its own.
pluto-trine-mars: Energy is higher than usual and you want to accomplish something substantial — often a serious drive for success in your work or in whatever matters most to you. Power over others may come to you whether or not you sought it, and with it the ability to change things you have not been able to change before. Even without that, you can work long and persistently at what would ordinarily wear you out. Physical activity is strongly favoured, particularly anything that rebuilds the body. Also favourable for any kind of repair, renovation or restoration, in the literal sense and otherwise.
pluto-opposition-mars: Powerful and difficult, because the energies are intense enough that harnessing them is a problem — not an impossible one. What is running rampant is the will to dominate, yours or somebody else's, and where it is somebody else's, the function is to test how secure you actually are. Expect real tension with the people around you and possibly serious flare-ups. The first thing is to recognise that you have a strong drive to win and, if necessary, to prevail over others in doing so. Acknowledged, that is manageable. Denied, it produces tension you cannot locate and anger you cannot account for.
pluto-conjunction-jupiter: Either great success in more or less anything you attempt, or strong opposition from people in power — largely depending on what you are trying to do and how. Most often it works out well. What you get is a rebirth of optimism and hope, which puts you in the frame of mind that produces success: you expect to succeed and therefore do. It works best where the aim is something beyond personal glory. You may get your share of that too, and it should not be the motive, because Pluto assists most reliably those working toward something that regenerates more than themselves.
pluto-sextile-jupiter: Several chances to advance whatever you are trying to do. Favourable for business and professional interests and for anything undertaken with a group. An excellent period for making an ideal actual, if it is at all achievable — Plutonian force can flow through your idealism now, and your ideals are higher than usual. You want to reform and change the world around you, which may be expressed simply as a drive for your own success, or as a wish to correct something genuinely unjust, at whatever scale is available to you. Philosophically you are drawn to systems that explain the whole.
pluto-square-jupiter: Real potential for achievement, with specific dangers attached. The success drive here can carry you forward in everything, particularly in your work, and at its best the optimism creates exactly the conditions in which things come out as you want. The risk is overreaching: taking on too much, committing too far, and finding yourself exposed when reality catches up with the expectations. The worse outcome is becoming arrogant and overbearing — a settled conviction that your aims matter more than anyone else's. Being willing to compromise, and making a genuine effort to understand the other position, is not optional here.
pluto-trine-jupiter: You will work to reform and improve the conditions around you, guided by your best sense of how things ought to be — within your immediate life, among the people you know, or on a larger scale. Nobody who asks you for help will be turned away. Interest grows in whatever takes a wide view — law, religion, philosophy, metaphysics — and you will not be content to hold it intellectually; you will want it operative in the world. Unusually favourable for dealings with the law and with anyone in authority, who may actively help you make the changes you want.
pluto-opposition-jupiter: You will drive yourself, and everyone near you, toward some kind of excellence or preeminence — this is the urge to make an ideal about how the world should be actually happen. The danger is arrogance: behaving as though you stood above the ordinary rules, answerable only to your own. That is the extreme form and it is the direction this leans. Before setting about improving everybody else, improve yourself, which you can genuinely do now. Deepen your understanding without forcing it on anyone, and while pursuing your own idea of excellence, do not obstruct anyone else's. Avoid anything that could bring you up against the law.
pluto-conjunction-saturn: A stressful period: Pluto is inevitable transformation and Saturn is the resistance to it, so change arrives in several areas and only after considerable difficulty. The typical situation has you holding onto something for dear life, or persisting at a task against forces trying to make you let go. The transit does increase your tenacity considerably, and it also creates the need for it. Often surrender serves better than the hard line — what is being changed usually needs to change, and holding on buys delay rather than reprieve. Underneath it, something in you is trying to break through the structure you built.
pluto-sextile-saturn: You can get by on very little now and keep working at something with extraordinary discipline, which makes this a good period for getting your life ready for harder times, whether or not any are coming. If this does fall in a difficult stretch, it will carry you through: it supplies tenacity and the capacity to apply steady pressure until a situation finally gives. Patience is the keynote — not that you need it, but that you have it. Because the work is slow, what it produces lasts. You will probably also find yourself changing, not dramatically, but slowly and at considerable depth.
pluto-square-saturn: Your way of life as currently arranged is severely challenged. We all build a structure as we grow and come to rely on it for order; sometimes the structure expresses us and sometimes it merely represses us, and if it is safe we tend to keep it either way. At some point the energies inside such an arrangement have to evolve or be destroyed, and this is that point. You may feel like the victim of some external force compelling you to move, but the mechanism for the change is inherent in the structure itself. Adapt for your own sake.
pluto-trine-saturn: Gradual and profound change, producing structures that last a long time. You work at it patiently and with real attention to detail, because you are not building for today. The endurance this confers lets you spend a long stretch eliminating what has become unnecessary and limiting, and replacing it with something that actually fits what you are doing now. You are changing internally at the same time, and taking a form that will hold for years — which may show up as changes in your work or in whatever occupies you. You will be careful with everything and waste nothing, which others may read as severity.
pluto-opposition-saturn: Circumstances change in ways that force you to give up a good deal — possessions, relationships, principles you have held onto — and you will probably resist, tenaciously, experiencing all of it as loss. Discipline is required, since there may be nothing to waste and you may have to do a great deal with very little. Feeling tends to get suppressed, as though facing your situation did not permit the luxury of emotion. That is apparent rather than real: what actually happens is that hardheartedness gets mistaken for hardheadedness. Keep your heart open even here, or you will carry the scar of this period as a permanent loss of humanity.
pluto-conjunction-uranus: This falls only for people born within about seventy years of a Uranus–Pluto conjunction, which means most who meet it at all meet it young — in the formative years, when a long transit does most to shape what comes later. What the combination brings is the demand to break away from whatever is holding you back: if things are not as you want them, you will change them, and you will not be patient about it. Discipline may mean very little to you now. Self-righteousness comes with it, a conviction that you know better than the people set over you.
pluto-sextile-uranus: Profound but constructive change. You go beneath the surface of things and meet dimensions of living you did not know were there, and the discoveries genuinely change how you live — provided you take what you find rather than turning away from it, and there is no reason to turn away. The insights also give you access to capacities and ingenuity you had not known about, and you can make real changes in your circumstances as well as in yourself. Favourable for taking up any study that opens something hidden, particularly one that is currently changing the world.
pluto-square-uranus: Change and upheaval, most of it originating outside your personal sphere in larger pressures from society. Many people feel that very little is happening in their own lives while the world around them is transformed beyond recognition. The task is adapting to that, since rigidity only makes it worse and resisting it is not a realistic option. Where Uranus is strong in your own chart you may find yourself acting as an agent of the change instead. If you feel severely limited by your circumstances, expect to be drawn to people and movements presenting themselves as the new order — on a political scale, or in the form of one person who shows you a different way.
pluto-trine-uranus: Radical and creative transformation, in your own life or in the lives of those around you. You will work to bring about changes that clearly separate this period from what preceded it — not wildly, but with a plan and a view of the whole, which is why what you build here is both thorough and lasting. Given the opportunity you may accomplish something genuinely out of the ordinary by your own standards. You are likely to become involved in something without precedent in your life, and to be drawn toward entirely new kinds of idea and the people who carry them.
pluto-opposition-uranus: Massive change, shared with almost everybody your age, and its causes may lie well outside your personal life in larger social forces. The combination reads as creative revolution — you may find yourself in revolt against whatever has made your life routine and uninteresting. Many things will pass out of your life abruptly and with little warning, including things you had assumed were permanent, and personal and professional relationships are strongly affected. The whole question is your attitude: the more heavily invested you are in conditions staying exactly as they are, the more this will cost you.
pluto-conjunction-neptune: Very deep inward transformation, showing up as changed ideals, aims and general view of things. You may also work harder than you ever have to make some long-held ideal actual — and you will have to give up a great deal for it, with very little recognition at the time, even where you succeed. Beliefs you have held as a matter of course require deep questioning, and discovering that you have been living inside illusions is disorienting. You will not be alone in it: this affects a whole age group at once, which is why talking to someone considerably older or younger is worth doing.
pluto-sextile-neptune: Because of the long mutual sextile between the two planets, this arrives in your fifties or later. It marks a turn toward mystical and otherworldly concerns: you want to explore the hidden depths of things and to have experiences with some substance to them. If you are ready, what happens can be genuinely illuminating about your own life and other people's. Even without any prior interest in such subjects, this awakens you to a dimension of existence you had not been accounting for. A purely materialist view of the universe will stop looking adequate, and you will know why.
pluto-square-neptune: This falls in your late sixties or after for everyone now living, and later still as the century goes on. You will have to deal with powerful outside forces that take no account of you as an individual — your particularity is not challenged so much as ignored, unless you stand in the way, in which case expect some discouraging experiences. Things you have always counted on begin to pass away in ways that are hard to understand. There is no dramatic struggle and no visible opponent; the old order is simply going, and what is hardest to accept is that there is nothing to fight.
pluto-trine-neptune: Like the sextile, this arrives late, and gently. Mystical and philosophical concerns deepen without the disorientation the harder angles bring: what you have believed can be re-examined without your losing your footing, and what survives that examination tends to be worth keeping. The dissolving power and the regenerating one are in accord for once, which makes this good ground for contemplative practice, and for the sort of quiet reappraisal of a life's ideals that only becomes possible once the ambition has gone out of them. Materialism will look thin. What replaces it is arrived at rather than adopted.
pluto-opposition-neptune: This has not happened to anyone now living and will not for at least another century, because the two planets have travelled in near-step through the whole modern period. Where it does eventually fall, it will set the dissolving power directly against the regenerating one — an entire structure of collective belief held in solution at one end and torn down at the other. It is a generational signature rather than a personal one, and its meaning will belong to whoever is alive to carry it rather than to anyone reading this now.
pluto-conjunction-pluto: This does not happen to anyone except, possibly, in the first months of life, when Pluto stations and crosses its own place again. As an early signature it belongs to the collective rather than the person: the whole of a birth-year carries it, and what it marks is less an event than a starting point — the degree from which the long slow work of a life's regeneration will be measured. Everything Pluto does afterwards is reckoned from here. For practical purposes this is a reference point rather than a transit anyone lives through.
pluto-sextile-pluto: The changes here belong to a creative evolution rather than a crisis. You can see that you are moving toward what you were aiming at and that nothing further is required — you will arrive simply by letting the present energies play out. Additional openings for growth appear alongside, which you may or may not take. This is stability inside change. Your concerns deepen, and you may want to understand more about your own workings, which is unusually safe to do now: the gentleness of this angle lets you discover things that would cause real anguish at another time.
pluto-square-pluto: Because Pluto's speed varies, this falls at very different ages depending on when you were born — at the earliest, in the late forties. It marks a general regeneration that is not necessarily pleasant. Most of us are attached to our past whether or not it is good for us, and this roots out precisely the parts that are not, including parts you had forgotten. Problems you lost track of but which have gone on operating may resurface and become active. Do not blame the unpleasant changes on the people or circumstances around you: look for how the ground for the present was laid.
pluto-trine-pluto: In practice this falls only in the eighties and nineties, and it is close in character to the sextile: a creative evolution rather than a crisis, in which change proceeds without your having to force it. Concerns deepen, and the long backward view available at that age makes the material unusually legible — you can see how the ground of the present was laid, and see it without much anguish, which is not always possible earlier. What is available here is understanding rather than upheaval, and it arrives quietly enough that it can pass unremarked.
pluto-opposition-pluto: This falls beyond any normal life expectancy and so is, for practical purposes, a transit nobody experiences. It would mark the exact midpoint of Pluto's cycle against the place it held at birth — the full culmination of a regeneration whose first half takes the better part of two centuries. As a piece of symbolism it is a reminder of the scale Pluto actually works on: the cycles it belongs to are longer than the lives measured against them, which is much of what gives its transits their impersonal weight.
pluto-conjunction-node: Pluto arrives at the axis of your own direction and takes it apart. What you believed you were developing toward is not so much revised as dismantled, usually along with whatever identity was resting on it — this is the point at which a direction stops being something you chose and becomes something that chooses you. Expect the accomplished end of the axis to lose its hold entirely: what you were good at will not serve, and cannot be gone back to. The change is slow, involuntary, and impersonal, and it takes years rather than months to complete.
pluto-sextile-node: A slow, workable contact with the line of your own development. Something in the direction you have been avoiding becomes possible, generally by way of a change in what you are willing to give up — an attachment loosens, a habit stops satisfying, and the way forward is clearer for its absence. Nothing forces the issue and nothing about it is dramatic. The characteristic feature is that the removal comes first and the direction becomes visible afterwards, which is the wrong order for comfort and the usual order for this planet.
pluto-square-node: What you are compelled by and what you are meant to be developing pull hard against each other. Usually the friction takes the form of an attachment — to a person, a role, a way of exercising power — that you cannot easily give up, standing exactly where the new ground begins. Struggling against it directly tends to deepen the hold. What actually shifts things is admitting the size of the attachment and what it has been doing for you, which is humbling and considerably more effective than force. This is a long transit; the resolution comes at the end of it.
pluto-trine-node: Depth and direction agree, and the result is a slow, thorough alignment that does not require a crisis to accomplish. What you have outgrown falls away without much drama, and the direction of the last stretch of your life becomes visible in a way that is genuinely usable. Where the effort has gone into the newer and harder side of yourself, the return arrives now as real weight — people take you seriously, and you can see why. This is one of the few Plutonian angles at which understanding comes without first having to lose something for it.
pluto-opposition-node: Pluto stands over the accomplished end of your axis and destroys the hold it had. The competence remains; what goes is your ability to live inside it, and that departure is neither gradual nor optional. Often it arrives through someone or something outside you making the old arrangement impossible to continue. Sasportas's account of this planet applies directly: the props your identity rested on are removed so that identity can be rebuilt on something wider. The first half of it is loss. The second half, which takes years, is what the loss was for.
pluto-conjunction-chiron: Pluto reaches the old injury and goes to the bottom of it. What has been managed for years is now excavated: the origin of it, what it has cost, and the arrangement you built to live around it. This is not gentle and it is not gratuitous. Chiron's wound does not close, and what Pluto changes is its position — it stops being the hidden centre of your arrangements and becomes something you have looked at squarely. The process takes years, and its first half is largely descent. What is rebuilt afterwards rests on something other than avoidance.
pluto-sextile-chiron: A slow, workable contact with the old injury, in which real understanding becomes available without a crisis to force it. Something loosens — a defence you no longer need, an account of the wound that turns out to be incomplete — and you can look further into it than usual without being overwhelmed. This is unusually good ground for serious therapeutic work, or for taking on something in the territory where you were hurt. Nothing here compels you, which means it can pass unused. What is on offer is depth without the cost that depth usually carries.
pluto-square-chiron: Pressure comes to bear directly on the injury and will not let up. Something in your circumstances keeps pressing exactly where you are least able to bear it, and the ordinary defences stop working. The temptation is to fight it — to force a resolution, to overpower the feeling, to make somebody responsible — and Sasportas's observation holds here: heroic struggle against this planet only deepens the anguish. What actually helps is admitting the size of what has been carried. That is humiliating, and it is what turns a wound managed in private into something that can eventually be used.
pluto-trine-chiron: The old damage can be examined at depth without a crisis to make you do it. What was hidden becomes legible, and the understanding available now is thorough rather than glancing — you can see where the injury came from, what it has shaped, and what it has genuinely taught you. That combination makes this a good period for serious work in the exact territory where you were hurt, professionally or otherwise, because you can do it without being run by it. Chiron does not close; what alters here is how much of you it governs.
pluto-opposition-chiron: You meet the injury at full depth, and from outside. Someone or something arrives that will not let you keep the old arrangement, and the pressure lands squarely on the place you have spent years protecting. Power is usually the medium — an imbalance, a dependency, someone in a position to hurt you where it counts. The first response is to fight, and fighting deepens it. What eventually works is looking at what the wound has been doing in your dealings with people, including what it has been earning you. That is unwelcome and it is the whole content of the transit.
pluto-conjunction-mc: Extremely important, and long — the effects work out over as much as two years. The question at the centre of it is your direction. Where are you going, what are you doing, and how are you going about it? This is a period of severe scrutiny in which you are likely to review everything you have done so far. Do you actually believe what you have been doing is valid — not only your job, since many people's real vocation is what they consider their sideline. And have the means you used been worth what they cost?
pluto-sextile-mc: This affects people very differently. It can be a period in which you fundamentally change your objectives at work, or one in which you turn inward and assess where you have actually got to, with much the same result. Forces you are probably not aware of, working behind the scenes, may hand you a chance to exert more real influence among the people you work with — sometimes because someone intended it, sometimes because you happen to fit a changed situation. A change of job or field is possible, though the change more often happens inside your present circumstances. Your private life shifts alongside.
pluto-square-mc: Take care not to provoke resistance. Avoid acting in a way that announces you are here to change everyone's habits and will not compromise on any of it. You may become obsessed with an objective, investing energy in it entirely out of proportion to what it is worth, and that is what alarms people and turns them against you. Equally, this may come at you from outside: someone or something may try to change you against your will. That is not wholly bad, since it forces you to become conscious of what you are actually doing. You will change either way; the changes can be good ones.
pluto-trine-mc: Gradual change that makes you far more aware of the forces, inside and outside, that actually move your life along. Psychological insight into yourself and other people deepens considerably, and you go beneath the surface of any question to whatever is really at issue. You may also gain some power, personally or professionally — the authority to direct something, or a group of people. Remember that you are acting for forces larger than yourself and that what you do has to serve more than you, or it comes to nothing. Sometimes the power is not authority at all but moral weight: people simply take you seriously.
pluto-opposition-mc: Pluto at the foot of your chart: great change in your family life and in your inner workings. You are likely to run into material from your own past — childhood, the home you grew up in, your parents, sometimes something further back in the family than that. The conditioning laid down early has a strong hold on adult behaviour, and understanding those mechanisms is what frees you from what they produce; this is a period when that understanding is genuinely available, because the forces are near enough to the surface to be watched in operation.
node-conjunction-sun: The Moon's north node reaches your Sun, which happens once and then not for nearly nineteen years. Rudhyar read this axis as the line of destiny: the north node the point at which life is taken in and something new has to be built by exertion, the south node the practised thing you can already do. When it crosses your Sun, the whole question of what you are for is briefly lit. Meetings made now tend to matter out of proportion to how they look. Notice which direction the people arriving are pointing you in.
node-conjunction-moon: The node reaches your Moon, and the line of your own direction crosses the seat of habit and instinct. That pairing is significant: habit is the strongest single force pulling you toward the easier end of this axis, and for a while the pull becomes visible. Domestic arrangements, family, the things you do without deciding to — all of these turn out to be carrying more of your direction than you had noticed. Something usually arrives through a person rather than an event. It comes once and does not return for nearly nineteen years.
node-conjunction-mercury: The node reaches your Mercury and the line of your own development crosses how you think and speak. What arrives is usually information: a conversation, an introduction, a piece of reading that turns out to have been the hinge. Small at the time, and pointed. This is one of the contacts where paying attention to what is being said to you matters more than what you are saying — the message here is inbound. It happens once and not again for nearly nineteen years, which is worth knowing while you are deciding whether to bother.
node-conjunction-venus: The node reaches your Venus, and the direction of your life crosses what you love and what you value. Almost always this arrives as a person: an introduction, an attraction, a connection made at a moment that turns out to have been the right one. Venus is what comes back to you from the world, so the meeting is also a return — a measure of which way you have actually been facing. It is worth noticing who turns up and what they represent. This crosses once, and then not for nearly nineteen years.
node-conjunction-mars: The node reaches your Mars, and your own direction crosses the impulse to act.
